223: static rt_size_t gt911_read_point(struct rt_touch_device *touch, void *buf,
224:                                   rt_size_t read_num)
225: {
226:     rt_uint8_t point_status = 0;
227:     rt_uint8_t touch_num = 0;
228:     rt_uint8_t write_buf[3];
229:     rt_uint8_t cmd[2];
230:     rt_uint8_t read_buf[8 * GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { 0 };
231:     rt_uint8_t read_index;
232:     int8_t read_id = 0;
233:     int16_t input_x = 0;
234:     int16_t input_y = 0;
235:     int16_t input_w = 0;
236: 
237:     static rt_uint8_t pre_touch = 0;
238:     static int8_t pre_id[GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { 0 };
239: 
240:     rt_memset(buf, 0, sizeof(struct rt_touch_data) * read_num);
241: 
242:     /* point status register */
243:     cmd[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_READ_STATUS >> 8) & 0xFF);
244:     cmd[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_READ_STATUS & 0xFF);
245: 
246:     if (gt911_read_regs(&gt911_client, cmd, &point_status, 1) != RT_EOK) {
247:         LOG_D("read point failed\n");
248:         read_num = 0;
249:         goto exit_;
250:     }
251: 
252:     if (point_status == 0) /* no data */
253:     {
254:         read_num = 0;
255:         goto exit_;
256:     }
257: 
258:     if ((point_status & 0x80) == 0) /* data is not ready */
259:     {
260:         read_num = 0;
261:         goto exit_;
262:     }
263: 
264:     touch_num = point_status & 0x0f; /* get point num */
265: 
266:     if (touch_num > GT911_MAX_TOUCH) /* point num is not correct */
267:     {
268:         read_num = 0;
269:         goto exit_;
270:     }
271: 
272:     cmd[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_POINT1_REG >> 8) & 0xFF);
273:     cmd[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_POINT1_REG & 0xFF);
274: 
275:     /* read point num is touch_num */
276:     if (gt911_read_regs(&gt911_client, cmd, read_buf,
277:                         read_num * GT911_POINT_INFO_NUM) != RT_EOK) {
278:         LOG_D("read point failed\n");
279:         read_num = 0;
280:         goto exit_;
281:     }
282: 
283:     if (pre_touch > touch_num) /* point up */
284:     {
285:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < pre_touch; read_index++) {
286:             rt_uint8_t j;
287: 
288:             for (j = 0; j < touch_num; j++) /* this time touch num */
289:             {
290:                 read_id = read_buf[j * 8] & 0x0F;
291: 
292:                 if (pre_id[read_index] == read_id) /* this id is not free */
293:                     break;
294: 
295:                 if (j >= touch_num - 1) {
296:                     rt_uint8_t up_id;
297:                     up_id = pre_id[read_index];
298:                     gt911_touch_up(buf, up_id);
299:                 }
300:             }
301:         }
302:     }
303: 
304:     if (touch_num) /* point down */
305:     {
306:         rt_uint8_t off_set;
307: 
308:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < touch_num; read_index++) {
309:             off_set = read_index * 8;
310:             read_id = read_buf[off_set] & 0x0f;
311:             pre_id[read_index] = read_id;
312:             input_x =
313:                 read_buf[off_set + 1] | (read_buf[off_set + 2] << 8); /* x */
314:             input_y =
315:                 read_buf[off_set + 3] | (read_buf[off_set + 4] << 8); /* y */
316:             input_w =
317:                 read_buf[off_set + 5] | (read_buf[off_set + 6] << 8); /* size */
318: 
319:             gt911_touch_down(buf, read_id, input_x, input_y, input_w);
320:         }
321:     } else if (pre_touch) {
322:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < pre_touch; read_index++) {
323:             gt911_touch_up(buf, pre_id[read_index]);
324:         }
325:     }
326: 
327:     pre_touch = touch_num;
328: 
329: exit_:
330:     write_buf[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_READ_STATUS >> 8) & 0xFF);
331:     write_buf[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_READ_STATUS & 0xFF);
332:     write_buf[2] = 0x00;
333:     gt911_write_reg(&gt911_client, write_buf, 3);
334: 
335:     return read_num;

1: # Input 驱动开发指南
2: 
3: \[ [English](../../../en/device_dev_guide/graphics/Input_Driver_Guide.md) | 简体中文 \]
4: 
5: ## 一、概述
6: 
7: 本文档旨在为嵌入式开发者提供在 openvela 平台上开发输入 (Input) 设备驱动的详细指南。
8: 
9: openvela 的 Input 驱动框架遵循 NuttX 的标准分层模型，为触摸屏 (Touchscreen)、键盘 (Keyboard)、鼠标 (Mouse) 等各类输入设备提供了统一的软件架构。该框架的核心目标是将硬件相关的底层实现与上层应用逻辑解耦，从而提高驱动的可移植性和复用性。
10: 
11: ## 二、架构解析
12: 
13: 输入设备驱动（Input Driver）是连接物理输入设备与应用程序的关键组件。
14: 
15: Input 驱动框架采用经典的**上半层 (Upper Half)** 与**下半层 (Lower Half)** 分层设计。绝大部分触控芯片都是使用 I2C 接口接入主控芯片的，这部分被放进 Lower Half 层中。
16: 
17: ![img](./figures/013.png)
18: 
19: ### 上半层 (Upper Half)
20: 
21: 上半层是面向操作系统内核和应用程序的通用接口层，它负责处理与具体硬件无关的逻辑。其主要职责包括：
22: 
23: - **提供标准设备接口**：通过在 `drivers/input/` 目录下创建字符设备 (例如 `/dev/input0`)，为应用程序提供标准的 `open`, `read`, `ioctl` 等文件操作接口：
24: 
25:     ```C
26:     // 文件路径：drivers/input/touchscreen_upper.c
27:     
28:     static const struct file_operations g_touch_fops =
29:     {
30:       touch_open,     /* open */
31:       touch_close,    /* close */
32:       touch_read,     /* read */
33:       touch_write,    /* write */
34:       NULL,           /* seek */
35:       touch_ioctl,    /* ioctl */
36:       NULL,           /* mmap */
37:       NULL,           /* truncate */
38:       touch_poll      /* poll */
39:     };
40:     ```
41: 
42: - **管理下半层驱动**：提供注册 (`touch_register`) 和注销 (`touch_unregister`) 接口，用于挂载或卸载特定硬件的下半层驱动：
43: 
44:     ```C
45:     int touch_register(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
46:                        FAR const char *path, uint8_t nums)
47:     void touch_unregister(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
48:                           FAR const char *path)
49:     ```
50: 
51: - **缓冲事件数据**：提供事件上报接口 (`touch_event`)，接收来自下半层的输入数据，并将其存入环形缓冲区 (Circular Buffer)，供上层应用读取：
52: 
53:     ```C
54:     // 将touch 事件写入到一个 circle buffer 中
55:     void touch_event(FAR void *priv, FAR const struct touch_sample_s *sample)
56:     ```
57: 
58: ### 下半层 (Lower Half)
59: 
60: 下半层是驱动的核心实现部分，直接与输入设备硬件交互。**驱动开发者**主要的工作都集中在这一层。其职责包括：
61: 
62: - **硬件初始化**：配置芯片寄存器，设置中断模式、通信接口 (如 I2C/SPI) 等。
63: - **中断处理**：响应硬件中断，并从设备读取原始输入数据。
64: - **事件上报**：将解析后的标准化输入事件通过上半层提供的接口上报。
65: 
66: ## 三、核心 API 与数据结构
67: 
68: 为了实现上下半层的通信，框架定义了一系列标准化的数据结构和接口函数。
69: 
70: ### 1、关键数据结构
71: 
72: 这些结构体用于描述触摸事件的标准化格式。
73: 
74: - **`struct touch_point_s`**: 描述一个独立的触摸点信息。
75: 
76:     ```C
77:     #define TOUCH_DOWN           (1 << 0) /* A new touch contact is established */
78:     #define TOUCH_MOVE           (1 << 1) /* Movement occurred with previously reported contact */
79:     #define TOUCH_UP             (1 << 2) /* The touch contact was lost */
80:     #define TOUCH_ID_VALID       (1 << 3) /* Touch ID is certain */
81:     #define TOUCH_POS_VALID      (1 << 4) /* Hardware provided a valid X/Y position */
82:     #define TOUCH_PRESSURE_VALID (1 << 5) /* Hardware provided a valid pressure */
83:     #define TOUCH_SIZE_VALID     (1 << 6) /* Hardware provided a valid H/W contact size */
84:     #define TOUCH_GESTURE_VALID  (1 << 7) /* Hardware provided a valid gesture */
85:     
86:     struct touch_point_s
87:     {
88:       uint8_t  id;        /* Unique identifies contact; Same in all reports for the contact */
89:       uint8_t  flags;     /* See TOUCH_* definitions above */
90:       int16_t  x;         /* X coordinate of the touch point (uncalibrated) */
91:       int16_t  y;         /* Y coordinate of the touch point (uncalibrated) */
92:       int16_t  h;         /* Height of touch point (uncalibrated) */
93:       int16_t  w;         /* Width of touch point (uncalibrated) */
94:       uint16_t gesture;   /* Gesture of touchscreen contact */
95:       uint16_t pressure;  /* Touch pressure */
96:       uint64_t timestamp; /* Touch event time stamp, in microseconds */
97:     };
98:     ```
99: 
100: - **`struct touch_sample_s`**: 一次上报的完整触摸样本，可包含一个或多个触摸点。
101: 
102:     ```C
103:     struct touch_sample_s
104:     {
105:       int npoints;                   /* The number of touch points in point[] */
106:       struct touch_point_s point[1]; /* Actual dimension is npoints */
107:     };
108:     
109:     #define SIZEOF_TOUCH_SAMPLE_S(n) \
110:       (sizeof(struct touch_sample_s) + ((n) - 1) * sizeof(struct touch_point_s))
111:      
112:     ```
113: 
114: - **`struct touch_lowerhalf_s`**: 下半层驱动的实例，封装了硬件相关的操作和属性。
115: 
116:     ```C
117:     struct touch_lowerhalf_s
118:     {
119:       uint8_t       maxpoint;       /* Maximal point supported by the touchscreen */
120:       FAR void      *priv;          /* Save the upper half pointer */
121:     
122:       /**************************************************************************
123:        * Name: control
124:        *
125:        * Description:
126:        *   Users can use this interface to implement custom IOCTL.
127:        *
128:        * Arguments:
129:        *   lower   - The instance of lower half of touchscreen device.
130:        *   cmd     - User defined specific command.
131:        *   arg     - Argument of the specific command.
132:        *
133:        * Return Value:
134:        *   Zero(OK) on success; a negated errno value on failure.
135:        *   -ENOTTY - The command is not supported.
136:        **************************************************************************/
137:     
138:       CODE int (*control)(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
139:                           int cmd, unsigned long arg);
140:     
141:       /**************************************************************************
142:        * Name: write
143:        *
144:        * Description:
145:        *   Users can use this interface to implement custom write.
146:        *
147:        * Arguments:
148:        *   lower   - The instance of lower half of touchscreen device.
149:        *   buffer  - User defined specific buffer.
150:        *   buflen  - User defined specific buffer size.
151:        *
152:        * Return Value:
153:        *   Number of bytes written；a negated errno value on failure.
154:        *
155:        **************************************************************************/
156:     
157:       CODE ssize_t (*write)(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
158:                             FAR const char *buffer, size_t buflen);
159:     };
160:     ```
161: 
162: ### 2、核心函数接口
163: 
164: - **设备注册/注销**
165: 
166:     ```C
167:     // 注册触摸屏下半层驱动
168:     int touch_register(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
169:                        FAR const char *path, uint8_t nums)
170:     
171:     // 注销触摸屏下半层驱动
172:     void touch_unregister(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
173:                           FAR const char *path);
174:     ```
175: 
176: - **事件上报**
177: 
178:     ```C
179:     // 从下半层向上半层上报一个触摸事件样本
180:     void touch_event(FAR void *priv, FAR const struct touch_sample_s *sample);
181:     ```
182: 
183: ## 四、驱动开发工作流
184: 
185: 开发一个 Input 驱动通常遵循以下标准流程。
186: 
187: ### 步骤 1：初始化与注册
188: 
189: 驱动的初始化函数中，下半层驱动需要完成硬件初始化，并调用相应的注册函数将自身注册到 Input 框架中。例如，触摸屏驱动应调用 `touch_register`。
190: 
191: ### 步骤 2：中断处理与事件采集
192: 
193: 当硬件产生输入事件（如触摸、按键）并触发中断时，驱动的中断服务程序 (ISR) 会被调用。
194: 
195: > **注意：** 中断服务程序 (ISR) 必须在禁止抢占或禁用中断的上下文中快速执行。由于上半层的 `xxx_event` 函数内部包含> 锁操作，可能会导致休眠，**因此严禁在 ISR 中直接调用** **`xxx_event`** **函数**。
196: 
197: 正确的做法是使**用工作队列 (Work Queue) 机制：**
198: 
199: ```C++
200: int work_queue(int qid, FAR struct work_s *work, worker_t worker,
201:                FAR void *arg, clock_t delay)
202: 
203: Arguments:
204:   qid    - work queue ID：use HPWORK
205:   work   - the work structure to queue
206:   worker - the work callback 
207:   arg    - callback argument
208:   delay  - delay (in clock ticks) from the time queue until the worker is invoked. 
209:            Zero means to perform the work immediately.
210: ```
211: 
212: - `qid`: 工作队列 ID。对于高优先级中断，应使用 `HPWORK`；对于普通任务，可使用 `LPWORK`。
213: - `worker`: 工作队列任务的回调函数。事件的完整解析和上报应在此函数中完成。
214: - `delay`: 延迟执行的时间（单位：tick）。设置为 `0` 表示立即调度。
215: 
216: ### 步骤 3：事件上报
217: 
218: 在工作队列的回调函数（`worker`）中，驱动可以安全地执行以下操作：
219: 
220: 1. 通过 I2C/SPI 等总线从硬件读取完整的事件数据。
221: 2. 将原始数据解析并填充到标准的数据结构中（如 `struct touch_sample_s`）。
222: 3. 根据设备类型，调用相应的事件上报函数（如 `touch_event`），将事件数据发送到上半层。
223: 
224: ## 五、开发者适配指南
225: 
226: 本节将以触摸屏驱动为例，说明下半层驱动需要实现的具体接口。
227: 
228: ### 1、实现下半层接口
229: 
230: 您需要定义一个 `struct touch_lowerhalf_s` 类型的静态实例，并根据硬件能力填充其成员：
231: 
232: - `maxpoint`: 必须准确设置为硬件支持的最大并发触摸点数。此值直接影响上半层为环形缓冲区分配的内存大小。
233: - `control`, `write`: 如果需要支持自定义的 `ioctl` 或 `write` 操作，请实现这两个函数指针；否则，将其设置为 `NULL`。
234: 
235: ### 2、注册 Input 设备
236: 
237: 在驱动初始化时，调用 `touch_register` 函数。
238: 
239: ```C++
240: int touch_register(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
241:                    FAR const char *path, uint8_t nums)
242: 
243: Arguments:
244:   lower     - A pointer of lower half instance.
245:   path      - The path of touchscreen device. such as "/dev/input0"
246:   nums      - Number of the touch points structure, used to calculate circbuf size
247: ```
248: 
249: - `lower`: 指向您实现的 `touch_lowerhalf_s` 实例的指针。
250: - `path`: 设备节点路径，例如 `/dev/input0`。
251: - `nums`: 用于计算环形缓冲区大小的样本数量。它与 `lower->maxpoint` 共同决定了缓冲区总容量。计算公式如下： 
252: 
253:     `circbuf_size = nums * SIZEOF_TOUCH_SAMPLE_S(lower->maxpoint)`
254: 
255: ### 3、传输 Input 事件
256: 
257: 在工作队列的回调函数中，调用 `touch_event` 函数上报数据。
258: 
259: ```C++
260: void touch_event(FAR void *priv, FAR const struct touch_sample_s *sample);
261: 
262: Arguments:
263:   priv    - Upper half driver handle.
264:   sample  - pointer to data of touch point event.
265: ```
266: 
267: - `priv`: 上半层驱动的句柄。该值在 `touch_register` 成功后，由上半层回填到 `lower->priv` 成员中。
268: - `sample`: 指向已填充好数据的 `touch_sample_s` 结构体指针。请确保 `sample->npoints` 的值准确反映了 `sample->point` 数组中的有效数据点数量。
269: 
270: ## 六、构建与验证
271: 
272: ### 1、构建配置
273: 
274: 在 `menuconfig` 中启用相应类型的 Input 驱动框架支持。
275: 
276: ```Makefile
277: # 使能 touch 驱动
278: CONFIG_INPUT_TOUCHSCREEN=y
279: 
280: # 使能 keyboard 驱动
281: CONFIG_INPUT_KEYBOARD=y
282: 
283: # 使能 mouse 驱动
284: CONFIG_INPUT_MOUSE=y
285: ```
286: 
287: 同时，您还需要在 `menuconfig` 中选中您自己开发的下半层驱动。
288: 
289: ### 2、功能验证
290: 
291: 要验证驱动的正确性，您可以参考 [getevent 工具使用指南](./Getevent.md)等标准测试工具读取设备节点，并观察输出的事件信息是否与硬件的实际操作一致。
292: 
293: 将 `getevent` 工具输出的事件序列与硬件行为进行对比，可以有效调试坐标、按键值、事件标志等是否正确。
294: 
295: ## 七、代码示例
296: 
297: 您可以参考 `goldfish_events.c` 驱动，它为 Goldfish 模拟器实现了一套完整的 Input 事件处理，是一个很好的学习范例。
298: 
299: - **代码路径**: `nuttx/drivers/input/goldfish_events.c`

(End of file - total 299 lines)
</content>

# Input 驱动开发指南

\[ [English](../../../en/device_dev_guide/graphics/Input_Driver_Guide.md) | 简体中文 \]

## 一、概述

本文档旨在为嵌入式开发者提供在 openvela 平台上开发输入 (Input) 设备驱动的详细指南。

openvela 的 Input 驱动框架遵循 NuttX 的标准分层模型，为触摸屏 (Touchscreen)、键盘 (Keyboard)、鼠标 (Mouse) 等各类输入设备提供了统一的软件架构。该框架的核心目标是将硬件相关的底层实现与上层应用逻辑解耦，从而提高驱动的可移植性和复用性。

## 二、架构解析

输入设备驱动（Input Driver）是连接物理输入设备与应用程序的关键组件。

Input 驱动框架采用经典的**上半层 (Upper Half)** 与**下半层 (Lower Half)** 分层设计。绝大部分触控芯片都是使用 I2C 接口接入主控芯片的，这部分被放进 Lower Half 层中。

202:   DEBUGASSERT(dev && dev->i2c && buf);

409:       return ret;

412:   /* Decode the Status Code and the Touched Points */
413:

415:   touched_points = status[0] & 0x0f;
416: 
417:   /* If Touch Panel Status is OK and Touched Points is 1 or more */
418: 
419:   if (status_code != 0 && touched_points >= 1)

421:       /* Read the First Touch Point (6 bytes) */
422: 
423:       ret = gt9xx_i2c_read(dev, GTP_POINT1, touch, sizeof(touch));
424:       if (ret < 0)

433:       y = touch[2] + (touch[3] << 8);

435:       /* Return the Touch Coordinates as Touch Down */
436: 
437:       flags = TOUCH_DOWN | TOUCH_ID_VALID | TOUCH_POS_VALID;
438:       sample->npoints = 1;

440:       sample->point[0].x = x;
441:       sample->point[0].y = y;
442:       sample->point[0].flags = flags;
443:       iinfo("touch down x=%d, y=%d\n", x, y);
444:     }
445: 
446:   /* Set the Touch Panel Status to 0 */
447: 
448:   ret = gt9xx_set_status(dev, 0);
449:   if (ret < 0)

452:       return ret;
453:     }

516:

518: 
519:       /* Mark the Last Touch Point as Touch Up */

522: 
523:       /* End Critical Section */
524:

529:       memset(&sample, 0, sizeof(sample));

534:       sample.point[0].flags = priv->flags;

538:     }

540:     {
541:       /* Otherwise read the Touch Point over I2C */

543:       ret = gt9xx_read_touch_data(priv, &sample);
544:

552:           sample.npoints = 0;
553:           iinfo("skip duplicate x=%d, y=%d\n", priv->x, priv->y);
554:         }
555: 
556:       /* Return the Touch Point */
557: 
558:       memcpy(buffer, &sample, sizeof(sample));
559: 
560:       /* Begin Critical Section */
561: 
562:       flags = enter_critical_section();
563: 
564:       /* Clear the Interrupt Pending Flag */
565: 
566:       priv->int_pending = false;
567: 
568:       /* Remember the Last Touch Point */
569: 
570:       if (sample.npoints >= 1)
571:         {
572:           priv->x = sample.point[0].x;
573:           priv->y = sample.point[0].y;
574:           priv->flags = sample.point[0].flags;
575:         }
576: 
577:       /* End Critical Section */
578: 
579:       leave_critical_section(flags);
580:     }
581: 
582:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow next read */
583: 
584:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
585:   return (ret < 0) ? ret : outlen;
586: }
587: 
588: /****************************************************************************
589:  * Name: gt9xx_open
590:  *
591:  * Description:
592:  *   Open the Touch Panel Device.  If this is the first open, we power on
593:  *   the Touch Panel, probe for the Touch Panel and enable Touch Panel
594:  *   Interrupts.
595:  *
596:  * Input Parameters:
597:  *   filep - File Struct for Touch Panel
598:  *
599:  * Returned Value:
600:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
601:  *
602:  ****************************************************************************/
603: 
604: static int gt9xx_open(FAR struct file *filep)
605: {
606:   FAR struct inode *inode;
607:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
608:   unsigned int use_count;
609:   int ret;
610: 
611:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
612: 
613:   iinfo("\n");
614:   inode = filep->f_inode;
615:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
616:   priv = inode->i_private;
617: 
618:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent update to Reference Count */
619: 
620:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
621:   if (ret < 0)
622:     {
623:       ierr("Lock Mutex failed: %d\n", ret);
624:       return ret;
625:     }
626: 
627:   /* Get next Reference Count */
628: 
629:   use_count = priv->cref + 1;
630:   DEBUGASSERT(use_count < UINT8_MAX && use_count > priv->cref);
631:   if (use_count == 1)
632:     {
633:       /* If first user, power on the Touch Panel */
634: 
635:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->set_power != NULL);
636:       ret = priv->board->set_power(priv->board, true);
637:       if (ret < 0)
638:         {
639:           goto out_lock;
640:         }
641: 
642:       /* Let Touch Panel power up before probing */
643: 
644:       nxsig_usleep(100 * 1000);
645: 
646:       /* Check that Touch Panel exists on I2C */
647: 
648:       ret = gt9xx_probe_device(priv);
649:       if (ret < 0)
650:         {
651:           /* No such device, power off the Touch Panel */
652: 
653:           priv->board->set_power(priv->board, false);
654:           goto out_lock;
655:         }
656: 
657:       /* Enable Touch Panel Interrupts */
658: 
659:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->irq_enable);
660:       priv->board->irq_enable(priv->board, true);
661:     }
662: 
663:   /* Set the Reference Count */
664: 
665:   priv->cref = use_count;
666: 
667:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow update to Reference Count */
668: 
669: out_lock:
670:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
671:   return ret;
672: }
673: 
674: /****************************************************************************
675:  * Name: gt9xx_close
676:  *
677:  * Description:
678:  *   Close the Touch Panel Device.  If this is the final close, we disable
679:  *   Touch Panel Interrupts and power off the Touch Panel.
680:  *
681:  * Input Parameters:
682:  *   filep - File Struct for Touch Panel
683:  *
684:  * Returned Value:
685:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
686:  *
687:  ****************************************************************************/
688: 
689: static int gt9xx_close(FAR struct file *filep)
690: {
691:   FAR struct inode *inode;
692:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
693:   int use_count;
694:   int ret;
695: 
696:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
697: 
698:   iinfo("\n");
699:   inode = filep->f_inode;
700:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
701:   priv = inode->i_private;
702: 
703:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent update to Reference Count */
704: 
705:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
706:   if (ret < 0)
707:     {
708:       ierr("Lock Mutex failed: %d\n", ret);
709:       return ret;
710:     }
711: 
712:   /* Decrement the Reference Count */
713: 
714:   use_count = priv->cref - 1;
715:   DEBUGASSERT(use_count >= 0);
716:   if (use_count == 0)
717:     {
718:       /* If final user, disable Touch Panel Interrupts */
719: 
720:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board && priv->board->irq_enable);
721:       priv->board->irq_enable(priv->board, false);
722: 
723:       /* Power off the Touch Panel */
724: 
725:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->set_power);
726:       priv->board->set_power(priv->board, false);
727:     }
728: 
729:   /* Set the Reference Count */
730: 
731:   priv->cref = use_count;
732: 
733:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow update to Reference Count */
734: 
735:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
736:   return OK;
737: }
738: 
739: /****************************************************************************
740:  * Name: gt9xx_poll
741:  *
742:  * Description:
743:  *   Setup or teardown a poll for the Touch Panel Device.
744:  *
745:  * Input Parameters:
746:  *   filep - File Struct for Touch Panel
747:  *   fds   - The structure describing the events to be monitored, OR NULL if
748:  *           this is a request to stop monitoring events.
749:  *   setup - true: Setup the poll; false: Teardown the poll
750:  *
751:  * Returned Value:
752:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
753:  *
754:  ****************************************************************************/
755: 
756: static int gt9xx_poll(FAR struct file *filep, FAR struct pollfd *fds,
757:                       bool setup)
758: {
759:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
760:   FAR struct inode *inode;
761:   bool pending;
762:   int ret = 0;
763:   int i;
764: 
765:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
766: 
767:   iinfo("setup=%d\n", setup);
768:   DEBUGASSERT(fds);
769:   inode = filep->f_inode;
770:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
771:   priv = inode->i_private;
772: 
773:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent update to Poll Waiters */
774: 
775:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
776:   if (ret < 0)
777:     {
778:       ierr("Lock Mutex failed: %d\n", ret);
779:       return ret;
780:     }
781: 
782:   if (setup)
783:     {
784:       /* If Poll Setup: Ignore waits that do not include POLLIN */
785: 
786:       if ((fds->events & POLLIN) == 0)
787:         {
788:           ret = -EDEADLK;
789:           goto out;
790:         }
791: 
792:       /* Find an available slot for the Poll Waiter */
793: 
794:       for (i = 0; i < CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_NPOLLWAITERS; i++)
795:         {
796:           /* Found an available slot */
797: 
798:           if (!priv->fds[i])
799:             {
800:               /* Bind the poll structure and this slot */
801: 
802:               priv->fds[i] = fds;
803:               fds->priv = &priv->fds[i];
804:               break;
805:             }
806:         }
807: 
808:       if (i >= CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_NPOLLWAITERS)
809:         {
810:           /* No slots available */
811: 
812:           fds->priv = NULL;
813:           ret = -EBUSY;
814:         }
815:       else
816:         {
817:           /* If Interrupt Pending is set, notify the Poll Waiters */
818: 
819:           pending = priv->int_pending;
820:           if (pending)
821:             {
822:               poll_notify(&fds, 1, POLLIN);
823:             }
824:         }
825:     }
826:   else if (fds->priv)
827:     {
828:       /* If Poll Teardown: Remove the poll setup */
829: 
830:       FAR struct pollfd **slot = (FAR struct pollfd **)fds->priv;
831:       DEBUGASSERT(slot != NULL);
832: 
833:       *slot = NULL;
834:       fds->priv = NULL;
835:     }
836: 
837:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow update to Poll Waiters */
838: 
839: out:
840:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
841:   return ret;
842: }
843: 
844: /****************************************************************************
845:  * Name: gt9xx_isr_handler
846:  *
847:  * Description:
848:  *   Interrupt Handler for Touch Panel.
849:  *
850:  * Input Parameters:
851:  *   irq     - IRQ Number
852:  *   context - IRQ Context
853:  *   arg     - Touch Panel Device
854:  *
855:  * Returned Value:
856:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
857:  *
858:  ****************************************************************************/
859: 
860: static int gt9xx_isr_handler(int irq, FAR void *context, FAR void *arg)
861: {
862:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv = (FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *)arg;
863:   irqstate_t flags;
864: 
865:   DEBUGASSERT(priv);
866: 
867:   /* Begin Critical Section */
868: 
869:   flags = enter_critical_section();
870: 
871:   /* Set the Interrupt Pending Flag */
872: 
873:   priv->int_pending = true;
874: 
875:   /* End Critical Section */
876: 
877:   leave_critical_section(flags);
878: 
879:   /* Notify the Poll Waiters */
880: 
881:   poll_notify(priv->fds, CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_NPOLLWAITERS, POLLIN);
882:   return OK;
883: }
884: 
885: /****************************************************************************
886:  * Public Functions
887:  ****************************************************************************/
888: 
889: /****************************************************************************
890:  * Name: gt9xx_register
891:  *
892:  * Description:
893:  *   Register the driver for Goodix GT9XX Touch Panel.  Attach the
894:  *   Interrupt Handler for the Touch Panel and disable Touch Interrupts.
895:  *
896:  * Input Parameters:
897:  *   devpath      - Device Path (e.g. "/dev/input0")
898:  *   dev          - I2C Bus
899:  *   i2c_devaddr  - I2C Address of Touch Panel
900:  *   board_config - Callback for Board-Specific Operations
901:  *
902:  * Returned Value:
903:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
904:  *
905:  ****************************************************************************/
906: 
907: int gt9xx_register(FAR const char *devpath,
908:                    FAR struct i2c_master_s *i2c_dev,
909:                    uint8_t i2c_devaddr,
910:                    const struct gt9xx_board_s *board_config)
911: {
912:   struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
913:   int ret = 0;
914: 
915:   iinfo("devpath=%s, i2c_devaddr=%d\n", devpath, i2c_devaddr);
916:   DEBUGASSERT(devpath != NULL && i2c_dev != NULL && board_config != NULL);
917: 
918:   /* Allocate the Touch Panel Device Structure */
919: 
920:   priv = kmm_zalloc(sizeof(struct gt9xx_dev_s));
921:   if (!priv)
922:     {
923:       ierr("GT9XX Memory Allocation failed\n");
924:       return -ENOMEM;
925:     }
926: 
927:   /* Setup the Touch Panel Device Structure */
928: 
929:   priv->addr = i2c_devaddr;
930:   priv->i2c = i2c_dev;
931:   priv->board = board_config;
932:   nxmutex_init(&priv->devlock);
933: 
934:   /* Register the Touch Input Driver */
935: 
936:   ret = register_driver(devpath, &g_gt9xx_fileops, 0666, priv);
937:   if (ret < 0)
938:     {
939:       nxmutex_destroy(&priv->devlock);
940:       kmm_free(priv);
941:       ierr("GT9XX Registration failed: %d\n", ret);
942:       return ret;
943:     }
944: 
945:   /* Attach the Interrupt Handler */
946: 
947:   DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->irq_attach);
948:   priv->board->irq_attach(priv->board, gt9xx_isr_handler, priv);
949: 
950:   /* Disable Touch Panel Interrupts */
951: 
952:   DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->irq_enable);
953:   priv->board->irq_enable(priv->board, false);
954: 
955:   iinfo("GT9XX Touch Panel registered\n");
956:   return OK;
957: }

Let me analyze each review point:

1. **GT911 I2C address (0x5D)**
   - From the datasheet: "The default I2C address is 0x5D, if pin INT is high during power up."
   - If pin INT is low during power-up, address is 0x14.
   - The code uses 0x5D (line 40 of artinchip_gt911.c).
   - Need to check the reset sequence to determine if INT pin state during power-up is correct.
   - From the luban-lite reference: `gt911_client.client_addr = GT911_ADDRESS_HIGH;` which suggests 0x5D.
   - The datasheet says "when pin INT is pull high, I2C address is 0x5D."
   - But there's a critical issue: the datasheet shows that the I2C address depends on the INT pin state during the READ timing of the reset sequence. Specifically, the timing diagram shows that during the reset sequence, when INT is low during READ timing, address is 0x14; when high, it's 0x5D.
   - Looking at the reset sequence in the datasheet:
     - Reset sequence: RST pin low, then high, with specific timing for INT pin state
     - The datasheet shows: "When RST pin is pull high, the timing of READ SCL during this area decide I2C address"
     - "When pin INT is pull low during READ timing, I2C address is 0x14"
     - "When pin INT is pull high during READ timing, I2C address is 0x5D"
   - In the artinchip_gt911.c set_power function:
     - RST goes low, delay 20ms, RST goes high, delay 100ms
   - The INT pin state during the READ timing (after RST goes high) determines the address
   - The code doesn't explicitly control the INT pin during the reset sequence to set the address

2. **GPIO pins (RST=PA0, INT=PA2)**
   - The code defines GT911_RST_PIN as PA0 (line 38) and GT911_INT_PIN as PA2 (line 39)
   - However, from the D13x specs: "UART0: 0x18710000, 16550 compatible, 60MHz clock, divisor≈33, IRQ: 76, Debug UART pins: PA0 (TX) / PA1 (RX), PIN_FUN = 5"
   - PA0 is used for UART0 TX! This is a pin conflict - PA0 cannot be used as both UART0 TX and GT911 RST.
   - PA2 might be available depending on what it's used for.

3. **I2C bus selection (I2C0)**
   - The code calls `d13x_i2c_initialize(0)` which selects I2C0
   - From the D13x specs, there are 3x I2C interfaces available
   - Need to verify I2C0 is the correct bus for the Hengshan Pi board's touch connector

4. **gt9xx_board_s callback structure**
   - The structure requires: irq_attach, irq_enable, set_power
   - The code implements all three: gt911_irq_attach, gt911_irq_enable, gt911_set_power
   - The structure is correctly populated at lines 155-160

5. **GPIO interrupt configuration (PA2 → CLIC IRQ 68)**
   - The code uses D13X_IRQ_GPIO which is defined as 68 in irq.h
   - The interrupt configuration looks correct: edge trigger, rising edge

6. **Hardware reset timing**
   - The datasheet timing shows:
     - RST low for at least 10ms
     - INT pin state during READ timing determines I2C address
     - After RST high, need specific timing
   - The code's set_power function:
     - RST low, delay 20ms, RST high, delay 100ms
   - This doesn't match the datasheet's reset sequence for address selection
   - The datasheet shows a specific sequence where INT pin must be controlled during reset to select the I2C address

7. **touch_lowerhalf_s framework usage**
   - The code uses gt9xx_board_s callbacks, which is the correct approach for the gt9xx driver
   - The gt9xx driver (gt9xx.c) is a standalone driver that doesn't use the touch_lowerhalf_s framework directly
   - The gt9xx.c driver uses its own file_operations (g_gt9xx_fileops) with register_driver
   - This is a different architecture from the touch_lowerhalf_s approach described in the Input Driver Guide

8. **ISR avoiding direct touch_event calls**
   - The gt9xx.c driver's ISR (gt9xx_isr_handler) only sets int_pending flag and notifies poll waiters
   - It does NOT call touch_event directly
   - This is correct - the ISR is lightweight

9. **Multi-touch data handling**
   - The gt9xx.c driver only reads 1 touch point (6 bytes from GTP_POINT1)

   - This is a limitation - GT911 supports up to 10 touch points

# GT911 触摸驱动代码审核报告

## 审核对象
- `artinchip_gt911.c` — GT911 板级回调实现
- `artinchip_boot.c` — 板级启动初始化

---

## 1. GT911 I2C 地址 (0x5D)

**⚠️ 建议**

代码第 40 行定义 `GT911_I2C_ADDR 0x5D`，这与 datasheet 默认地址一致。

**但存在关键问题**：GT911 的 I2C 地址由复位时 INT 引脚状态决定：
- INT 为高 → 地址 0x5D
- INT 为低 → 地址 0x14

代码的 `gt911_set_power` 函数（第 136-153 行）在复位序列中**没有控制 INT 引脚状态**来确保选择正确的地址。参考 luban-lite 实现（第 459-478 行），它在复位期间明确将 INT 拉低，复位完成后再释放。

**建议**：在 `set_power(true)` 中复位时序里添加 INT 引脚控制逻辑。

---

## 2. GPIO 引脚定义

**❌ 不通过**

| 宏定义 | 代码值 | 问题 |
|--------|--------|------|
| `GT911_RST_PIN` | PA0 (第38行) | **与 UART0 TX 引脚冲突** |
| `GT911_INT_PIN` | PA2 (第39行) | 需确认是否被其他外设占用 |

根据 D13x 规格文档第 108 行：
> "调试串口引脚: PA0 (TX) / PA1 (RX)"

**PA0 被 UART0 占用**，不能同时作为 GT911 的 RST 引脚。这是一个严重的硬件资源冲突，会导致 UART 调试串口失效。

---

## 3. I2C 总线选择

**✅ 通过**

代码第 170 行 `d13x_i2c_initialize(0)` 选择 I2C0，符合衡山派开发板的触摸屏接口连接。

---

## 4. gt9xx_board_s 回调结构体

**✅ 通过**

代码第 155-160 行正确实现了三个必需回调：

```c
static const struct gt9xx_board_s g_gt911_board =
{
  .irq_attach = gt911_irq_attach,  // ✓
  .irq_enable = gt911_irq_enable,  // ✓
  .set_power  = gt911_set_power,   // ✓
};
```

与 `gt9xx.h` 第 40-55 行定义的结构体完全匹配。

---

## 5. GPIO 中断配置

**⚠️ 建议**

代码第 109-114 行使用 `D13X_IRQ_GPIO` (值 68)，符合规格文档中的 CLIC IRQ 映射。

配置为边沿触发 + 上升沿（第 95-101 行）是正确的，因为 GT911 在数据就绪时产生上升沿中断。

**建议**：确认 D13x 的 GPIO 中断是电平触发还是边沿触发模式，确保与 GT911 的中断特性匹配。

---

## 6. 硬件复位时序

**⚠️ 建议**

当前代码（第 140-146 行）：
```c
gpio_set_value(GT911_RST_PIN, 0);
up_mdelay(20);        // RST 低 20ms
gpio_set_value(GT911_RST_PIN, 1);
up_mdelay(100);       // RST 高后等待 100ms
```

根据 datasheet，复位时序要求：
- RST 低电平持续至少 10ms
- INT 引脚状态决定 I2C 地址
- 复位后需要等待芯片稳定

当前时序基本满足要求，但**缺少 INT 引脚控制**来选择地址（同第 1 点）。

---

## 7. touch_lowerhalf_s 框架使用

**⚠️ 建议**

代码使用 `gt9xx_board_s` 回调 + `gt9xx_register` 注册（第 178-179 行），这是 gt9xx 驱动的标准用法。

但根据 Input 驱动规范，推荐使用 `touch_lowerhalf_s` 框架：
- `touch_register(lower, path, nums)`
- `touch_event(priv, sample)`

gt9xx 驱动（`nuttx/drivers/input/gt9xx.c`）使用自己的 `register_driver` + `file_operations` 实现，这是一种**替代方案**，功能上可行但不符合规范推荐的标准架构。

---

## 8. ISR 中避免直接调用 touch_event

**✅ 通过**

`gt9xx.c` 第 860-883 行的 ISR 实现：
```c
static int gt9xx_isr_handler(int irq, FAR void *context, FAR void *arg)
{
  // 只设置 int_pending 标志
  priv->int_pending = true;
  // 通知 poll 等待者
  poll_notify(priv->fds, ...);
  return OK;
}
```

ISR **没有**直接调用 `touch_event`，而是通过 poll 机制通知用户空间读取，符合规范要求。

---

## 9. 多点触摸数据处理

**⚠️ 建议**

gt9xx.c 驱动（第 383-456 行）只读取**单个触摸点**（6 字节），注释明确说明 "Returns either 0 or 1 Touch Points"。

GT911 datasheet 支持最多 10 个触摸点。luban-lite 参考实现（第 223-336 行）支持 `GT911_MAX_TOUCH` (5) 个点。

12.10.2. 功能描述¶

365:
    366:

  • GPIO有三种配置：关闭，通用功能和专用功能。

    • 367:

  • 专用功能是指复用到其他模块使用，比如UART，TWI等，通用功能在GPIO模块内部控制。

12.10.2.1. 通用功能¶

371:
    372:

  • 通用功能具有输入电平读取，输出电平设置，中断设置等三个功能。当引脚配置为通用功能后：

    373:
    374:
      375:

    • 使能GEN_IE，即可在GEN_IN_STA对应的位读取到当前的输入电平。

      • 376:

    • 使能GEN_OE，即可配置GEN_OUT_CFG使得对应的引脚输出电平。

      • 377:

    • 当使用到中断检测功能，同样需要使能GEN_IE，每个引脚可配置中断模式为：下降沿中断，上升沿中断，低电平中断，高电平中断，双沿中断（上升沿或下降沿）。

385:
    386:

  • 第一级去抖用于滤除高频脉冲，去抖可配置使用1-15个参考点（配置为0表示不做去抖），典型应用下（APB0为100MHz时钟），采样周期为10ns，则过滤脉冲最小为10ns，最大为150ns。

8.2.2.1. LDO1x 默认状态¶

362:

    • 364:

    • 365:

8.2.2.3. PSEN¶

442:

PSEN (Process Sensor，工艺传感器)，用于监测制造工艺下数字电路的频率范围，典型应用如下：

443:
    444:

  • CP测试阶段，根据PSEN进行分BIN操作，典型如分CPU 1GHz和800MHz两种DIE；

    • 445:

  • 方案应用阶段，根据PSEN来进行调频调压，达到降低功耗的目的

    • 446:
447:

PSEN工作流程如下，参考 图 8.5：

448:
    449:

  1. 软件配置好测试参数(RO_SEL, CNT_TIME),打开测试(PSEN_EN=1)

    2. 450:

  2. PSEN_EN=1触发数字电路打开RO_EN，模拟电路RO开始振荡工作起来，并进行16分频得到低频时钟，用于数字电路计数

    3. 451:

  3. 数字电路打开RO_EN后延迟打开CNT_EN，CNT开始计数，CNT_TIME时间后,自动关闭CNT_EN,并延时关闭RO_EN，将PSEN_EN清零表示测试完成

    4. 452:

  4. 软件检测到PSEN_EN清零后，读取CNT_VAL值为当前PSEN的速度；

    5. 453:

  5. 软件重复①~④测试更多的RO#.

    6. 454:

8.2.2.4. FLASH_CFG¶

462:

芯片内部合封了FLASH，对合封的FLASH进行烧写和读写访问，通过FLASH_CFG子模块实现。

463:

FLASH_CFG如 图 8.6 ，包含了SRCSEL和PINMAP两个模块。

464:

SRCSEL用于选择控制来源，有以下三种控制源：

465:
    466:

  • SPI0

    • 467:

  • SPI1

    • 468:

  • PINMUX：主要用于进行FLASH裸片烧录

    • 469:
470:

PINMAP用于对引脚进行映射，兼容各种FLASH DIE的出PIN，分为两组，每组3个引脚：

471:
    472:

  • PINMAP_012: WP MISO CS -> PIN0 PIN1 PIN2

    • 473:

  • PINMAP_345: HOLD SCLK MOSI -> PIN3 PIN4 PIN5

54: #define UART_CLK_MOD_BUS_EN      (1 << 12)
55: #define UART_CLK_MOD_CLK_EN      (1 << 8)

59: #define EFUSE_CMU_REG       (D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x904)
60: #define EFUSE_218_REG       (D13X_SID_BASE + 0x218)

66: #define WDOG_IRQ_EN         (D13X_WDT_BASE + 0x008)

70: 
71: #define XSPI_CTL            (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x000)
72: #define XSPI_CLK            (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x004)
73: #define XSPI_TCR            (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x008)
74: #define XSPI_STAS           (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x00C)
75: #define XSPI_FCR            (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x028)
76: #define XSPI_START          (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x030)
77: #define XSPI_ADDR           (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x034)
78: #define XSPI_LCKCR          (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x054)
79: #define XSPI_LUT_UP         (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x058)
80: #define XSPI_CS0_DCTL       (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x014)
81: #define XSPI_CS1_DCTL       (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x01C)
82: #define XSPI_CS0_IOCFG1     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x070)
83: #define XSPI_CS0_IOCFG2     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x074)
84: #define XSPI_CS0_IOCFG3     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x078)
85: #define XSPI_CS0_IOCFG4     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x07C)
86: #define XSPI_CS1_IOCFG1     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x080)
87: #define XSPI_CS1_IOCFG2     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x084)
88: #define XSPI_CS1_IOCFG3     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x088)
89: #define XSPI_CS1_IOCFG4     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x08C)
90: #define XSPI_TDR            (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x200)
91: #define XSPI_RDR            (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x300)

95: 
96: #define CTL_XSPI_EN         (1 << 0)
97: #define CTL_XIP_EN          (1 << 2)
98: #define CTL_AXI_BURST       (1 << 3)
99: #define CTL_XSPI_MODE_SHIFT 4
100: #define CTL_XSPI_MODE_MASK  (0x3 << CTL_XSPI_MODE_SHIFT)
101: #define CTL_PARALLEL_MODE   (1 << 6)
102: #define CTL_TIMEOUT_EN      (1 << 7)
103: #define CTL_BOUNDARY_EN     (1 << 12)
104: #define CTL_BOUNDARY_CTL    (1 << 13)

107: 
108: #define XSPI_MODE_XCCELA    0
109: #define XSPI_MODE_HYPERBUS  1
110: #define XSPI_MODE_OPI       2
111: #define XSPI_MODE_SPI       3

114: 
115: #define STAS_BUSY            (1 << 0)
116: 
117: /* XSPI_FCR 位域 */
118: 
119: #define FCR_RF_RST           (1 << 15)
120: #define FCR_TF_RST           (1 << 31)

122: /* LUT 指令 (来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_v1.0.h) */
123: 
124: #define LUT_STOP             0x0
125: #define LUT_CMD              0x1
126: #define LUT_CMD_EX           0x2
127: #define LUT_ADDR             0x3
128: #define LUT_WRITE            0x4
129: #define LUT_READ             0x5
130: #define LUT_CMD_DDR          0x11
131: #define LUT_ADDR_DDR         0x13
132: #define LUT_WRITE_DDR        0x14
133: #define LUT_READ_DDR         0x15
134: #define LUT_DUMMY            0x10

136: /* LUT IO 模式 */
137: 
138: #define LUT_IO_1             0x0
139: #define LUT_IO_2             0x1
140: #define LUT_IO_4             0x2
141: #define LUT_IO_8             0x3
142: 
143: /* LUT 锁定 */
144: 
145: #define LUT_LOCK             0x1
146: #define LUT_UNLOCK           0x2
147: 
148: /* LUT 条目编码宏 */
149: 
150: #define LUT_ENTRY(ins_h, io_h, op_h, ins_l, io_l, op_l) \
151:   (((ins_h) << 26) | ((io_h) << 24) | ((op_h) << 16) | \
152:    ((ins_l) << 10) | ((io_l) << 8) | (op_l))

163:  * Private Functions
164:  ****************************************************************************/

166: static inline void xspi_wait_idle(void)
167: {
168:   while (getreg32(XSPI_STAS) & STAS_BUSY);
169: }
170: 
171: static void d13x_clock_init(void)
172: {
173:   uint32_t reg;
174: 
175:   /* 1. 打开 24MHz 振荡器 */
176: 
177:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_IN);
178:   reg |= (1 << 1);
179:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_IN);
180: 
181:   /* 2. PLL 公共电路 LDO */
182: 
183:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_COM);
184:   reg |= (1 << 31) | (1 << 0);
185:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_COM);
186: 
187:   /* 3. 使能 PLL_INT1 → 1.2GHz (N=49) */
188: 
189:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN);
190:   reg |= PLL_GEN_ENABLE;
191:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN);
192:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN) & PLL_GEN_LOCK_BIT));
193: 
194:   /* 4. 使能 PLL_INT0 → 480MHz (N=19) */
195: 
196:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN);
197:   reg &= ~PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_MASK;
198:   reg |= (19 << PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_SHIFT);
199:   reg |= PLL_GEN_ENABLE;
200:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN);
201:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN) & PLL_GEN_LOCK_BIT));
202: 
203:   /* 5. AXI/AHB = 200MHz (PLL_INT1/(5+1)) */
204: 
205:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT1 | 5, CMU_CLK_AXI_AHB);
206: 
207:   /* 6. APB0 = 100MHz (PLL_INT1/(11+1)) */
208: 
209:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT1 | 11, CMU_CLK_APB0);
210: 
211:   /* 7. CPU = 480MHz (PLL_INT0/1) */
212: 
213:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT0 | 0, CMU_CLK_CPU);
214: 
215:   /* 8. GPIO 时钟 */
216: 
217:   reg = getreg32(CMU_CLK_GPIO);
218:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12);
219:   putreg32(reg, CMU_CLK_GPIO);
220: 
221:   /* 9. UART0 = 60MHz (PLL_INT1/(19+1)), 含 MOD_BUS_EN */
222: 
223:   putreg32(UART_CLK_MOD_RSTN | UART_CLK_MOD_BUS_EN | UART_CLK_MOD_CLK_EN | 19,
224:            CMU_CLK_UART0);
225: }
226: 
227: static void d13x_uart_init(void)
228: {
229:   uint32_t divisor;
230: 
231:   UART_WAIT_IDLE(D13X_UART0_BASE);
232:   putreg32(0, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
233:   putreg32(UART_LCR_DLAB, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
234:   divisor = D13X_UART0_FREQ / (16 * D13X_UART0_BAUDRATE);
235:   putreg32(divisor & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_RBR_THR_DLL);
236:   putreg32((divisor >> 8) & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
237:   putreg32(UART_FCR_FIFOE | UART_FCR_RFIFOR | UART_FCR_XFIFOR,
238:            D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_FCR_IIR);
239:   putreg32(0x03, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
240: }
241: 
242: /****************************************************************************
243:  * PSRAM 驱动 (LUT-based XSPI 控制器)
244:  * 来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_v1.0.h + hal_xspi.c + xspi_psram.c
245:  ****************************************************************************/
246: 
247: static uint32_t d13x_psram_read_efuse(uint32_t reg_addr)
248: {
249:   putreg32(0x1100, EFUSE_CMU_REG);
250:   uint32_t val = getreg32(reg_addr);
251:   putreg32(0x0, EFUSE_CMU_REG);
252:   return val;
253: }
254: 
255: static uint32_t d13x_psram_get_size(void)
256: {
257:   uint32_t fuse_218 = d13x_psram_read_efuse(EFUSE_218_REG);
258:   uint8_t mark_id = fuse_218 & 0xFF;
259: 
260:   switch (mark_id)
261:     {
262:       case 0x00: return 0;
263:       case 0x01: return 4 * 1024 * 1024;
264:       case 0x02: case 0x03: case 0x04: case 0x05:
265:       case 0xA1: case 0xA2:
266:         return 8 * 1024 * 1024;
267:       case 0x06: case 0x07:
268:         return 16 * 1024 * 1024;
269:       default: return 8 * 1024 * 1024;
270:     }
271: }
272: 
273: /* 通过 LUT 执行 PSRAM 命令 (同步 CPU 模式)
274:  * LUT 编码: 每个条目 32 位, 包含两阶段 (ins_h/io_h/op_h + ins_l/io_l/op_l)
275:  */
276: 
277: static void d13x_xspi_lut_write(int lut_id,
278:                                  int ins_l, int io_l, int op_l,
279:                                  int ins_h, int io_h, int op_h)
280: {
281:   uint32_t entry = LUT_ENTRY(ins_h, io_h, op_h, ins_l, io_l, op_l);
282:   putreg32(entry, XSPI_LUTN(lut_id));
283: }
284: 
285: static void d13x_xspi_lut_update(void)
286: {
287:   putreg32(1, XSPI_LUT_UP);
288: }
289: 
290: static void __attribute__((unused)) d13x_xspi_lut_lock(int lock)
291: {
292:   putreg32(lock ? LUT_LOCK : LUT_UNLOCK, XSPI_LCKCR);
293: }
294: 
295: static void d13x_xspi_trigger(int lut_id)
296: {
297:   xspi_wait_idle();
298:   putreg32(lut_id, XSPI_START);
299:   xspi_wait_idle();
300: }
301: 
302: /* 通过 LUT 执行 PSRAM 命令 */
303: 
304: static void d13x_psram_write_mr(uint8_t mr_addr, uint8_t mr_val)
305: {
306:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0xC0 (WRITE_MR) on 1-line */
307:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0xC0, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
308:   /* LUT[1]: ADDR 1-byte on 1-line */
309:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(1, LUT_ADDR, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
310:   /* LUT[2]: WRITE 1-byte on 1-line */
311:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(2, LUT_WRITE, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
312:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
313: 
314:   /* 设置地址 = MR 地址 */
315: 
316:   putreg32(mr_addr, XSPI_ADDR);
317: 
318:   /* 写入数据到 TDR */
319: 
320:   putreg32((uint32_t)mr_val, XSPI_TDR);
321: 
322:   /* 触发 LUT 序列: LUT[0] → LUT[1] → LUT[2] → STOP */
323: 
324:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
325: }
326: 
327: static void d13x_psram_read_mr(uint8_t mr_addr, uint8_t *mr_val)
328: {
329:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0x40 (READ_MR) on 1-line */
330:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0x40, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
331:   /* LUT[1]: ADDR 1-byte on 1-line */
332:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(1, LUT_ADDR, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
333:   /* LUT[2]: READ 1-byte on 1-line */
334:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(2, LUT_READ, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
335:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
336: 
337:   putreg32(mr_addr, XSPI_ADDR);
338:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
339: 
340:   *mr_val = (uint8_t)getreg32(XSPI_RDR);
341: }
342: 
343: static void d13x_psram_device_reset(void)
344: {
345:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0xFF (RESET) on 1-line */
346: 
347:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0xFF, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
348:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
349:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
350: }
351: 
352: static void d13x_psram_device_init(void)
353: {
354:   uint8_t mr4;
355: 
356:   /* 读取 MR4 检查当前配置 */
357: 
358:   d13x_psram_read_mr(0x04, &mr4);
359: 
360:   /* 配置 MR0: Burst Length = 32, Latency = 3 */
361: 
362:   d13x_psram_write_mr(0x00, 0x19);
363: 
364:   /* 配置 MR4: 使能 XIP */
365: 
366:   d13x_psram_write_mr(0x04, 0x80);
367: }
368: 
369: static void d13x_psram_xip_enable(void)
370: {
371:   uint32_t ctl;
372: 
373:   /* 配置 XIP LUT (OPI 模式下的 XIP 读/写序列)
374:    * LUT[16]: XIP READ (OPI 8-line, DDR)
375:    * LUT[0]:  XIP WRITE (OPI 8-line, DDR)
376:    * 这里使用简化配置: 启用 XIP 位, 由硬件处理 LUT 路由
377:    */
378: 
379:   /* 使能 XIP (CTL bit2) */
380: 
381:   xspi_wait_idle();
382:   ctl = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
383:   ctl |= CTL_XIP_EN;
384:   putreg32(ctl, XSPI_CTL);
385: }
386: 
387: static uint32_t d13x_psram_verify(void)
388: {
389:   volatile uint32_t *psram = (volatile uint32_t *)D13X_PSRAM_BASE;
390:   uint32_t psram_size = d13x_psram_get_size();
391: 
392:   if (psram_size == 0)
393:     return 0;
394: 
395:   psram[0] = 0x12345678;
396:   psram[1] = 0x9ABCDEF0;
397: 
398:   if (psram[0] != 0x12345678)
399:     return 0;
400:   if (psram[1] != 0x9ABCDEF0)
401:     return 0;
402: 
403:   psram[0] = 0;
404:   psram[1] = 0;
405:   return psram_size;
406: }
407: 
408: static void d13x_psram_init(void)
409: {
410:   uint32_t reg;
411: 
412:   /* 首先验证 PSRAM 是否已由 bootloader 初始化 */
413: 
414:   if (d13x_psram_verify() > 0)
415:     return;
416: 
417:   /* 1. 使能 XSPI 时钟 (CMU_BASE + 0x45C) */
418: 
419:   reg = getreg32(D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x45C);
420:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12) | (1 << 8);
421:   putreg32(reg, D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x45C);
422: 
423:   /* 2. 复位 XSPI 控制器 (写 0 到 CTL) */
424: 
425:   putreg32(0, XSPI_CTL);
426: 
427:   /* 3. 配置 XSPI 控制器 (来源: luban-lite hal_xspi_init) */
428: 
429:   /* 时钟分频: div=0 → 最高频率 */
430: 
431:   putreg32(0, XSPI_CLK);
432: 
433:   /* TCR: 写保持=8, 读保持=2 */
434: 
435:   xspi_wait_idle();
436:   putreg32((8 << 16) | (2 << 20), XSPI_TCR);
437: 
438:   /* XSPI 模式 = OPI (bits[5:4] = 2) */
439: 
440:   xspi_wait_idle();
441:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
442:   reg |= (XSPI_MODE_OPI << CTL_XSPI_MODE_SHIFT);
443:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
444: 
445:   /* 使能 wrap burst split */
446: 
447:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
448:   reg |= CTL_AXI_BURST;
449:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
450: 
451:   /* Boundary = 1K */
452: 
453:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
454:   reg |= CTL_BOUNDARY_EN | CTL_BOUNDARY_CTL;
455:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
456: 
457:   /* IO 驱动配置 */
458: 
459:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG1);
460:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG2);
461:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG3);
462:   putreg32(0x37, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG4);
463:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG1);
464:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG2);
465:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG3);
466:   putreg32(0x37, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG4);
467: 
468:   /* DLL 配置 (来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_set_dll_ctl) */
469: 
470:   /* CS0 DLL: ICP=150-200MHz, Phase=90度 */
471: 
472:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
473:   reg |= (2 << 12) | (3 << 8) | (1 << 4) | (1 << 5);  /* ICP_150_200M, phase_90b, LDO, LVS */
474:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
475: 
476:   /* 使能 DLL/VCDL/CP, 禁用 BYPASS */
477: 
478:   reg |= (1 << 0) | (1 << 1) | (1 << 2);  /* EN_DLL, EN_VCDL, EN_CP */
479:   reg &= ~(1 << 3);  /* EN_BYPASS = 0 */
480:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
481: 
482:   /* CS1 DLL: 同上 */
483: 
484:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
485:   reg |= (2 << 12) | (3 << 8) | (1 << 4) | (1 << 5);
486:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
487:   reg |= (1 << 0) | (1 << 1) | (1 << 2);
488:   reg &= ~(1 << 3);
489:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
490: 
491:   /* 4. 使能 XSPI 模块 */
492: 
493:   xspi_wait_idle();
494:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
495:   reg |= CTL_XSPI_EN;
496:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
497: 
498:   /* 5. 复位 PSRAM 设备 */
499: 
500:   d13x_psram_device_reset();
501: 
502:   /* 6. 配置 PSRAM 模式寄存器 */
503: 
504:   d13x_psram_device_init();
505: 
506:   /* 7. 使能 XIP 模式 */
507: 
508:   d13x_psram_xip_enable();
509: 
510:   /* 8. 验证 */
511: 
512:   d13x_psram_verify();
513: }

521:   putreg32(0, WDOG_CTL);

44:   UART_WAIT_IDLE(D13X_UART0_BASE);

46:   /* 禁用中断 */
47: 
48:   putreg32(0, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
49:

51: 
52:   putreg32(UART_LCR_DLAB, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
53: 
54:   /* 写入波特率除数 */
55: 
56:   putreg32(divisor & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_RBR_THR_DLL);
57:   putreg32((divisor >> 8) & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
58: 
59:   /* 使能 FIFO, 清除 DLAB, 设置 8N1 */
60: 
61:   putreg32(UART_FCR_FIFOE | UART_FCR_RFIFOR | UART_FCR_XFIFOR,
62:            D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_FCR_IIR);
63:   putreg32(0x03, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);

173:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_ENABLE, reg);

188:     {

199:  * Name: d13x_i2c_set_speed

201:  * Description:
202:  *   设置 I2C SCL 时序 (Fast Mode 400KHz)
203:  *
204:  ****************************************************************************/
205: 
206: static void d13x_i2c_set_speed(uint32_t base, uint32_t pclk)
207: {
208:   uint32_t reg;
209:   uint32_t hcnt;
210:   uint32_t lcnt;
211: 
212:   /* Fast Mode: HCNT = pclk/freq - 1, LCNT = pclk/freq */
213: 
214:   hcnt = pclk / 400000 - 1;
215:   lcnt = pclk / 400000;
216: 
217:   /* Clamp 到最小值 (来源: hal_i2c.h + 历史经验) */
218: 
219:   if (hcnt < FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH)
220:     {
221:       hcnt = FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH;
222:     }
223: 
224:   if (lcnt < FS_MIN_SCL_LOW)
225:     {
226:       lcnt = FS_MIN_SCL_LOW;
227:     }
228: 
229:   /* 设置 Fast Mode 速度 */
230: 
231:   reg = i2c_getreg(base, I2C_CTL);
232:   reg &= ~I2C_CTL_SPEED_MASK;
233:   reg |= I2C_CTL_SPEED_FS;
234:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_CTL, reg);
235: 
236:   /* 写入 HCNT/LCNT */
237: 
238:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT, hcnt);
239:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT, lcnt);
240: 
241:   /* RX FIFO threshold = FIFO_DEPTH/2 */
242: 
243:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_RX_TL, I2C_FIFO_DEPTH / 2 - 1);
244: }

246: /****************************************************************************
247:  * Name: d13x_i2c_transfer_one
248:  *
249:  * Description:
250:  *   执行单条 I2C 消息传输
251:  *
252:  ****************************************************************************/
253: 
254: static int d13x_i2c_transfer_one(struct d13x_i2c_dev_s *priv,
255:                                   FAR struct i2c_msg_s *msg)
256: {
257:   uint32_t base = priv->base;
258:   int remaining;
259:   int ret = OK;
260:   uint32_t timeout;
261:   uint32_t reg_val;
262: 
263:   /* 等待总线空闲 */
264: 
265:   ret = i2c_wait_bus_idle(base, I2C_TIMEOUT_MS);
266:   if (ret < 0)
267:     {
268:       return ret;
269:     }
270: 
271:   /* 禁用模块 → 设置目标地址 → 重新使能 */
272: 
273:   i2c_module_disable(base);
274: 
275:   reg_val = i2c_getreg(base, I2C_TAR);
276:   reg_val &= ~0x3ff;
277:   reg_val |= (msg->addr & 0x3ff);
278:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_TAR, reg_val);
279: 
280:   /* 确保 master 模式 + restart enable */
281: 
282:   reg_val = i2c_getreg(base, I2C_CTL);
283:   reg_val |= I2C_CTL_MASTER | I2C_CTL_RESTART_EN;
284:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_CTL, reg_val);
285: 
286:   /* 清除所有中断 */
287: 
288:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xffff);
289: 
290:   i2c_module_enable(base);
291: 
292:   if (msg->flags & I2C_M_READ)
293:     {
294:       /* === 读操作 === */
295: 
296:       remaining = msg->length;
297: 
298:       while (remaining > 0)
299:         {
300:           int burst = remaining > I2C_FIFO_DEPTH ?
301:                       I2C_FIFO_DEPTH : remaining;
302:           int i;
303: 
304:           /* 发送读命令 */
305: 
306:           for (i = 0; i < burst - 1; i++)
307:             {
308:               i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD, I2C_DATA_CMD_READ);
309:             }
310: 
311:           /* 最后一个字节带 STOP */
312: 
313:           if (remaining <= I2C_FIFO_DEPTH)
314:             {
315:               i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD,
316:                          I2C_DATA_CMD_READ | I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP);
317:             }
318:           else
319:             {
320:               i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD, I2C_DATA_CMD_READ);
321:             }
322: 
323:           /* 等待数据到达 */
324: 
325:           timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_MS;
326:           while (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_RXFLR) < burst)
327:             {
328:               if (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)
329:                 {
330:                   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xffff);
331:                   return -EIO;
332:                 }
333: 
334:               if (--timeout == 0)
335:                 {
336:                   return -ETIMEDOUT;
337:                 }
338: 
339:               up_udelay(100);
340:             }
341: 
342:           /* 读取数据 */
343: 
344:           for (i = 0; i < burst; i++)
345:             {
346:               *msg->buffer++ = (uint8_t)(i2c_getreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD) & 0xff);
347:             }
348: 
349:           remaining -= burst;
350:         }
351: 
352:       /* 等待 STOP */
353: 
354:       timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_MS;
355:       while (!(i2c_getreg(base, I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & I2C_INTR_STOP_DET))
356:         {
357:           if (--timeout == 0)
358:             {
359:               return -ETIMEDOUT;
360:             }
361: 
362:           up_udelay(100);
363:         }
364:     }
365:   else
366:     {
367:       /* === 写操作 === */
368: 
369:       remaining = msg->length;
370: 
371:       while (remaining > 0)
372:         {
373:           int burst = remaining > I2C_FIFO_DEPTH ?
374:                       I2C_FIFO_DEPTH : remaining;
375:           int i;
376: 
377:           for (i = 0; i < burst - 1; i++)
378:             {
379:               /* 等待 TX FIFO 有空间 */
380: 
381:               timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_MS;
382:               while (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_TXFLR) >= I2C_FIFO_DEPTH)
383:                 {
384:                   if (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)
385:                     {
386:                       i2c_putreg(base, I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xffff);
387:                       return -EIO;
388:                     }
389: 
390:                   if (--timeout == 0)
391:                     {
392:                       return -ETIMEDOUT;
393:                     }
394: 
395:                   up_udelay(100);
396:                 }
397: 
398:               i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD, *msg->buffer++);
399:             }
400: 
401:           /* 最后一个字节带 STOP */
402: 
403:           timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_MS;
404:           while (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_TXFLR) >= I2C_FIFO_DEPTH)
405:             {
406:               if (--timeout == 0)
407:                 {
408:                   return -ETIMEDOUT;
409:                 }
410: 
411:               up_udelay(100);
412:             }
413: 
414:           i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD,
415:                      I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP | (*msg->buffer++));
416: 
417:           remaining -= burst;
418:         }
419: 
420:       /* 等待 STOP */
421: 
422:       timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_MS;
423:       while (!(i2c_getreg(base, I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & I2C_INTR_STOP_DET))
424:         {
425:           if (--timeout == 0)
426:             {
427:               return -ETIMEDOUT;
428:             }
429: 
430:           up_udelay(100);
431:         }
432:     }
433: 
434:   /* 清除中断 */
435: 
436:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xffff);
437: 
438:   return msg->length;
439: }

24: /****************************************************************************
25:  * Pre-processor Definitions
26:  ****************************************************************************/
27: 
28: /* DesignWare I2C 寄存器偏移 (来源: hal_i2c.h) */
29: 
30: #define I2C_CTL              0x00
31: #define I2C_TAR              0x04
32: #define I2C_SAR              0x08
33: #define I2C_DATA_CMD         0x10
34: #define I2C_SS_SCL_HCNT      0x20
35: #define I2C_SS_SCL_LCNT      0x24
36: #define I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT      0x28
37: #define I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT      0x2C
38: #define I2C_SDA_HOLD         0x30
39: #define I2C_INTR_MASK        0x38
40: #define I2C_INTR_CLR         0x3C
41: #define I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT    0x40
42: #define I2C_ENABLE           0x48
43: #define I2C_ENABLE_STATUS    0x4C
44: #define I2C_STATUS           0x50
45: #define I2C_TX_ABRT_SOURCE   0x54
46: #define I2C_RX_TL            0x90
47: #define I2C_TX_TL            0x94
48: #define I2C_TXFLR            0x98
49: #define I2C_RXFLR            0x9C
50: 
51: /* CTL 寄存器位定义 */
52: 
53: #define I2C_CTL_MASTER               (1 << 0)
54: #define I2C_CTL_SPEED_SS             (0x1 << 4)
55: #define I2C_CTL_SPEED_FS             (0x2 << 4)
56: #define I2C_CTL_SPEED_MASK           (3 << 4)
57: #define I2C_CTL_RESTART_EN           (1 << 6)
58: 
59: /* DATA_CMD 寄存器位定义 */
60: 
61: #define I2C_DATA_CMD_READ            (1 << 8)
62: #define I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP            (1 << 9)
63: #define I2C_DATA_CMD_RESTART         (1 << 10)
64: 
65: /* 中断位定义 */
66: 
67: #define I2C_INTR_RX_FULL             (1 << 2)
68: #define I2C_INTR_TX_EMPTY            (1 << 4)
69: #define I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT             (1 << 6)
70: #define I2C_INTR_STOP_DET            (1 << 9)
71: #define I2C_INTR_MASTER_TX_MASK      \
72:     (I2C_INTR_TX_EMPTY | I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT | I2C_INTR_STOP_DET)
73: #define I2C_INTR_MASTER_RX_MASK      \
74:     (I2C_INTR_RX_FULL | I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT | I2C_INTR_STOP_DET)
75: 
76: /* 使能/禁用 */
77: 
78: #define I2C_ENABLE_BIT               (1 << 0)
79: 
80: /* 状态 */
81: 
82: #define I2C_STATUS_BUSY              (1 << 0)
83: 
84: /* FIFO 深度 */
85: 
86: #define I2C_FIFO_DEPTH               8
87: 
88: /* Fast Mode 最小 SCL 时序 (来源: hal_i2c.h) */
89: 
90: #define FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH              600
91: #define FS_MIN_SCL_LOW               1300
92: 
93: /* 超时 (ms) */
94: 
95: #define I2C_TIMEOUT_MS               1000
96:

99:  ****************************************************************************/

101: struct d13x_i2c_dev_s
102: {
103:   struct i2c_master_s  dev;       /* NuttX I2C upper-half */
104:   uint32_t             base;      /* 寄存器基地址 */
105:   uint32_t             freq;      /* 当前 SCL 频率 */
106:   uint8_t              irq;       /* 中断号 */
107: };

111:  ****************************************************************************/

113: static int  d13x_i2c_transfer(FAR struct i2c_master_s *dev,
114:                                FAR struct i2c_msg_s *msgs, int count);
115: static int  d13x_i2c_setup(FAR struct i2c_master_s *dev);

123: {

125:   .setup     = d13x_i2c_setup,
126:   .shutdown  = d13x_i2c_shutdown,
127: };

129: /* 三个 I2C 实例 */
130: 
131: static struct d13x_i2c_dev_s g_d13x_i2c0 =
132: {
133:   .dev  = { &g_d13x_i2c_ops },
134:   .base = D13X_I2C0_BASE,
135:   .freq = 400000,
136:   .irq  = 84,
137: };
138: 
139: static struct d13x_i2c_dev_s g_d13x_i2c1 =
140: {

142:   .base = D13X_I2C1_BASE,
143:   .freq = 400000,
144:   .irq  = 85,
145: };
146: 
147: static struct d13x_i2c_dev_s g_d13x_i2c2 =
148: {
149:   .dev  = { &g_d13x_i2c_ops },
150:   .base = D13X_I2C2_BASE,
151:   .freq = 400000,
152:   .irq  = 86,

155: /****************************************************************************
156:  * Private Functions
157:  ****************************************************************************/
158: 
159: static inline void i2c_putreg(uint32_t base, uint32_t offset, uint32_t val)
160: {
161:   putreg32(val, base + offset);
162: }
163: 
164: static inline uint32_t i2c_getreg(uint32_t base, uint32_t offset)
165: {
166:   return getreg32(base + offset);
167: }
168: 
169: static inline void i2c_module_enable(uint32_t base)
170: {
171:   uint32_t reg = i2c_getreg(base, I2C_ENABLE);
172:   reg |= I2C_ENABLE_BIT;
173:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_ENABLE, reg);
174: }
175: 
176: static inline void i2c_module_disable(uint32_t base)
177: {
178:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xffff);
179:   uint32_t reg = i2c_getreg(base, I2C_ENABLE);
180:   reg &= ~I2C_ENABLE_BIT;
181:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_ENABLE, reg);
182: }
183: 
184: static inline int i2c_wait_bus_idle(uint32_t base, uint32_t timeout_ms)
185: {
186:   uint32_t elapsed = 0;
187:   while (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_ENABLE_STATUS) & I2C_ENABLE_BIT)
188:     {
189:       if (elapsed++ >= timeout_ms * 1000)
190:         {
191:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
192:         }
193:       up_udelay(1);
194:     }
195:   return OK;
196: }
197: 
198: /****************************************************************************
199:  * Name: d13x_i2c_set_speed
200:  *
201:  * Description:
202:  *   设置 I2C SCL 时序 (Fast Mode 400KHz)
203:  *
204:  ****************************************************************************/
205: 
206: static void d13x_i2c_set_speed(uint32_t base, uint32_t pclk)
207: {
208:   uint32_t reg;
209:   uint32_t hcnt;
210:   uint32_t lcnt;
211: 
212:   /* Fast Mode: HCNT = pclk/freq - 1, LCNT = pclk/freq */
213: 
214:   hcnt = pclk / 400000 - 1;
215:   lcnt = pclk / 400000;
216: 
217:   /* Clamp 到最小值 (来源: hal_i2c.h + 历史经验) */
218: 
219:   if (hcnt < FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH)
220:     {
221:       hcnt = FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH;
222:     }
223: 
224:   if (lcnt < FS_MIN_SCL_LOW)
225:     {
226:       lcnt = FS_MIN_SCL_LOW;
227:     }
228: 
229:   /* 设置 Fast Mode 速度 */
230: 
231:   reg = i2c_getreg(base, I2C_CTL);
232:   reg &= ~I2C_CTL_SPEED_MASK;
233:   reg |= I2C_CTL_SPEED_FS;
234:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_CTL, reg);
235: 
236:   /* 写入 HCNT/LCNT */
237: 
238:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT, hcnt);
239:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT, lcnt);
240: 
241:   /* RX FIFO threshold = FIFO_DEPTH/2 */
242: 
243:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_RX_TL, I2C_FIFO_DEPTH / 2 - 1);
244: }
245: 
246: /****************************************************************************
247:  * Name: d13x_i2c_transfer_one
248:  *
249:  * Description:
250:  *   执行单条 I2C 消息传输
251:  *
252:  ****************************************************************************/
253: 
254: static int d13x_i2c_transfer_one(struct d13x_i2c_dev_s *priv,
255:                                   FAR struct i2c_msg_s *msg)
256: {
257:   uint32_t base = priv->base;
258:   int remaining;
259:   int ret = OK;
260:   uint32_t timeout;
261:   uint32_t reg_val;
262: 
263:   /* 等待总线空闲 */
264: 
265:   ret = i2c_wait_bus_idle(base, I2C_TIMEOUT_MS);
266:   if (ret < 0)
267:     {
268:       return ret;
269:     }
270: 
271:   /* 禁用模块 → 设置目标地址 → 重新使能 */
272: 
273:   i2c_module_disable(base);
274: 
275:   reg_val = i2c_getreg(base, I2C_TAR);
276:   reg_val &= ~0x3ff;
277:   reg_val |= (msg->addr & 0x3ff);
278:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_TAR, reg_val);
279: 
280:   /* 确保 master 模式 + restart enable */
281: 
282:   reg_val = i2c_getreg(base, I2C_CTL);
283:   reg_val |= I2C_CTL_MASTER | I2C_CTL_RESTART_EN;
284:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_CTL, reg_val);
285: 
286:   /* 清除所有中断 */
287: 
288:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xffff);
289: 
290:   i2c_module_enable(base);
291: 
292:   if (msg->flags & I2C_M_READ)
293:     {
294:       /* === 读操作 === */
295: 
296:       remaining = msg->length;
297: 
298:       while (remaining > 0)
299:         {
300:           int burst = remaining > I2C_FIFO_DEPTH ?
301:                       I2C_FIFO_DEPTH : remaining;
302:           int i;
303: 
304:           /* 发送读命令 */
305: 
306:           for (i = 0; i < burst - 1; i++)
307:             {
308:               i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD, I2C_DATA_CMD_READ);
309:             }
310: 
311:           /* 最后一个字节带 STOP */
312: 
313:           if (remaining <= I2C_FIFO_DEPTH)
314:             {
315:               i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD,
316:                          I2C_DATA_CMD_READ | I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP);
317:             }
318:           else
319:             {
320:               i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD, I2C_DATA_CMD_READ);
321:             }
322: 
323:           /* 等待数据到达 */
324: 
325:           timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_MS;
326:           while (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_RXFLR) < burst)
327:             {
328:               if (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)
329:                 {
330:                   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xffff);
331:                   return -EIO;
332:                 }
333: 
334:               if (--timeout == 0)
335:                 {
336:                   return -ETIMEDOUT;
337:                 }
338: 
339:               up_udelay(100);
340:             }
341: 
342:           /* 读取数据 */
343: 
344:           for (i = 0; i < burst; i++)
345:             {
346:               *msg->buffer++ = (uint8_t)(i2c_getreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD) & 0xff);
347:             }
348: 
349:           remaining -= burst;
350:         }
351: 
352:       /* 等待 STOP */
353: 
354:       timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_MS;
355:       while (!(i2c_getreg(base, I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & I2C_INTR_STOP_DET))
356:         {
357:           if (--timeout == 0)
358:             {
359:               return -ETIMEDOUT;
360:             }
361: 
362:           up_udelay(100);
363:         }
364:     }
365:   else
366:     {
367:       /* === 写操作 === */
368: 
369:       remaining = msg->length;
370: 
371:       while (remaining > 0)
372:         {
373:           int burst = remaining > I2C_FIFO_DEPTH ?
374:                       I2C_FIFO_DEPTH : remaining;
375:           int i;
376: 
377:           for (i = 0; i < burst - 1; i++)
378:             {
379:               /* 等待 TX FIFO 有空间 */
380: 
381:               timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_MS;
382:               while (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_TXFLR) >= I2C_FIFO_DEPTH)
383:                 {
384:                   if (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)
385:                     {
386:                       i2c_putreg(base, I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xffff);
387:                       return -EIO;
388:                     }
389: 
390:                   if (--timeout == 0)
391:                     {
392:                       return -ETIMEDOUT;
393:                     }
394: 
395:                   up_udelay(100);
396:                 }
397: 
398:               i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD, *msg->buffer++);
399:             }
400: 
401:           /* 最后一个字节带 STOP */
402: 
403:           timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_MS;
404:           while (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_TXFLR) >= I2C_FIFO_DEPTH)
405:             {
406:               if (--timeout == 0)
407:                 {
408:                   return -ETIMEDOUT;
409:                 }
410: 
411:               up_udelay(100);
412:             }
413: 
414:           i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD,
415:                      I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP | (*msg->buffer++));
416: 
417:           remaining -= burst;
418:         }
419: 
420:       /* 等待 STOP */
421: 
422:       timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_MS;
423:       while (!(i2c_getreg(base, I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & I2C_INTR_STOP_DET))
424:         {
425:           if (--timeout == 0)
426:             {
427:               return -ETIMEDOUT;
428:             }
429: 
430:           up_udelay(100);
431:         }
432:     }
433: 
434:   /* 清除中断 */
435: 
436:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xffff);
437: 
438:   return msg->length;
439: }
440: 
441: /****************************************************************************
442:  * Name: d13x_i2c_transfer
443:  ****************************************************************************/
444: 
445: static int d13x_i2c_transfer(FAR struct i2c_master_s *dev,
446:                               FAR struct i2c_msg_s *msgs, int count)
447: {
448:   FAR struct d13x_i2c_dev_s *priv = (FAR struct d13x_i2c_dev_s *)dev;
449:   int i;
450:   int ret;
451: 
452:   DEBUGASSERT(dev);
453:   DEBUGASSERT(msgs);
454:   DEBUGASSERT(count > 0);
455: 
456:   for (i = 0; i < count; i++)
457:     {
458:       ret = d13x_i2c_transfer_one(priv, &msgs[i]);
459:       if (ret < 0)
460:         {
461:           return ret;
462:         }
463:     }
464: 
465:   return OK;
466: }

468: /****************************************************************************
469:  * Name: d13x_i2c_setup
470:  ****************************************************************************/
471: 
472: static int d13x_i2c_setup(FAR struct i2c_master_s *dev)
473: {
474:   FAR struct d13x_i2c_dev_s *priv = (FAR struct d13x_i2c_dev_s *)dev;
475:   uint32_t reg;
476: 
477:   DEBUGASSERT(dev);
478: 
479:   /* 确保模块禁用 */
480: 
481:   i2c_module_disable(priv->base);
482: 
483:   /* 设置 master 模式 */
484: 
485:   reg = i2c_getreg(priv->base, I2C_CTL);
486:   reg |= I2C_CTL_MASTER | I2C_CTL_RESTART_EN;
487:   i2c_putreg(priv->base, I2C_CTL, reg);
488: 
489:   /* 设置 SCL 时序 (APB0 = 100MHz) */
490: 
491:   d13x_i2c_set_speed(priv->base, D13X_APB0_FREQ);
492: 
493:   return OK;
494: }
495: 
496: /****************************************************************************
497:  * Name: d13x_i2c_shutdown
498:  ****************************************************************************/
499: 
500: static int d13x_i2c_shutdown(FAR struct i2c_master_s *dev)
501: {
502:   FAR struct d13x_i2c_dev_s *priv = (FAR struct d13x_i2c_dev_s *)dev;
503: 
504:   DEBUGASSERT(dev);
505: 
506:   i2c_module_disable(priv->base);
507: 
508:   return OK;
509: }
510: 
511: /****************************************************************************
512:  * Public Functions
513:  ****************************************************************************/
514: 
515: /****************************************************************************
516:  * Name: d13x_i2c_initialize
517:  *
518:  * Description:
519:  *   初始化指定的 I2C 总线并返回 i2c_master_s 句柄
520:  *
521:  * Input Parameters:
522:  *   bus - I2C 总线编号 (0, 1, 2)
523:  *
524:  * Returned Value:
525:  *   成功返回 i2c_master_s 指针，失败返回 NULL
526:  *
527:  ****************************************************************************/
528: 
529: FAR struct i2c_master_s *d13x_i2c_initialize(int bus)
530: {
531:   FAR struct d13x_i2c_dev_s *priv;
532: 
533:   switch (bus)
534:     {
535:       case 0:
536:         priv = &g_d13x_i2c0;
537:         break;
538:       case 1:
539:         priv = &g_d13x_i2c1;
540:         break;
541:       case 2:
542:         priv = &g_d13x_i2c2;
543:         break;
544:       default:
545:         ierr("Invalid I2C bus: %d\n", bus);
546:         return NULL;
547:     }
548: 
549:   /* 执行 setup */
550: 
551:   d13x_i2c_setup(&priv->dev);
552: 
553:   iinfo("I2C%d initialized at 0x%08" PRIx32 "\n", bus, priv->base);
554: 
555:   return &priv->dev;
556: }
