1: # 适配 I2C Master 驱动
2: 
3: [ [English](../../../../../en/device_dev_guide/driver/bus_driver/I2C/i2c_master_guide.md) | 简体中文 ]
4: 
5: 本文档介绍如何为 openvela 适配一个标准的 I2C Master 驱动，使其能够作为总线主设备工作。
6: 
7: ## 一、驱动框架层级
8: 
9: I2C Master 驱动的开发涉及驱动层、板级层和应用层，它们之间的协作关系如下：
10: 
11: ### 驱动层 (Driver)
12: 
13: 负责实现芯片相关的 I2C 底层硬件操作。此层需要封装硬件细节，并向上层提供一个标准化的 `i2c_master_s` 句柄。
14: 
15: ```C
16: /* 1. 定义底层操作函数集 */
17: static const struct i2c_ops_s bl602_i2c_ops =
18: {
19:     .transfer = bl602_i2c_transfer,
20: #ifdef CONFIG_I2C_RESET
21:     .reset = bl602_i2c_reset
22: #endif
23: };
24: 
25: /* 2. 定义私有数据结构，包含操作函数集和配置信息 */
26: static struct bl602_i2c_priv_s bl602_i2c0_priv =
27: {
28:     .ops      = &bl602_i2c_ops,
29:     .config   = &bl602_i2c0_config,
30: };
31: 
32: /* 3. 实现初始化函数，返回标准的 I2C Master 句柄 */
33: struct i2c_master_s *bl602_i2cbus_initialize(int port)
34: {
35:     priv = (struct bl602_i2c_priv_s *)&bl602_i2c0_priv;
36:     
37:     return (struct i2c_master_s *)priv;
38: }
39: ```
40: 
41: ### 板级层 (Board)
42: 
43: 在系统启动阶段，调用驱动层的初始化函数获取 I2C 总线句柄。根据需求，可以选择性地将该总线注册为字符设备（如 `/dev/i2c-0`），或直接传递给其他内核驱动（如传感器驱动）使用。
44: 
45: ```C
46: /* 获取 I2C 总线句柄 */
47: i2c_bus = bl602_i2cbus_initialize(0);
48: 
49: /* 将总线注册为 /dev/i2c0 */
50: i2c_register(i2c_bus, 0);
51: ```
52: 
53: ### 应用层 (Application)
54: 
55: 通过标准的 POSIX 文件接口（`open`, `ioctl` 等）访问已注册的 `/dev/i2c-N` 设备节点，从而与挂载在总线上的 I2C 从设备通信。
56: 
57: ```C
58: fd = open("/dev/i2c", O_RDWR);
59: ioctl(fd, );
60: ...
61: ```
62: 
63: ## 二、适配南向接口 (Lower Half)
64: 
65: 南向接口适配的核心任务是实现芯片的底层驱动，并提供一个标准的初始化函数 `xxx_i2cbus_initialize()`，其中 `xxx` 代表芯片（Chip）名称。
66: 
67: ### 1、Kconfig 配置选项
68: 
69: 请在 Kconfig 中启用以下配置项以支持 I2C Master 驱动：
70: 
71: ```Makefile
72: CONFIG_I2C=y          # 必需，启用 I2C 子系统
73: CONFIG_I2C_DRIVER=y   # 必需，启用 I2C 字符设备驱动上层
74: CONFIG_I2C_RESET=y    # 可选，如果需要支持总线复位功能
75: ```
76: 
77: ### 2、核心数据结构
78: 
79: openvela I2C Master 驱动围绕 `struct i2c_master_s` 和 `struct i2c_ops_s` 这两个核心结构进行抽象。
80: 
81: ```C
82: /*
83:  * I2C Master 操作函数集。
84:  * 驱动开发者需要实现其中的函数指针，特别是 transfer 函数。
85:  */
86: struct i2c_ops_s
87: {
88:   /* 核心传输函数，必需 */
89:   CODE int (*transfer)(FAR struct i2c_master_s *dev,
90:                        FAR struct i2c_msg_s *msgs, int count);
91: #ifdef CONFIG_I2C_RESET
92:   /* 可选的总线复位函数 */
93:   CODE int (*reset)(FAR struct i2c_master_s *dev);
94: #endif
95: };
96: 
97: /*
98:  * I2C Master 设备句柄。
99:  * 这是南向驱动向上层提供的标准接口。
100:  * 开发者通常会定义一个包含此结构的私有设备结构体。
101:  */
102: struct i2c_master_s
103: {
104:   FAR const struct i2c_ops_s *ops; /* 指向操作函数集的指针 */
105: };
106: ```
107: 
108: ### 3、驱动入口函数说明
109: 
110: 您需要根据下表的要求，在芯片驱动文件（`xxx_i2c.c`）中实现 `xxx_i2cbus_initialize()` 函数。
111: 
112: | **项目**     | **描述**                                                                                                                                                             |
113: | :----------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
114: | **函数原型** | `struct i2c_master_s *xxx_i2cbus_initialize(int port)`                                                                                                               |
115: | **参数**     | `port`：I2C 总线端口号。如果芯片支持多路 I2C，您需要根据此参数进行多路配置。                                                                                         |
116: | **返回值**   | 返回一个标准的 `i2c_master_s` 操作句柄。如果初始化失败，则返回 `NULL`。                                                                                              |
117: | **实现内容** | 初始化 I2C 控制器所需的时钟和 GPIO。如果使用中断模式，还需配置并使能中断。填充并返回一个包含 `transfer` 函数指针的 `i2c_master_s` 句柄，用于处理上层的数据传输请求。 |
118: | **文件位置** | chip 路径下的 `xxx_i2c.c`，`xxx` 为 chip 名称。                                                                                                                      |
119: | **调用位置** | board 路径下的 `xxx_bringup.c` 里调用，`xxx` 为 `board` 名字。                                                                                                       |
120: 
121: ### 4、适配实现步骤
122: 
123: 本节通过代码示例，展示如何分步完成 I2C Master 驱动的适配。
124: 
125: - **参考实现**：[bl602_i2c.c](https://github.com/apache/nuttx/blob/master/arch/risc-v/src/bl602/bl602_i2c.c)
126: 
127: #### 步骤一：定义私有设备结构体
128: 
129: 我们强烈建议您定义一个私有结构体，用于封装 I2C 控制器的所有状态信息，例如配置、锁、信号量以及运行时数据等。以下是 `bl602` 芯片的私有结构体示例：
130: 
131: > **核心要点：结构体成员布局** 为确保类型安全转换，私有结构体的**第一个成员**必须是 `const struct i2c_ops_s *ops;`。这使得框架可以将您的私有结构体指针安全地转换为标准的 `struct i2c_master_s *` 句柄。
132: 
133: <details>
134: <summary>点击展开代码</summary>
135: 
136: ```C
137: /* 位于: arch/risc-v/src/bl602/bl602_i2c.c */
138: 
139: /* bl602 I2C 驱动的私有数据结构 */
140: struct bl602_i2c_priv_s
141: {
142:   /* 必须作为第一个成员，以兼容 i2c_master_s 类型转换 */
143:   const struct i2c_ops_s *ops; /* Standard I2C operations */
144: 
145:   /* 端口配置 */
146:   const struct bl602_i2c_config_s *config;
147: 
148:   /* 状态与同步机制 */
149:   uint8_t  subflag;   /* Sub address flag */
150:   uint32_t subaddr;   /* Sub address */
151:   uint8_t  sublen;    /* Sub address length */
152:   mutex_t  lock;      /* Mutual exclusion mutex */
153:   sem_t    sem_isr;   /* Interrupt wait semaphore */
154: 
155:   /* 运行时数据 */
156:   /* I2C work state */
157:   uint8_t i2cstate;
158: 
159:   struct i2c_msg_s *msgv; /* Message list */
160: 
161:   uint8_t msgid; /* Current message ID */
162:   ssize_t bytes; /* Processed data bytes */
163:   int     refs;  /* Reference count */
164: };
165: ```
166: 
167: </details>
168: 
169: #### 步骤二：实现初始化函数 `xxx_i2cbus_initialize()`
170: 
171: 此函数负责完成硬件初始化，并返回一个配置好的 I2C Master 句柄。
172: 
173: <details>
174: <summary>点击展开代码</summary>
175: 
176: ```C
177: struct i2c_master_s *bl602_i2cbus_initialize(int port)
178: {
179:   struct bl602_i2c_priv_s         *priv;
180:   const struct bl602_i2c_config_s *config;
181: 
182:   /* 1. 根据 port 号获取对应的私有设备实例 */
183:   switch (port)
184:     {
185: #ifdef CONFIG_BL602_I2C0
186:     case 0:
187:       priv = (struct bl602_i2c_priv_s *)&bl602_i2c0_priv;
188:       break;
189: #endif
190:     default:
191:       return NULL;
192:     }
193: 
194:   config = priv->config;
195: /*************************************************
196: 此部分是把IIC配置为中断，不配置中断可以把此部分替换成IIC GPIO以及时钟初始化
197:   
198:   nxmutex_lock(&priv->lock);
199:   if (++priv->refs > 1)
200:   {
201:     nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
202:     return (struct i2c_master_s *)priv;
203:   }
204: 
205:   bl602_configgpio(BOARD_I2C_SCL);
206:   bl602_configgpio(BOARD_I2C_SDA);
207: 
208:   bl602_i2c_set_freq(config->clk_freq);
209:   bl602_i2c_disable();
210:   up_enable_irq(BL602_IRQ_I2C);
211:   bl602_i2c_intmask(I2C_INT_ALL, 1);
212:   irq_attach(BL602_IRQ_I2C, bl602_i2c_irq, priv);
213: **************************************************/
214:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
215: 
216:    /* 2. 返回私有结构体指针，并强制转换为标准句柄类型 */
217:   return (struct i2c_master_s *)priv;
218: }
219: ```
220: 
221: </details>
222: 
223: #### 步骤三：在板级代码中调用
224: 
225: 在板级初始化代码（`xxx_bringup.c`）中，调用芯片驱动提供的初始化函数，并根据需要将 I2C 总线注册为系统设备。
226: 
227: - **参考实现**：[bl602_bringup.c](https://github.com/apache/nuttx/blob/master/boards/risc-v/bl602/bl602evb/src/bl602_bringup.c)
228: 
229: <details>
230: <summary>点击展开代码</summary>
231: 
232: ```C
233: #ifdef CONFIG_I2C
234:   /* 初始化 I2C 总线 0 */
235:   i2c_bus = bl602_i2cbus_initialize(0);
236:   
237:   /* 2. (可选) 将总线注册为 /dev/i2c-0 设备节点 */
238:   i2c_register(i2c_bus, 0);
239: #endif
240: ```
241: 
242: </details>
243: 
244: **`i2c_register()`** **使用说明**
245: 
246: - **注册为设备节点**：调用 `i2c_register(i2c_bus, N)` 会创建字符设备节点 `/dev/i2c-N`。这使得用户空间应用（如测试程序、`i2ctool`）能通过标准文件接口访问 I2C 总线。
247: - **仅供内核使用**：如果某个 I2C 总线仅供内核中的其他驱动（如板载传感器）使用，您可以不调用 `i2c_register()`。直接将 `i2c_bus` 句柄传递给相应驱动的注册函数即可。
248: 
249: ## 三、北向使用
250: 
251: 当 I2C Master 驱动被成功注册后，系统会创建 `/dev/i2c-N` 格式的设备节点（例如 `/dev/i2c-0`, `/dev/i2c-1` 等）。应用程序可以通过这些设备节点，使用标准的 POSIX 文件接口与挂载在 I2C 总线上的从设备进行通信。
252: 
253: ### 1、API 列表
254: 
255: I2C 设备节点支持以下标准文件操作接口：
256: 
257: | **API**                                                  | **描述**                                                                |
258: | :------------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
259: | `int open(FAR const char *path, int oflag, ...);`        | 打开 I2C 设备节点，例如 `"/dev/i2c-0"`。                                |
260: | `int  close(int `*`fd`*`);`                              | 关闭已打开的设备文件描述符。                                            |
261: | `int ioctl(int fd, int req, ...)`                        | **核心通信接口**。通过发送特定命令来执行 I2C 读写、总线复位等复杂操作。 |
262: | `ssize_t read(int fd, ...)` `ssize_t write(int fd, ...)` | **暂未使用**。                                                          |
263: 
264: ### 2、`ioctl()` 核心接口
265: 
266: `ioctl()` 是与 I2C 设备进行数据交互的主要方式。openvela 定义了以下标准 `ioctl` 命令：
267: 
268: #### `I2CIOC_TRANSFER`
269: 
270: 执行一次或多次 I2C 消息传输。这是最核心、最常用的命令。它使用 `struct i2c_transfer_s` 结构体来描述整个传输任务。
271: 
272: ```C
273: /* 定义一个 I2C 传输任务，可包含一个或多个消息 */
274: struct i2c_transfer_s
275: {
276:   FAR struct i2c_msg_s *msgv; /* Array of I2C messages for the transfer */
277:   size_t msgc;                /* Number of messages in the array. */
278: };
279: ```
280: 
281: 每个 I2C 消息由 `struct i2c_msg_s` 定义，用于描述单次读或写操作：
282: 
283: ```C
284: #define I2C_M_READ           0x0001 /* Read data, from slave to master */
285: #define I2C_M_NOSTOP         0x0040 /* Message should not end with a STOP */
286: #define I2C_M_NOSTART        0x0080 /* Message should not begin with a START */
287: 
288: struct i2c_msg_s
289: {
290:   uint32_t frequency;         /* I2C frequency */
291:   uint16_t addr;              /* Slave address (7- or 10-bit) */
292:   uint16_t flags;             /* See I2C_M_* definitions */
293:   FAR uint8_t *buffer;        /* Buffer to be transferred */
294:   ssize_t length;             /* Length of the buffer in bytes */
295: };
296: ```
297: 
298: #### `CONFIG_I2C_RESET`
299: 
300: 复位 I2C 总线。此命令在总线锁死或出现异常时非常有用。要使用此功能，必须在 Kconfig 中启用 `CONFIG_I2C_RESET`。调用时无需第三个参数。
301: 
302: ### 3、复合传输示例：读取传感器寄存器
303: 
304: 本节提供一个完整的示例，演示如何执行一次**复合传输 (Combined Transfer)** 来读取 I2C 设备的寄存器值。这是与 I2C 传感器等设备通信的典型场景，其过程分为两步：
305: 
306: 1. **写操作**：向从设备发送要读取的**寄存器地址**。
307: 2. **读操作**：紧接着从该寄存器**读取数据**。
308: 
309: #### 步骤一：Kconfig 配置
310: 
311: 确保您的项目中已启用以下配置：
312: 
313: ```Makefile
314: CONFIG_I2C=y
315: CONFIG_I2C_DRIVER=y
316: ```
317: 
318: #### 步骤二：读写示例代码
319: 
320: 以下代码从指定的 I2C 从机地址和寄存器地址读取一个字节的数据。
321: 
322: <details>
323: <summary>点击展开代码</summary>
324: 
325: ```C
326: #include <stdio.h>
327: #include <fcntl.h>
328: #include <sys/types.h>
329: #include <sys/stat.h>
330: #include <sys/ioctl.h>
331: #include <nuttx/i2c/i2c_master.h>
332: 
333: // 含义：使用 /dev/i2c-8，访问从机地址 0x68，读取寄存器 0x00 的值
334: //./i2c_test.out /dev/i2c-8 0x68 0x60
335: 
336: 
337: int main(int argc, char **argv)
338: {
339:   int fd,ret;
340:   uint8_t val;
341:   char dev_name[20];
342:   unsigned int slave_address,reg_address;
343:   struct i2c_transfer_s work;
344: 
345:   snprintf(dev_name, sizeof(dev_name),"%s", argv[1]);
346: 
347:   /* 1. 打开 I2C 设备节点 */
348:   fd = open(dev_name, O_RDWR);
349:   if (fd < 0)
350:    {
351:      printf("open failed: %d\n", fd);
352:      return fd;
353:    }
354: 
355:   /* 2. 准备 I2C 消息 */
356:   work.msgc = 2;
357:   work.msgv = (struct i2c_msg_s *)malloc(work.msgc * sizeof(struct i2c_msg_s));
358:   if (NULL == work.msgv)
359:     {
360:       printf("Memory alloc error\n");
361:       close(fd);
362:       return -1;
363:     }
364: 
365:   sscanf(argv[2], "%x", &slave_address);
366:   sscanf(argv[3], "%x", &reg_address);
367: 
368:   val = reg_address;
369:   /* 消息 1: 写操作，发送要读取的寄存器地址 */
370:   (work.msgv[0]).frequency=400000;
371:   (work.msgv[0]).length = 1;
372:   (work.msgv[0]).addr = slave_address;
373:   (work.msgv[0]).buffer = &val;
374:   (work.msgv[0]).flags = I2C_M_NOSTOP;
375: 
376:   /* 消息 2: 读操作，从设备读取一个字节的数据 */
377:   (work.msgv[1]).frequency=400000;
378:   (work.msgv[1]).length = 1;
379:   (work.msgv[1]).flags = I2C_M_READ;
380:   (work.msgv[1]).addr = slave_address;
381:   (work.msgv[1]).buffer = &val;
382: 
383:   /* 3. 执行 ioctl 调用，发起传输 */
384:   ret = ioctl(fd, I2CIOC_TRANSFER, &work);
385:   if (ret < 0)
386:   {
387:      printf("i2c: ioctl(I2CIOC_TRANSFER) failed: %d\n",fd);
388:      free( work.msgv);
389:      close(fd);
390:      return -1;
391:   }
392: 
393:   printf("reg:0x%02X val:%02x\n", reg_address, val);
394:   free( work.msgv);
395:   close(fd);
396: 
397:   return 0;
398: }
399: ```
400: 
401: </details>
402: 
403: ## 四、验证与测试
404: 
405: - 请参考 [I2C 驱动的验证与调试](./i2c_verification_guide.md)来测试您的驱动。

(End of file - total 405 lines)

227:     rt_uint8_t touch_num = 0;
228:     rt_uint8_t write_buf[3];
229:     rt_uint8_t cmd[2];
230:     rt_uint8_t read_buf[8 * GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { 0 };
231:     rt_uint8_t read_index;
232:     int8_t read_id = 0;
233:     int16_t input_x = 0;
234:     int16_t input_y = 0;
235:     int16_t input_w = 0;
236: 
237:     static rt_uint8_t pre_touch = 0;
238:     static int8_t pre_id[GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { 0 };
239: 
240:     rt_memset(buf, 0, sizeof(struct rt_touch_data) * read_num);
241: 
242:     /* point status register */
243:     cmd[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_READ_STATUS >> 8) & 0xFF);
244:     cmd[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_READ_STATUS & 0xFF);
245: 
246:     if (gt911_read_regs(&gt911_client, cmd, &point_status, 1) != RT_EOK) {
247:         LOG_D("read point failed\n");
248:         read_num = 0;
249:         goto exit_;
250:     }
251: 
252:     if (point_status == 0) /* no data */
253:     {
254:         read_num = 0;
255:         goto exit_;
256:     }
257: 
258:     if ((point_status & 0x80) == 0) /* data is not ready */
259:     {
260:         read_num = 0;
261:         goto exit_;
262:     }
263: 
264:     touch_num = point_status & 0x0f; /* get point num */
265: 
266:     if (touch_num > GT911_MAX_TOUCH) /* point num is not correct */
267:     {
268:         read_num = 0;
269:         goto exit_;
270:     }
271: 
272:     cmd[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_POINT1_REG >> 8) & 0xFF);
273:     cmd[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_POINT1_REG & 0xFF);
274: 
275:     /* read point num is touch_num */
276:     if (gt911_read_regs(&gt911_client, cmd, read_buf,
277:                         read_num * GT911_POINT_INFO_NUM) != RT_EOK) {
278:         LOG_D("read point failed\n");
279:         read_num = 0;
280:         goto exit_;
281:     }
282: 
283:     if (pre_touch > touch_num) /* point up */
284:     {
285:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < pre_touch; read_index++) {
286:             rt_uint8_t j;
287: 
288:             for (j = 0; j < touch_num; j++) /* this time touch num */
289:             {
290:                 read_id = read_buf[j * 8] & 0x0F;
291: 
292:                 if (pre_id[read_index] == read_id) /* this id is not free */
293:                     break;
294: 
295:                 if (j >= touch_num - 1) {
296:                     rt_uint8_t up_id;
297:                     up_id = pre_id[read_index];
298:                     gt911_touch_up(buf, up_id);
299:                 }
300:             }
301:         }
302:     }
303: 
304:     if (touch_num) /* point down */
305:     {
306:         rt_uint8_t off_set;
307: 
308:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < touch_num; read_index++) {
309:             off_set = read_index * 8;
310:             read_id = read_buf[off_set] & 0x0f;
311:             pre_id[read_index] = read_id;
312:             input_x =
313:                 read_buf[off_set + 1] | (read_buf[off_set + 2] << 8); /* x */
314:             input_y =
315:                 read_buf[off_set + 3] | (read_buf[off_set + 4] << 8); /* y */
316:             input_w =
317:                 read_buf[off_set + 5] | (read_buf[off_set + 6] << 8); /* size */
318: 
319:             gt911_touch_down(buf, read_id, input_x, input_y, input_w);
320:         }
321:     } else if (pre_touch) {
322:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < pre_touch; read_index++) {
323:             gt911_touch_up(buf, pre_id[read_index]);
324:         }
325:     }
326: 
327:     pre_touch = touch_num;
328: 
329: exit_:
330:     write_buf[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_READ_STATUS >> 8) & 0xFF);
331:     write_buf[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_READ_STATUS & 0xFF);
332:     write_buf[2] = 0x00;
333:     gt911_write_reg(&gt911_client, write_buf, 3);
334: 
335:     return read_num;
336: }

```

[1] DE probe                [2] LVDS probe              [3] attach_panel

    CLK_PIX 使能                CLK_SCLK 分频                 写 LVDS_0/1_POL

- DE 时钟使能必须在 LVDS 时钟使能**之前**，因为 DE 是像素数据的源头

66: static irqreturn_t aic_de_handler(int irq, void *ctx)
67: {
68:     struct aic_de_comp *comp = aic_de_request_drvdata();
69:     u32 status;
70: 
71:     status = de_timing_interrupt_status(comp->regs);
72:     de_timing_interrupt_clean_status(comp->regs, status);
73: 
74:     if (status & TIMING_INIT_V_BLANK_FLAG) {
75:         if (event_flag) {
76:             event_flag = 0;
77:             aicos_event_send(comp->vsync_event, VSYNC_EVENT);
78:         }
79:     }
80: 
81:     if (status & TIMING_INIT_UNDERFLOW_FLAG)
82:         pr_err("ERROR: DE UNDERFLOW\n");
83: 
84:     return IRQ_HANDLED;
85: }

423: static bool is_valid_video_size(struct aic_de_comp *comp,
424:                 struct aicfb_layer_data *layer_data)
425: {
426:     u32 src_width;
427:     u32 src_height;
428:     u32 x_offset;
429:     u32 y_offset;
430:     u32 active_w;
431:     u32 active_h;
432: 
433:     src_width = layer_data->buf.size.width;
434:     src_height = layer_data->buf.size.height;
435:     x_offset = layer_data->pos.x;
436:     y_offset = layer_data->pos.y;
437:     active_w = comp->timing->hactive;
438:     active_h = comp->timing->vactive;
439: 
440:     if (x_offset >= active_w || y_offset >= active_h) {
441:         pr_err("video layer x or y offset is invalid\n");
442:         return false;
443:     }
444: 
445:     if (layer_data->buf.crop_en) {
446:         u32 crop_x = layer_data->buf.crop.x;
447:         u32 crop_y = layer_data->buf.crop.y;
448: 
449:         if (crop_x >= src_width || crop_y >= src_height) {
450:             pr_err("video layer crop is invalid\n");
451:             return false;
452:         }
453: 
454:         if (crop_x + layer_data->buf.crop.width > src_width)
455:             layer_data->buf.crop.width = src_width - crop_x;
456: 
457:         if (crop_y + layer_data->buf.crop.height > src_height)
458:             layer_data->buf.crop.height = src_height - crop_y;
459:     }
460: 
461:     if (x_offset + layer_data->scale_size.width > active_w)
462:         layer_data->scale_size.width = active_w - x_offset;
463: 
464:     if (y_offset + layer_data->scale_size.height > active_h)
465:         layer_data->scale_size.height = active_h - y_offset;
466: 
467:     return true;
468: }

470: static bool is_ui_rect_win_overlap(struct aic_de_comp *comp,
471:                    u32 layer_id, u32 rect_id,
472:                    u32 x, u32 y, u32 w, u32 h)
473: {
474:     int i;
475:     u32 index;
476:     u32 cur_x, cur_y;
477:     u32 cur_w, cur_h;
478: 
479:     index = (layer_id << RECT_NUM_SHIFT);
480: 
481:     for (i = 0; i < MAX_RECT_NUM; i++) {
482:         if (rect_id == i) {
483:             index++;
484:             continue;
485:         }
486: 
487:         if (comp->layers[index].enable) {
488:             if (comp->layers[index].buf.crop_en) {
489:                 cur_w = comp->layers[index].buf.crop.width;
490:                 cur_h = comp->layers[index].buf.crop.height;
491:             } else {
492:                 cur_w = comp->layers[index].buf.size.width;
493:                 cur_h = comp->layers[index].buf.size.height;
494:             }
495:             cur_x = comp->layers[index].pos.x;
496:             cur_y = comp->layers[index].pos.y;
497: 
498:             if ((min(y + h, cur_y + cur_h) > max(y, cur_y)) &&
499:                 (min(x + w, cur_x + cur_w) > max(x, cur_x))) {
500:                 return true;
501:             }
502:         }
503:         index++;
504:     }
505:     return false;
506: }

514:     u32 y_offset;

524:     y_offset = layer_data->pos.y;

527: 
528:     if (x_offset >= active_w || y_offset >= active_h) {
529:         pr_err("ui layer x or y offset is invalid\n");
530:         return false;
531:     }
532: 
533:     if (layer_data->buf.crop_en) {
534:         u32 crop_x = layer_data->buf.crop.x;
535:         u32 crop_y = layer_data->buf.crop.y;
536: 
537:         if (crop_x >= src_width || crop_y >= src_height) {
538:             pr_err("ui layer crop is invalid\n");
539:             return false;
540:         }
541: 
542:         if ((crop_x + layer_data->buf.crop.width) > src_width)
543:             layer_data->buf.crop.width = src_width - crop_x;
544: 
545:         if ((crop_y + layer_data->buf.crop.height) > src_height)
546:             layer_data->buf.crop.height = src_height - crop_y;
547: 
548:         if ((x_offset + layer_data->buf.crop.width) > active_w)
549:             layer_data->buf.crop.width = active_w - x_offset;
550: 
551:         if ((y_offset + layer_data->buf.crop.height) > active_h)
552:             layer_data->buf.crop.height = active_h - y_offset;

559: 
560:         if ((y_offset + src_height) > active_h)

563:         w = layer_data->buf.size.width;

594: static int config_ui_layer_rect(struct aic_de_comp *comp,
595:                 struct aicfb_layer_data *layer_data)
596: {
597:     enum mpp_pixel_format format = layer_data->buf.format;
598:     u32 in_w = (u32)layer_data->buf.size.width;
599:     u32 in_h = (u32)layer_data->buf.size.height;
600: 
601:     u32 stride0 = layer_data->buf.stride[0];
602:     u32 addr0 = layer_data->buf.phy_addr[0];
603:     u32 x_offset = layer_data->pos.x;
604:     u32 y_offset = layer_data->pos.y;
605:     u32 crop_en = layer_data->buf.crop_en;
606:     u32 crop_x = layer_data->buf.crop.x;
607:     u32 crop_y = layer_data->buf.crop.y;
608:     u32 crop_w = layer_data->buf.crop.width;
609:     u32 crop_h = layer_data->buf.crop.height;
610: 
611:     switch (format) {
612:     case MPP_FMT_ARGB_8888:
613:     case MPP_FMT_ABGR_8888:
614:     case MPP_FMT_RGBA_8888:
615:     case MPP_FMT_BGRA_8888:
616:     case MPP_FMT_XRGB_8888:
617:     case MPP_FMT_XBGR_8888:
618:     case MPP_FMT_RGBX_8888:
619:     case MPP_FMT_BGRX_8888:
620:         if (crop_en) {
621:             addr0 += crop_x * 4 + crop_y * stride0;
622:             in_w = crop_w;
623:             in_h = crop_h;
624:         }
625:         break;
626:     case MPP_FMT_RGB_888:
627:     case MPP_FMT_BGR_888:
628:         if (crop_en) {
629:             addr0 += crop_x * 3 + crop_y * stride0;
630:             in_w = crop_w;
631:             in_h = crop_h;
632:         }
633:         break;
634:     case MPP_FMT_ARGB_1555:
635:     case MPP_FMT_ABGR_1555:
636:     case MPP_FMT_RGBA_5551:
637:     case MPP_FMT_BGRA_5551:
638:     case MPP_FMT_RGB_565:
639:     case MPP_FMT_BGR_565:
640:     case MPP_FMT_ARGB_4444:
641:     case MPP_FMT_ABGR_4444:
642:     case MPP_FMT_RGBA_4444:
643:     case MPP_FMT_BGRA_4444:
644:         if (crop_en) {
645:             addr0 += crop_x * 2 + crop_y * stride0;
646:             in_w = crop_w;
647:             in_h = crop_h;
648:         }
649:         break;
650:     default:
651:         pr_err("invalid ui layer format: %d\n",
652:             format);
653: 
654:         return -EINVAL;
655:     }
656: 
657:     if (is_all_rect_win_disabled(comp, layer_data->layer_id)) {
658:         de_set_ui_layer_format(comp->regs, format);
659:         de_ui_layer_enable(comp->regs, 1);
660:     }
661: 
662:     de_ui_layer_set_rect(comp->regs, in_w, in_h, x_offset, y_offset,
663:                  stride0, addr0, layer_data->rect_id);
664:     de_ui_layer_rect_enable(comp->regs, layer_data->rect_id, 1);
665: 
666:     return 0;
667: }

669: static int de_update_csc(struct aic_de_comp *comp,
670:              struct aicfb_disp_prop *disp_prop,
671:              int color_space)

1128: static int update_one_layer_config(struct aic_de_comp *comp,
1129:                    struct aicfb_layer_data *layer_data)
1130: {
1131:     u32 index;
1132:     int ret;
1133: 
1134:     if (!is_valid_layer_and_rect_id(comp, layer_data->layer_id,
1135:                        layer_data->rect_id)) {

1137:             __func__, layer_data->layer_id, layer_data->rect_id);
1138:         return -EINVAL;
1139:     }
1140: 
1141:     if (layer_data->enable == 0) {
1142:         index = (layer_data->layer_id << RECT_NUM_SHIFT)
1143:             + layer_data->rect_id;
1144:         comp->layers[index].enable = 0;
1145: 
1146:         if (is_ui_layer(comp, layer_data->layer_id)) {
1147:             ui_rect_disable(comp, layer_data->layer_id,
1148:                     layer_data->rect_id);
1149:         } else {
1150:             de_video_layer_enable(comp->regs, 0);
1151:         }
1152:         return 0;
1153:     }
1154: 
1155:     if (is_ui_layer(comp, layer_data->layer_id)) {
1156:         index = (layer_data->layer_id << RECT_NUM_SHIFT)
1157:             + layer_data->rect_id;
1158: 
1159:         if (!is_valid_ui_rect_size(comp, layer_data))
1160:             return -EINVAL;
1161: 
1162:         ret = config_ui_layer_rect(comp, layer_data);
1163:         if (ret != 0)
1164:             return -EINVAL;
1165:         else
1166:             memcpy(&comp->layers[index], layer_data,
1167:                    sizeof(struct aicfb_layer_data));
1168:     } else {
1169:         index = layer_data->layer_id << RECT_NUM_SHIFT;
1170: 
1171:         if (!is_valid_video_size(comp, layer_data)) {
1172:             comp->layers[index].enable = 0;
1173:             de_video_layer_enable(comp->regs, 0);
1174:             return -EINVAL;
1175:         }
1176: 
1177:         ret = config_video_layer(comp, layer_data);
1178:         if (ret != 0) {
1179:             comp->layers[index].enable = 0;
1180:             de_video_layer_enable(comp->regs, 0);
1181:         } else {
1182:             memcpy(&comp->layers[index], layer_data,
1183:                    sizeof(struct aicfb_layer_data));
1184:         }
1185:         return ret;
1186:     }
1187:     return 0;

327: static int get_hsbc_coefs(int bright, int contrast,
328:               int sat, int hue, int coef[][4])
329: {
330:     int sinv = sin_table[hue + 29];
331:     int cosv = cos_table[hue + 29];
332: 
333:     sat = sat + 128;
334:     contrast = contrast + 128;
335: 
336:     coef[0][0] = contrast << 3;
337:     coef[0][1] = 0;
338:     coef[0][2] = 0;
339:     coef[0][3] = ((bright << 3) << 8) + ((1024 - (contrast << 3)) << 4);
340: 
341:     coef[1][0] = 0;
342:     coef[1][1] = (contrast * sat * cosv) >> 16;
343:     coef[1][2] = (contrast * sat * sinv) >> 16;
344:     coef[1][3] = (1024 - (coef[1][1] + coef[1][2])) << 7;
345: 
346:     coef[2][0] = 0;
347:     coef[2][1] = (-contrast * sat * sinv) >> 16;
348:     coef[2][2] = (contrast * sat * cosv) >> 16;
349:     coef[2][3] = (1024 - (coef[2][1] + coef[2][2])) << 7;
350: 
351:     coef[3][0] = 0;

359: static void matrix_4x4_multi(int a[][4], int b[][4], int out[][4])
360: {
361:     int i, j;
362:     int c;
363: 
364:     for (j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
365:         for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
366:             for (c = 0; c < 4; c++)
367:                 out[j][i] += (a[j][c] * b[c][i]) >> 10;
368:         }
369:     }

372: static int get_csc_coefs_for_hsbc(int is_rgb, int color_space,
373:                   int bright, int contrast,
374:                   int saturation, int hue,
375:                   u32 *csc_coef)
376: {
377:     int(*y2r)[4];
378:     int(*r2y)[4];
379:     int(*cur_coef)[4];
380:     int i, j, c, k;
381:     int hsv_coef[4][4] = {0};
382:     int out_coef[4][4] = {0};
383: 
384:     bright = bright > 100 ? 100 : bright;
385:     contrast = contrast > 100 ? 100 : contrast;
386:     saturation = saturation > 100 ? 100 : saturation;
387:     hue = hue > 100 ? 100 : hue;
388: 
389:     bright = bright * 128 / 100 - 64;
390:     contrast = contrast * 180 / 100 - 90;
391:     saturation = saturation * 128 / 100 - 64;
392:     hue = hue * 58 / 100 - 29;
393: 
394:     if (color_space == 0)
395:         y2r = yuv2rgb_bt601_limit;
396:     else if (color_space == 1)
397:         y2r = yuv2rgb_bt709_limit;
398:     else if (color_space == 2)
399:         y2r = yuv2rgb_bt601_full;
400:     else if (color_space == 3)
401:         y2r = yuv2rgb_bt709_full;
402:     else
403:         y2r = yuv2rgb_bt601_limit;
404: 
405:     get_hsbc_coefs(bright, contrast, saturation, hue, hsv_coef);
406: 
407:     if (is_rgb) {
408:         r2y = rgb2yuv_bt709_full;
409:         matrix_4x4_multi(hsv_coef, r2y, out_coef);
410:         cur_coef = out_coef;
411:     } else {
412:         cur_coef = hsv_coef;
413:     }
414: 
415:     k = 0;
416:     for (j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
417:         for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
418:             unsigned int value;
419:             int accum;
420: 
421:             accum = 0;
422:             for (c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
423:                 int cur_value =  y2r[j][c];
424: 
425:                 if (c == 3)
426:                     cur_value = cur_value << 6;
427: 
428:                 accum += cur_value * cur_coef[c][i];
429:             }
430: 
431:             if (i == 3) {
432:                 accum = accum >> 16;
433:                 accum = accum > 8091 ? 8091 : accum;
434:                 accum = accum < -8092 ? -8092 : accum;
435:                 value = (unsigned int)accum;
436:                 value = CSC0_COEF_OFFSET_SET(value);
437:             } else {
438:                 accum = accum >> 10;
439:                 accum = accum > 4095 ? 4095 : accum;
440:                 accum = accum < -4096 ? -4096 : accum;
441:                 value = (unsigned int)accum;
442:                 value = CSC0_COEF_SET(value);
443:             }
444:             csc_coef[k++] = value;
445:         }
446:     }
447: 
448:     return 0;
449: }

13: static unsigned long clk_disp_mod_recalc_rate(struct aic_clk_comm_cfg *comm_cfg,
14:                                               unsigned long parent_rate)
15: {
16:     struct aic_clk_disp_cfg *mod = to_clk_disp_mod(comm_cfg);
17:     unsigned long rate, pix_divsel, divn, divm, divl;
18:     u32 reg_val;
19: 
20:     if (mod->divn_mask) {
21:         /* For sclk */
22:         divn = (readl(cmu_reg(mod->offset_reg)) >> mod->divn_bit) &
23:                mod->divn_mask;
24:         rate = parent_rate / (1 << divn);
25:     } else if (mod->divm_mask) {
26:         /* For pixclk */
27:         reg_val    = readl(cmu_reg(mod->offset_reg));
28:         pix_divsel = (reg_val >> mod->pix_divsel_bit) & mod->pix_divsel_mask;
29:         switch (pix_divsel) {
30:         case 0:
31:             divl = (reg_val >> mod->divl_bit) & mod->divl_mask;
32:             divm = (reg_val >> mod->divm_bit) & mod->divm_mask;
33:             rate = parent_rate / (1 << divl) / (divm + 1);
34:             break;
35:         case 1:
36:             rate = parent_rate * 2 / 7;
37:             break;
38:         case 2:
39:             rate = parent_rate * 2 / 9;
40:             break;
41:         default:
42:             return -EINVAL;
43:         }
44:     } else
45:         return -EINVAL;
46: 
47: #ifdef FPGA_BOARD_ARTINCHIP
48:     rate = fpga_board_rate[mod->id];
49: #endif
50:     return rate;
51: }
52: 
53: static void clk_disp_try_best_divider(u32 rate, u32 parent_rate, u32 max_divn,
54:                                       u32 *divn)
55: {
56:     u32 tmp, i, min_delta = U32_MAX;
57:     u32 best_divn = 0;
58: 
59:     for (i = 0; i <= max_divn; i++) {
60:         tmp = (1 << i) * rate;
61:         if (parent_rate == tmp) {
62:             best_divn = i;
63:             goto __out;
64:         }
65: 
66:         if (abs(parent_rate - tmp) < min_delta) {
67:             min_delta = abs(parent_rate - tmp);
68:             best_divn = i;
69:         }
70:     }
71: 
72: __out:
73:     *divn = best_divn;
74: }
75: 
76: static void clk_disp_try_best_divider_pixclk(u32 rate, u32 parent_rate,
77:                                              u32 divm_max, u32 *divm,
78:                                              u32 divl_max, u32 *divl,
79:                                              u8 *pix_divsel)
80: {
81:     u32 tmp, tmpm, tmpl, val0, val1, val2, i;
82: 
83:     /* Calculate clock division */
84:     tmp = DIV_ROUND_CLOSEST(parent_rate, rate);
85:     /* Calculate the value of divl */
86:     tmpl = DIV_ROUND_UP(tmp, divm_max);
87:     for (i = 0; i < divl_max; i++)
88:         if (1 << i >= tmpl)
89:             break;
90:     tmpm = tmp / (1 << i);
91: 
92:     if ((1 << i) * tmpm * rate == parent_rate) {
93:         *pix_divsel = 0;
94:     } else {
95:         val0 = abs((1 << i) * tmpm * rate - parent_rate);
96:         val1 = abs(rate * 7 / 2 - parent_rate);
97:         val2 = abs(rate * 9 / 2 - parent_rate);
98: 
99:         if (val0 < val1 && val0 < val2)
100:             *pix_divsel = 0;
101:         else if (val1 < val0 && val1 < val2)
102:             *pix_divsel = 1;
103:         else if (val2 < val0 && val2 < val1)
104:             *pix_divsel = 2;
105:         else
106:             *pix_divsel = 0;
107:     }
108: 
109:     *divm = tmpm - 1;
110:     *divl = i;
111: }
112: 
113: static long clk_disp_mod_round_rate(struct aic_clk_comm_cfg *comm_cfg,
114:                                     unsigned long rate, unsigned long *prate)
115: {
116:     struct aic_clk_disp_cfg *mod = to_clk_disp_mod(comm_cfg);
117:     u32 parent_rate, divn, divm, divl, rrate;
118:     u8 pix_divsel = 0;
119: 
120:     parent_rate = *prate;
121: 
122:     if (mod->divm_mask) {
123:         /* For pixclk */
124:         clk_disp_try_best_divider_pixclk(rate, parent_rate, mod->divm_mask + 1,
125:                                          &divm, mod->divl_mask + 1, &divl,
126:                                          &pix_divsel);
127:         if (pix_divsel == 1)
128:             rrate = parent_rate * 2 / 7;
129:         else if (pix_divsel == 2)
130:             rrate = parent_rate * 2 / 9;
131:         else
132:             rrate = parent_rate / (divm + 1) / (1 << divl);
133:     } else if (mod->divn_mask) {
134:         /* For sclk */
135:         clk_disp_try_best_divider(rate, parent_rate, mod->divn_mask, &divn);
136:         rrate = parent_rate / (1 << divn);
137:     } else
138:         return -EINVAL;
139: 
140: #ifdef FPGA_BOARD_ARTINCHIP
141:     rrate = fpga_board_rate[mod->id];
142: #endif
143:     return rrate;
144: }
145: 
146: static int clk_disp_mod_set_rate(struct aic_clk_comm_cfg *comm_cfg,
147:                                  unsigned long rate, unsigned long parent_rate)
148: {
149:     struct aic_clk_disp_cfg *mod = to_clk_disp_mod(comm_cfg);
150:     u32 divn, divm, divl, val;
151:     u8 pix_divsel = 0;
152: 
153:     val = readl(cmu_reg(mod->offset_reg));
154: 
155:     if (mod->divm_mask) {
156:         /* For pixclk */
157:         clk_disp_try_best_divider_pixclk(rate, parent_rate, mod->divm_mask + 1,
158:                                          &divm, mod->divl_mask + 1, &divl,
159:                                          &pix_divsel);
160:         if (pix_divsel) {
161:             val &= ~(mod->pix_divsel_mask << mod->pix_divsel_bit);
162:             val |= (pix_divsel << mod->pix_divsel_bit);
163:         } else {
164:             val &= ~((mod->pix_divsel_mask << mod->pix_divsel_bit) |
165:                      (mod->divm_mask << mod->divm_bit) |
166:                      (mod->divl_mask << mod->divl_bit));
167:             val |= (divm << mod->divm_bit) | (divl << mod->divl_bit);
168:         }
169: 
170:         writel(val, cmu_reg(mod->offset_reg));
171:     } else if (mod->divn_mask) {
172:         /* For sclk */
173:         clk_disp_try_best_divider(rate, parent_rate, mod->divn_mask, &divn);
174:         val &= ~(mod->divn_mask << mod->divn_bit);
175:         val |= (divn << mod->divn_bit);
176: 
177:         writel(val, cmu_reg(mod->offset_reg));
178:     }
179: 
180:     return 0;
181: }

186:     .set_rate    = clk_disp_mod_set_rate,

19: static inline void clk_pll_bypass(struct aic_clk_pll_cfg *pll, unsigned int bypass)

22: 
23:     val = readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));
24:     val &= ~(1 << PLL_OUT_MUX);
25:     val |= (!bypass << PLL_OUT_MUX);

35:         return 0;
36:     }
37: 
38:

40:     val |= (1 << PLL_OUT_SYS | 1 << PLL_EN_BIT);
41:     writel(val, cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));

43:     return clk_pll_wait_lock();
44: }

62: 
63:     if ((reg_val & (1 << PLL_EN_BIT)) && (reg_val & (1 << PLL_OUT_SYS)))
64:         return 1;
65: 
66:     return 0;

69: static unsigned long clk_pll_recalc_rate(struct aic_clk_comm_cfg *comm_cfg,
70:                                          unsigned long parent_rate)
71: {
72:     struct aic_clk_pll_cfg *pll = to_clk_pll(comm_cfg);
73:     u32 factor_n, factor_m, factor_p, fra_in;
74:     u64 rate, rate_int, rate_fra;
75:     u8 fra_en = 0;
76:     u32 sdm_en = 0;
77: 
78:     /* PLL output mux is CLK_24M */
79:     if (!((readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen)) >> PLL_OUT_MUX) & 0x1))
80:         return CLOCK_24M;
81: 
82:     factor_n = (readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen)) >> PLL_FACTORN_BIT) &
83:                PLL_FACTORN_MASK;
84:     factor_m = (readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen)) >> PLL_FACTORM_BIT) &
85:                PLL_FACTORM_MASK;
86:     factor_p = (readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen)) >> PLL_FACTORP_BIT) &
87:                PLL_FACTORP_MASK;
88:     if (pll->type == AIC_PLL_FRA)
89:         fra_en = (readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_fra)) >> PLL_FRAC_EN_BIT) & 0x1;
90: 
91:     if (pll->type == AIC_PLL_INT || !fra_en) {
92:         rate = parent_rate / (factor_p + 1) * (factor_n + 1) / (factor_m + 1);
93:     } else {
94:         fra_in = readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_fra)) & PLL_FRAC_DIV_MASK;
95:         rate_int =
96:                 parent_rate / (factor_p + 1) * (factor_n + 1) / (factor_m + 1);
97:         rate_fra = (u64)parent_rate / (factor_p + 1) * fra_in;
98:         do_div(rate_fra, PLL_FRAC_DIV_MASK * (factor_m + 1));
99:         rate = rate_int + rate_fra;
100:     }
101: 
102:     if (pll->type == AIC_PLL_SDM) {
103:         sdm_en = readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_sdm));
104:         sdm_en >>= 31;
105: 
106:         /* Pll is SDM mode, but SDM is not enable
107:          * Create a small deviation, let sys setup again
108:          */
109:         if (sdm_en == 0)
110:             rate += 1;
111:     }
112: #ifdef FPGA_BOARD_ARTINCHIP
113:     rate = fpga_board_rate[pll->id];
114: #endif
115:     return rate;
116: }
117: 
118: static long clk_pll_round_rate(struct aic_clk_comm_cfg *comm_cfg,
119:                                unsigned long rate, unsigned long *prate)
120: {
121:     struct aic_clk_pll_cfg *pll = to_clk_pll(comm_cfg);
122:     u32 factor_n, factor_m, factor_p;
123:     long rrate, vco_rate;
124:     unsigned long parent_rate = *prate;
125: 
126:     if (pll->type == AIC_PLL_FRA)
127:             return rate;
128: 
129:     /* The frequency constraint of PLL_VCO is between 768M and 1560M */
130:     if (rate < PLL_VCO_MIN)
131:         factor_m = DIV_ROUND_UP(PLL_VCO_MIN, rate) - 1;
132:     else
133:         factor_m = 0;
134: 
135:     if (factor_m > PLL_FACTORM_MASK)
136:         factor_m = PLL_FACTORM_MASK;
137: 
138:     vco_rate = (factor_m + 1) * rate;
139:     if (vco_rate > PLL_VCO_MAX)
140:         vco_rate = PLL_VCO_MAX;
141: 
142:     factor_p = (vco_rate % parent_rate) ? 1 : 0;
143:     if (!factor_p)
144:         return rate;
145:     else if (!(vco_rate % (parent_rate / (factor_p + 1))))
146:         return rate;
147: 
148:     factor_n = vco_rate / parent_rate * (factor_p + 1) - 1;
149: 
150:     rrate = parent_rate / (factor_p + 1) * (factor_n + 1) / (factor_m + 1);
151: 
152: #ifdef FPGA_BOARD_ARTINCHIP
153:     rrate = fpga_board_rate[pll->id];
154: #endif
155:     return rrate;
156: }
157: 
158: static int clk_pll_set_rate(struct aic_clk_comm_cfg *comm_cfg,
159:                             unsigned long rate, unsigned long parent_rate)
160: {
161:     u32 factor_n, factor_m, factor_p, reg_val;
162:     u64 val, fra_in = 0;
163:     u8 fra_en, factor_m_en;
164:     unsigned long vco_rate;
165:     u32 ppm_max, sdm_amp, sdm_en = 0;
166:     u64 sdm_step;
167:     struct aic_clk_pll_cfg *pll = to_clk_pll(comm_cfg);
168: 
169:     if (pll->flag & CLK_NO_CHANGE)
170:         return 0;
171: 
172:     if (rate == CLOCK_24M) {
173:         val = readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));
174:         val &= ~(1 << PLL_OUT_MUX);
175:         writel(val, cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));
176:         return 0;
177:     }
178: 
179:     /* Switch the output of PLL to 24MHz */
180:     clk_pll_bypass(pll, 1);
181: 
182:     /* Calculate PLL parameters.
183:      * The frequency constraint of PLL_VCO
184:      * is between 768M and 1560M
185:      */
186:     if (rate < PLL_VCO_MIN)
187:         factor_m = DIV_ROUND_UP(PLL_VCO_MIN, rate) - 1;
188:     else
189:         factor_m = 0;
190: 
191:     /* Avoid factor_m == 2 */
192:     if (factor_m == 2)
193:         factor_m = 3;
194: 
195:     if (factor_m > PLL_FACTORM_MASK)
196:         factor_m = PLL_FACTORM_MASK;
197: 
198:     if (factor_m)
199:         factor_m_en = 1;
200:     else
201:         factor_m_en = 0;
202: 
203:     vco_rate = (factor_m + 1) * rate;
204:     if (vco_rate > PLL_VCO_MAX)
205:         vco_rate = PLL_VCO_MAX;
206: 
207:     factor_p = (vco_rate % parent_rate) ? 1 : 0;
208:     factor_n = vco_rate * (factor_p + 1) / parent_rate  - 1;
209: 
210:     reg_val = readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));
211:     reg_val &= ~0xFFFF;
212:     reg_val |= (factor_m_en << PLL_FACTORM_EN_BIT) |
213:             (factor_n << PLL_FACTORN_BIT) |
214:             (factor_m << PLL_FACTORM_BIT) |
215:             (factor_p << PLL_FACTORP_BIT);
216:     /* If SDM enable, set PLL_ICP = 0 */
217:     if (pll->type == AIC_PLL_SDM)
218:         reg_val &= ~(0x1F << 24);
219:     writel(reg_val, cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));
220: 
221:     if (pll->type == AIC_PLL_FRA) {
222:         val = rate % (parent_rate * (factor_n + 1) /
223:                   (factor_m + 1) / (factor_p + 1));
224:         fra_en = val ? 1 : 0;
225:         if (fra_en) {
226:             fra_in = val * (factor_p + 1) *
227:                  (factor_m + 1) * PLL_FRAC_DIV_MASK;
228:             do_div(fra_in, parent_rate);
229:         }
230:         /* Configure fractional division */
231:         writel(fra_en << PLL_FRAC_EN_BIT | fra_in, cmu_reg(pll->offset_fra));
232:     } else if (pll->type == AIC_PLL_SDM) {
233:         sdm_en = readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_sdm));
234:         sdm_en >>= 31;
235: 
236:         ppm_max = 1000000 / (factor_n + 1);
237:         /* 1% spread */
238:         if (ppm_max < PLL_SDM_SPREAD_PPM)
239:             sdm_amp = 0;
240:         else
241:             sdm_amp = PLL_SDM_AMP_MAX -
242:                 PLL_SDM_SPREAD_PPM *
243:                 PLL_SDM_AMP_MAX / ppm_max;
244: 
245:         /* SDM uses triangular wave, 33KHz by default  */
246:         sdm_step = (PLL_SDM_AMP_MAX - sdm_amp) * 2 *
247:             PLL_SDM_SPREAD_FREQ;
248:         do_div(sdm_step, parent_rate);
249:         if (sdm_step > 511)
250:             sdm_step = 511;
251: 
252:         reg_val = (1UL << PLL_SDM_EN_BIT) |
253:               (2 << PLL_SDM_MODE_BIT) |
254:               (sdm_step << PLL_SDM_STEP_BIT) |
255:               (3 << PLL_SDM_FREQ_BIT) |
256:               (sdm_amp << PLL_SDM_AMP_BIT);
257: 
258:         writel(reg_val, cmu_reg(pll->offset_sdm));
259:     }
260: 
261:     reg_val = readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));
262:     reg_val |= (1 << PLL_OUT_SYS | 1 << PLL_EN_BIT);
263:     writel(reg_val, cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));
264: 
265:     if (!clk_pll_wait_lock()) {
266:         clk_pll_bypass(pll, 0);
267:     } else {
268:         //pr_err("%d not lock\n", pll->id);
269:         return -EAGAIN;
270:     }
271: 
272:     return 0;
273: }
274: 
275: static unsigned int clk_pll_get_parent(struct aic_clk_comm_cfg *comm_cfg)
276: {
277:     struct aic_clk_pll_cfg *pll = to_clk_pll(comm_cfg);
278: 
279:     return pll->parent_id;
280: }

285:     .is_enabled  = clk_pll_is_enable,

## LVDS 显示管线完整初始化流程分析

基于 luban-lite (ArtInChip D13x/D11x 平台) 的源码，以下按初始化顺序逐步列出寄存器操作和关键参数。以 1024x600 面板、pixelclock = 52MHz、单链路 (Single Link 0) 为具体配置。

---

### 一、PLL_DISP 时钟链路

**时钟树结构：**

```
PLL_FRA2 (PLL_DISP)  ──>  CLK_SCLK  ──>  CLK_PIX (pixel clock)
                              │
                              └──>  CLK_LVDS
```

**PLL_FRA2 配置（CMU 寄存器）：**

| 寄存器 | 偏移 | 用途 |
|--------|------|------|
| `PLL_FRA2_GEN_REG` | `0x0028` (CMU_BASE + 0x0028) | PLL 使能、factor_n/m/p |
| `PLL_FRA2_CFG_REG` | `0x0068` (CMU_BASE + 0x0068) | PLL 配置 |
| `PLL_FRA2_SDM_REG` | `0x0088` (CMU_BASE + 0x0088) | SDM (扩频调制) 配置 |

**PLL 频率计算公式（`aic_hal_pll_clk.c` 第 158-273 行）：**

```
rate = parent_rate / (factor_p + 1) * (factor_n + 1) / (factor_m + 1)
       + parent_rate / (factor_p + 1) * fra_in / (0x1FFFF * (factor_m + 1))
```

其中：
- `parent_rate` = 24 MHz (CLK_OSC24M)
- `factor_n` 范围 [14, 199]，对应 `PLL_GEN_REG[15:8]`
- `factor_m` 范围 [0, 3]，对应 `PLL_GEN_REG[5:4]`，使能位 `bit 19`
- `factor_p` 范围 [0, 1]，对应 `PLL_GEN_REG[0]`
- VCO 频率约束：768 MHz <= VCO <= 1560 MHz
- `PLL_GEN_REG[16]` = PLL_EN，`bit 17` = PLL_LOCK，`bit 18` = PLL_OUT_SYS，`bit 20` = PLL_OUT_MUX

**PLL_FRA2 使能流程（`clk_pll_enable`）：**
1. 读取 `CMU_BASE + PLL_FRA2_GEN_REG`
2. 设置 `PLL_OUT_SYS` (bit 18) 和 `PLL_EN` (bit 16)
3. 写回寄存器
4. 等待 200us 锁定

**PLL_FRA2 配置流程（`clk_pll_set_rate`）：**
1. 先 bypass PLL（输出切换到 24MHz）
2. 计算 factor_m：若 rate < 768MHz，则 `factor_m = DIV_ROUND_UP(768M, rate) - 1`
3. 计算 VCO = (factor_m + 1) * rate，限制最大 1560MHz
4. 计算 factor_p 和 factor_n
5. 写入 `PLL_GEN_REG` 的 factor_n/m/p 字段
6. 若为 SDM 类型，配置 SDM 寄存器（扩频）
7. 重新使能 PLL，等待锁定
8. 切换 bypass

---

| hactive | `PANEL_HACTIVE` | 1024 | `TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE` (0x1E0) | [12:0] |
| vactive | `PANEL_VACTIVE` | 600 | `TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE` (0x1E0) | [28:16] |
| hbp | `PANEL_HBP` | 160 | `TIMING_H_PORCH` (0x1E4) | [28:16] |

### 三、LVDS 使能前的前置初始化

从 `drv_lvds.c` 的 `aic_lvds_attach_panel()` 和 `aic_lvds_clk_enable()` 可以看到：

**3.1 SCLK 频率计算（`drv_lvds.c` 第 136-160 行）：**

```c
if (lvds->link_mode != DUAL_LINK)
    comp->sclk_rate = pixclk * 7;           // 单链路：52 * 7 = 364 MHz
else
    comp->sclk_rate = pixclk * 3.5;         // 双链路：pixclk * 3.5
```

**3.2 PLL_DISP 频率计算：**

```c
pll_disp_rate = sclk_rate;                   // 364 MHz
while (pll_disp_rate < PLL_DISP_FREQ_MIN) {  // PLL_DISP_FREQ_MIN = 360 MHz
    pll_disp_rate = sclk_rate * (2 << i);
    i++;
}
```

对于 52MHz 像素时钟：`364 MHz >= 360 MHz`，无需倍频，`pll_disp_rate = 364 MHz`。

**3.3 时钟使能顺序（`drv_lvds.c` 第 62-78 行）：**

```
1. hal_clk_set_freq(CLK_PLL_FRA2, 364MHz)   // 设置 PLL_FRA2 输出频率
2. hal_clk_set_rate(CLK_SCLK, 364MHz, 364MHz) // SCLK = PLL_FRA2 / divider
3. hal_clk_set_rate(CLK_PIX, 52MHz, 364MHz)   // PIX = SCLK / divider
4. hal_clk_enable(CLK_PLL_FRA2)                // 使能 PLL
5. hal_clk_enable(CLK_SCLK)                    // 使能 SCLK
6. hal_clk_enable(CLK_LVDS)                    // 使能 LVDS 模块时钟
7. hal_reset_deassert(RESET_LVDS)              // 释放 LVDS 复位
```

**时钟分频器实现（`aic_hal_disp_clk.c`）：**

CLK_SCLK 配置：`DISPCLK(CLK_SCLK, "sclk", CLK_PLL_FRA2, ..., CLK_DISP_REG, 0, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)`
- divn 位于 `CLK_DISP_REG` (0x0220 + CMU_BASE) 的 bit[2:0]
- 分频公式：`sclk_rate = pll_fra2_rate / (1 << divn)`

CLK_PIX 配置：`DISPCLK(CLK_PIX, "pixclk", CLK_SCLK, ..., CLK_DISP_REG, 0, 0, 4, 5, 10, 2, 12, 2)`
- pix_divsel 位于 `CLK_DISP_REG` bit[13:12]
- divm 位于 `CLK_DISP_REG` bit[8:4]
- divl 位于 `CLK_DISP_REG` bit[11:10]
- 分频公式（pix_divsel=0）：`pixclk = sclk_rate / (1 << divl) / (divm + 1)`
- 特殊分频（pix_divsel=1）：`pixclk = sclk_rate * 2 / 7`
- 特殊分频（pix_divsel=2）：`pixclk = sclk_rate * 2 / 9`

#define I2C_M_NOSTOP   0x0040  /* Message should not end with a STOP */
#define I2C_M_NOSTART  0x0080  /* Message should not begin with a START */
```

文档第 370-374 行的复合传输示例展示了 `I2C_M_NOSTOP` 的典型用法：写寄存器地址时不发 STOP，紧接着读取数据。

**具体问题**:

- **`d13x_i2c_transfer_one()` (第 256-441 行)**: 全程未检查 `msg->flags & I2C_M_NOSTOP` 和 `msg->flags & I2C_M_NOSTART`。

- **写操作 (第 367-434 行)**: 第 416-417 行无条件在最后一个字节带 `I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP`，同上。

**后果**: 复合传输（如读传感器寄存器：先写地址再读数据）会失败，因为每次 `transfer_one` 都会强制发送 STOP，破坏总线上的复合事务。

256: static int d13x_i2c_transfer_one(struct d13x_i2c_dev_s *priv,
257:                                   FAR struct i2c_msg_s *msg)
258: {
259:   uint32_t base = priv->base;
260:   int remaining;
261:   int ret = OK;
262:   uint32_t timeout;
263:   uint32_t reg_val;
264: 
265:   /* 等待总线空闲 */
266: 
267:   ret = i2c_wait_bus_idle(base, I2C_TIMEOUT_MS);
268:   if (ret < 0)
269:     {
270:       return ret;
271:     }
272: 
273:   /* 禁用模块 → 设置目标地址 → 重新使能 */
274: 
275:   i2c_module_disable(base);
276: 
277:   reg_val = i2c_getreg(base, I2C_TAR);
278:   reg_val &= ~0x3ff;
279:   reg_val |= (msg->addr & 0x3ff);
280:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_TAR, reg_val);
281: 
282:   /* 确保 master 模式 + restart enable */
283: 
284:   reg_val = i2c_getreg(base, I2C_CTL);
285:   reg_val |= I2C_CTL_MASTER | I2C_CTL_RESTART_EN;
286:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_CTL, reg_val);
287: 
288:   /* 清除所有中断 */
289: 
290:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xffff);
291: 
292:   i2c_module_enable(base);
293: 
294:   if (msg->flags & I2C_M_READ)
295:     {
296:       /* === 读操作 === */
297: 
298:       remaining = msg->length;
299: 
300:       while (remaining > 0)
301:         {
302:           int burst = remaining > I2C_FIFO_DEPTH ?
303:                       I2C_FIFO_DEPTH : remaining;
304:           int i;
305: 
306:           /* 发送读命令 */
307: 
308:           for (i = 0; i < burst - 1; i++)
309:             {
310:               i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD, I2C_DATA_CMD_READ);
311:             }
312: 
313:           /* 最后一个字节带 STOP */
314: 
315:           if (remaining <= I2C_FIFO_DEPTH)
316:             {
317:               i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD,
318:                          I2C_DATA_CMD_READ | I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP);
319:             }
320:           else
321:             {
322:               i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD, I2C_DATA_CMD_READ);
323:             }
324: 
325:           /* 等待数据到达 */
326: 
327:           timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_MS;
328:           while (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_RXFLR) < burst)
329:             {
330:               if (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)
331:                 {
332:                   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xffff);
333:                   return -EIO;
334:                 }
335: 
336:               if (--timeout == 0)
337:                 {
338:                   return -ETIMEDOUT;
339:                 }
340: 
341:               up_udelay(100);
342:             }
343: 
344:           /* 读取数据 */
345: 
346:           for (i = 0; i < burst; i++)
347:             {
348:               *msg->buffer++ = (uint8_t)(i2c_getreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD) & 0xff);
349:             }
350: 
351:           remaining -= burst;
352:         }
353: 
354:       /* 等待 STOP */
355: 
356:       timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_MS;
357:       while (!(i2c_getreg(base, I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & I2C_INTR_STOP_DET))
358:         {
359:           if (--timeout == 0)
360:             {
361:               return -ETIMEDOUT;
362:             }
363: 
364:           up_udelay(100);
365:         }
366:     }
367:   else
368:     {
369:       /* === 写操作 === */
370: 
371:       remaining = msg->length;
372: 
373:       while (remaining > 0)
374:         {
375:           int burst = remaining > I2C_FIFO_DEPTH ?
376:                       I2C_FIFO_DEPTH : remaining;
377:           int i;
378: 
379:           for (i = 0; i < burst - 1; i++)
380:             {
381:               /* 等待 TX FIFO 有空间 */
382: 
383:               timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_MS;
384:               while (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_TXFLR) >= I2C_FIFO_DEPTH)
385:                 {
386:                   if (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)
387:                     {
388:                       i2c_putreg(base, I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xffff);
389:                       return -EIO;
390:                     }
391: 
392:                   if (--timeout == 0)
393:                     {
394:                       return -ETIMEDOUT;
395:                     }
396: 
397:                   up_udelay(100);
398:                 }
399: 
400:               i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD, *msg->buffer++);
401:             }
402: 
403:           /* 最后一个字节带 STOP */
404: 
405:           timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_MS;
406:           while (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_TXFLR) >= I2C_FIFO_DEPTH)
407:             {
408:               if (--timeout == 0)
409:                 {
410:                   return -ETIMEDOUT;
411:                 }
412: 
413:               up_udelay(100);
414:             }
415: 
416:           i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD,
417:                      I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP | (*msg->buffer++));
418: 
419:           remaining -= burst;
420:         }
421: 
422:       /* 等待 STOP */
423: 
424:       timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_MS;
425:       while (!(i2c_getreg(base, I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & I2C_INTR_STOP_DET))
426:         {
427:           if (--timeout == 0)
428:             {
429:               return -ETIMEDOUT;
430:             }
431: 
432:           up_udelay(100);
433:         }
434:     }
435: 
436:   /* 清除中断 */
437: 
438:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xffff);
439: 
440:   return msg->length;
441: }

537:   /* 设置 SCL 时序 (APB0 = 100MHz) */
538: 
539:   d13x_i2c_set_speed(priv->base, D13X_APB0_FREQ);
540: 
541:   iinfo("I2C%d initialized at 0x%08" PRIx32 "\n", bus, priv->base);
542: 
543:   return &priv->dev;
544: }

<content>
1: # 适配 I2C Master 驱动
2: 
3: [ [English](../../../../../en/device_dev_guide/driver/bus_driver/I2C/i2c_master_guide.md) | 简体中文 ]
4: 
5: 本文档介绍如何为 openvela 适配一个标准的 I2C Master 驱动，使其能够作为总线主设备工作。
6: 
7: ## 一、驱动框架层级
8: 
9: I2C Master 驱动的开发涉及驱动层、板级层和应用层，它们之间的协作关系如下：
10: 
11: ### 驱动层 (Driver)
12: 
13: 负责实现芯片相关的 I2C 底层硬件操作。此层需要封装硬件细节，并向上层提供一个标准化的 `i2c_master_s` 句柄。
14: 
15: ```C
16: /* 1. 定义底层操作函数集 */
17: static const struct i2c_ops_s bl602_i2c_ops =
18: {
19:     .transfer = bl602_i2c_transfer,
20: #ifdef CONFIG_I2C_RESET
21:     .reset = bl602_i2c_reset
22: #endif
23: };
24: 
25: /* 2. 定义私有数据结构，包含操作函数集和配置信息 */
26: static struct bl602_i2c_priv_s bl602_i2c0_priv =
27: {
28:     .ops      = &bl602_i2c_ops,
29:     .config   = &bl602_i2c0_config,
30: };
31: 
32: /* 3. 实现初始化函数，返回标准的 I2C Master 句柄 */
33: struct i2c_master_s *bl602_i2cbus_initialize(int port)
34: {
35:     priv = (struct bl602_i2c_priv_s *)&bl602_i2c0_priv;
36:     
37:     return (struct i2c_master_s *)priv;
38: }
39: ```
40: 
41: ### 板级层 (Board)
42: 
43: 在系统启动阶段，调用驱动层的初始化函数获取 I2C 总线句柄。根据需求，可以选择性地将该总线注册为字符设备（如 `/dev/i2c-0`），或直接传递给其他内核驱动（如传感器驱动）使用。
44: 
45: ```C
46: /* 获取 I2C 总线句柄 */
47: i2c_bus = bl602_i2cbus_initialize(0);
48: 
49: /* 将总线注册为 /dev/i2c0 */
50: i2c_register(i2c_bus, 0);
51: ```
52: 
53: ### 应用层 (Application)
54: 
55: 通过标准的 POSIX 文件接口（`open`, `ioctl` 等）访问已注册的 `/dev/i2c-N` 设备节点，从而与挂载在总线上的 I2C 从设备通信。
56: 
57: ```C
58: fd = open("/dev/i2c", O_RDWR);
59: ioctl(fd, );
60: ...
61: ```
62: 
63: ## 二、适配南向接口 (Lower Half)
64: 
65: 南向接口适配的核心任务是实现芯片的底层驱动，并提供一个标准的初始化函数 `xxx_i2cbus_initialize()`，其中 `xxx` 代表芯片（Chip）名称。
66: 
67: ### 1、Kconfig 配置选项
68: 
69: 请在 Kconfig 中启用以下配置项以支持 I2C Master 驱动：
70: 
71: ```Makefile
72: CONFIG_I2C=y          # 必需，启用 I2C 子系统
73: CONFIG_I2C_DRIVER=y   # 必需，启用 I2C 字符设备驱动上层
74: CONFIG_I2C_RESET=y    # 可选，如果需要支持总线复位功能
75: ```
76: 
77: ### 2、核心数据结构
78: 
79: openvela I2C Master 驱动围绕 `struct i2c_master_s` 和 `struct i2c_ops_s` 这两个核心结构进行抽象。
80: 
81: ```C
82: /*
83:  * I2C Master 操作函数集。
84:  * 驱动开发者需要实现其中的函数指针，特别是 transfer 函数。
85:  */
86: struct i2c_ops_s
87: {
88:   /* 核心传输函数，必需 */
89:   CODE int (*transfer)(FAR struct i2c_master_s *dev,
90:                        FAR struct i2c_msg_s *msgs, int count);
91: #ifdef CONFIG_I2C_RESET
92:   /* 可选的总线复位函数 */
93:   CODE int (*reset)(FAR struct i2c_master_s *dev);
94: #endif
95: };
96: 
97: /*
98:  * I2C Master 设备句柄。
99:  * 这是南向驱动向上层提供的标准接口。
100:  * 开发者通常会定义一个包含此结构的私有设备结构体。
101:  */
102: struct i2c_master_s
103: {
104:   FAR const struct i2c_ops_s *ops; /* 指向操作函数集的指针 */
105: };
106: ```
107: 
108: ### 3、驱动入口函数说明
109: 
110: 您需要根据下表的要求，在芯片驱动文件（`xxx_i2c.c`）中实现 `xxx_i2cbus_initialize()` 函数。
111: 
112: | **项目**     | **描述**                                                                                                                                                             |
113: | :----------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
114: | **函数原型** | `struct i2c_master_s *xxx_i2cbus_initialize(int port)`                                                                                                               |
115: | **参数**     | `port`：I2C 总线端口号。如果芯片支持多路 I2C，您需要根据此参数进行多路配置。                                                                                         |
116: | **返回值**   | 返回一个标准的 `i2c_master_s` 操作句柄。如果初始化失败，则返回 `NULL`。                                                                                              |
117: | **实现内容** | 初始化 I2C 控制器所需的时钟和 GPIO。如果使用中断模式，还需配置并使能中断。填充并返回一个包含 `transfer` 函数指针的 `i2c_master_s` 句柄，用于处理上层的数据传输请求。 |
118: | **文件位置** | chip 路径下的 `xxx_i2c.c`，`xxx` 为 chip 名称。                                                                                                                      |
119: | **调用位置** | board 路径下的 `xxx_bringup.c` 里调用，`xxx` 为 `board` 名字。                                                                                                       |
120: 
121: ### 4、适配实现步骤
122: 
123: 本节通过代码示例，展示如何分步完成 I2C Master 驱动的适配。
124: 
125: - **参考实现**：[bl602_i2c.c](https://github.com/apache/nuttx/blob/master/arch/risc-v/src/bl602/bl602_i2c.c)
126: 
127: #### 步骤一：定义私有设备结构体
128: 
129: 我们强烈建议您定义一个私有结构体，用于封装 I2C 控制器的所有状态信息，例如配置、锁、信号量以及运行时数据等。以下是 `bl602` 芯片的私有结构体示例：
130: 
131: > **核心要点：结构体成员布局** 为确保类型安全转换，私有结构体的**第一个成员**必须是 `const struct i2c_ops_s *ops;`。这使得框架可以将您的私有结构体指针安全地转换为标准的 `struct i2c_master_s *` 句柄。
132: 
133: <details>
134: <summary>点击展开代码</summary>
135: 
136: ```C
137: /* 位于: arch/risc-v/src/bl602/bl602_i2c.c */
138: 
139: /* bl602 I2C 驱动的私有数据结构 */
140: struct bl602_i2c_priv_s
141: {
142:   /* 必须作为第一个成员，以兼容 i2c_master_s 类型转换 */
143:   const struct i2c_ops_s *ops; /* Standard I2C operations */
144: 
145:   /* 端口配置 */
146:   const struct bl602_i2c_config_s *config;
147: 
148:   /* 状态与同步机制 */
149:   uint8_t  subflag;   /* Sub address flag */
150:   uint32_t subaddr;   /* Sub address */
151:   uint8_t  sublen;    /* Sub address length */
152:   mutex_t  lock;      /* Mutual exclusion mutex */
153:   sem_t    sem_isr;   /* Interrupt wait semaphore */
154: 
155:   /* 运行时数据 */
156:   /* I2C work state */
157:   uint8_t i2cstate;
158: 
159:   struct i2c_msg_s *msgv; /* Message list */
160: 
161:   uint8_t msgid; /* Current message ID */
162:   ssize_t bytes; /* Processed data bytes */
163:   int     refs;  /* Reference count */
164: };
165: ```
166: 
167: </details>
168: 
169: #### 步骤二：实现初始化函数 `xxx_i2cbus_initialize()`
170: 
171: 此函数负责完成硬件初始化，并返回一个配置好的 I2C Master 句柄。
172: 
173: <details>
174: <summary>点击展开代码</summary>
175: 
176: ```C
177: struct i2c_master_s *bl602_i2cbus_initialize(int port)
178: {
179:   struct bl602_i2c_priv_s         *priv;
180:   const struct bl602_i2c_config_s *config;
181: 
182:   /* 1. 根据 port 号获取对应的私有设备实例 */
183:   switch (port)
184:     {
185: #ifdef CONFIG_BL602_I2C0
186:     case 0:
187:       priv = (struct bl602_i2c_priv_s *)&bl602_i2c0_priv;
188:       break;
189: #endif
190:     default:
191:       return NULL;
192:     }
193: 
194:   config = priv->config;
195: /*************************************************
196: 此部分是把IIC配置为中断，不配置中断可以把此部分替换成IIC GPIO以及时钟初始化
197:   
198:   nxmutex_lock(&priv->lock);
199:   if (++priv->refs > 1)
200:   {
201:     nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
202:     return (struct i2c_master_s *)priv;
203:   }
204: 
205:   bl602_configgpio(BOARD_I2C_SCL);
206:   bl602_configgpio(BOARD_I2C_SDA);
207: 
208:   bl602_i2c_set_freq(config->clk_freq);
209:   bl602_i2c_disable();
210:   up_enable_irq(BL602_IRQ_I2C);
211:   bl602_i2c_intmask(I2C_INT_ALL, 1);
212:   irq_attach(BL602_IRQ_I2C, bl602_i2c_irq, priv);
213: **************************************************/
214:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
215: 
216:    /* 2. 返回私有结构体指针，并强制转换为标准句柄类型 */
217:   return (struct i2c_master_s *)priv;
218: }
219: ```
220: 
221: </details>
222: 
223: #### 步骤三：在板级代码中调用
224: 
225: 在板级初始化代码（`xxx_bringup.c`）中，调用芯片驱动提供的初始化函数，并根据需要将 I2C 总线注册为系统设备。
226: 
227: - **参考实现**：[bl602_bringup.c](https://github.com/apache/nuttx/blob/master/boards/risc-v/bl602/bl602evb/src/bl602_bringup.c)
228: 
229: <details>
230: <summary>点击展开代码</summary>
231: 
232: ```C
233: #ifdef CONFIG_I2C
234:   /* 初始化 I2C 总线 0 */
235:   i2c_bus = bl602_i2cbus_initialize(0);
236:   
237:   /* 2. (可选) 将总线注册为 /dev/i2c-0 设备节点 */
238:   i2c_register(i2c_bus, 0);
239: #endif
240: ```
241: 
242: </details>
243: 
244: **`i2c_register()`** **使用说明**
245: 
246: - **注册为设备节点**：调用 `i2c_register(i2c_bus, N)` 会创建字符设备节点 `/dev/i2c-N`。这使得用户空间应用（如测试程序、`i2ctool`）能通过标准文件接口访问 I2C 总线。
247: - **仅供内核使用**：如果某个 I2C 总线仅供内核中的其他驱动（如板载传感器）使用，您可以不调用 `i2c_register()`。直接将 `i2c_bus` 句柄传递给相应驱动的注册函数即可。
248: 
249: ## 三、北向使用
250: 
251: 当 I2C Master 驱动被成功注册后，系统会创建 `/dev/i2c-N` 格式的设备节点（例如 `/dev/i2c-0`, `/dev/i2c-1` 等）。应用程序可以通过这些设备节点，使用标准的 POSIX 文件接口与挂载在 I2C 总线上的从设备进行通信。
252: 
253: ### 1、API 列表
254: 
255: I2C 设备节点支持以下标准文件操作接口：
256: 
257: | **API**                                                  | **描述**                                                                |
258: | :------------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
259: | `int open(FAR const char *path, int oflag, ...);`        | 打开 I2C 设备节点，例如 `"/dev/i2c-0"`。                                |
260: | `int  close(int `*`fd`*`);`                              | 关闭已打开的设备文件描述符。                                            |
261: | `int ioctl(int fd, int req, ...)`                        | **核心通信接口**。通过发送特定命令来执行 I2C 读写、总线复位等复杂操作。 |
262: | `ssize_t read(int fd, ...)` `ssize_t write(int fd, ...)` | **暂未使用**。                                                          |
263: 
264: ### 2、`ioctl()` 核心接口
265: 
266: `ioctl()` 是与 I2C 设备进行数据交互的主要方式。openvela 定义了以下标准 `ioctl` 命令：
267: 
268: #### `I2CIOC_TRANSFER`
269: 
270: 执行一次或多次 I2C 消息传输。这是最核心、最常用的命令。它使用 `struct i2c_transfer_s` 结构体来描述整个传输任务。
271: 
272: ```C
273: /* 定义一个 I2C 传输任务，可包含一个或多个消息 */
274: struct i2c_transfer_s
275: {
276:   FAR struct i2c_msg_s *msgv; /* Array of I2C messages for the transfer */
277:   size_t msgc;                /* Number of messages in the array. */
278: };
279: ```
280: 
281: 每个 I2C 消息由 `struct i2c_msg_s` 定义，用于描述单次读或写操作：
282: 
283: ```C
284: #define I2C_M_READ           0x0001 /* Read data, from slave to master */
285: #define I2C_M_NOSTOP         0x0040 /* Message should not end with a STOP */
286: #define I2C_M_NOSTART        0x0080 /* Message should not begin with a START */
287: 
288: struct i2c_msg_s
289: {
290:   uint32_t frequency;         /* I2C frequency */
291:   uint16_t addr;              /* Slave address (7- or 10-bit) */
292:   uint16_t flags;             /* See I2C_M_* definitions */
293:   FAR uint8_t *buffer;        /* Buffer to be transferred */
294:   ssize_t length;             /* Length of the buffer in bytes */
295: };
296: ```
297: 
298: #### `CONFIG_I2C_RESET`
299: 
300: 复位 I2C 总线。此命令在总线锁死或出现异常时非常有用。要使用此功能，必须在 Kconfig 中启用 `CONFIG_I2C_RESET`。调用时无需第三个参数。
301: 
302: ### 3、复合传输示例：读取传感器寄存器
303: 
304: 本节提供一个完整的示例，演示如何执行一次**复合传输 (Combined Transfer)** 来读取 I2C 设备的寄存器值。这是与 I2C 传感器等设备通信的典型场景，其过程分为两步：
305: 
306: 1. **写操作**：向从设备发送要读取的**寄存器地址**。
307: 2. **读操作**：紧接着从该寄存器**读取数据**。
308: 
309: #### 步骤一：Kconfig 配置
310: 
311: 确保您的项目中已启用以下配置：
312: 
313: ```Makefile
314: CONFIG_I2C=y
315: CONFIG_I2C_DRIVER=y
316: ```
317: 
318: #### 步骤二：读写示例代码
319: 
320: 以下代码从指定的 I2C 从机地址和寄存器地址读取一个字节的数据。
321: 
322: <details>
323: <summary>点击展开代码</summary>
324: 
325: ```C
326: #include <stdio.h>
327: #include <fcntl.h>
328: #include <sys/types.h>
329: #include <sys/stat.h>
330: #include <sys/ioctl.h>
331: #include <nuttx/i2c/i2c_master.h>
332: 
333: // 含义：使用 /dev/i2c-8，访问从机地址 0x68，读取寄存器 0x00 的值
334: //./i2c_test.out /dev/i2c-8 0x68 0x60
335: 
336: 
337: int main(int argc, char **argv)
338: {
339:   int fd,ret;
340:   uint8_t val;
341:   char dev_name[20];
342:   unsigned int slave_address,reg_address;
343:   struct i2c_transfer_s work;
344: 
345:   snprintf(dev_name, sizeof(dev_name),"%s", argv[1]);
346: 
347:   /* 1. 打开 I2C 设备节点 */
348:   fd = open(dev_name, O_RDWR);
349:   if (fd < 0)
350:    {
351:      printf("open failed: %d\n", fd);
352:      return fd;
353:    }
354: 
355:   /* 2. 准备 I2C 消息 */
356:   work.msgc = 2;
357:   work.msgv = (struct i2c_msg_s *)malloc(work.msgc * sizeof(struct i2c_msg_s));
358:   if (NULL == work.msgv)
359:     {
360:       printf("Memory alloc error\n");
361:       close(fd);
362:       return -1;
363:     }
364: 
365:   sscanf(argv[2], "%x", &slave_address);
366:   sscanf(argv[3], "%x", &reg_address);
367: 
368:   val = reg_address;
369:   /* 消息 1: 写操作，发送要读取的寄存器地址 */
370:   (work.msgv[0]).frequency=400000;
371:   (work.msgv[0]).length = 1;
372:   (work.msgv[0]).addr = slave_address;
373:   (work.msgv[0]).buffer = &val;
374:   (work.msgv[0]).flags = I2C_M_NOSTOP;
375: 
376:   /* 消息 2: 读操作，从设备读取一个字节的数据 */
377:   (work.msgv[1]).frequency=400000;
378:   (work.msgv[1]).length = 1;
379:   (work.msgv[1]).flags = I2C_M_READ;
380:   (work.msgv[1]).addr = slave_address;
381:   (work.msgv[1]).buffer = &val;
382: 
383:   /* 3. 执行 ioctl 调用，发起传输 */
384:   ret = ioctl(fd, I2CIOC_TRANSFER, &work);
385:   if (ret < 0)
386:   {
387:      printf("i2c: ioctl(I2CIOC_TRANSFER) failed: %d\n",fd);
388:      free( work.msgv);
389:      close(fd);
390:      return -1;
391:   }
392: 
393:   printf("reg:0x%02X val:%02x\n", reg_address, val);
394:   free( work.msgv);
395:   close(fd);
396: 
397:   return 0;
398: }
399: ```
400: 
401: </details>
402: 
403: ## 四、验证与测试
404: 
405: - 请参考 [I2C 驱动的验证与调试](./i2c_verification_guide.md)来测试您的驱动。

(End of file - total 405 lines)

# 适配 I2C Master 驱动

[ [English](../../../../../en/device_dev_guide/driver/bus_driver/I2C/i2c_master_guide.md) | 简体中文 ]

本文档介绍如何为 openvela 适配一个标准的 I2C Master 驱动，使其能够作为总线主设备工作。

## 一、驱动框架层级

I2C Master 驱动的开发涉及驱动层、板级层和应用层，它们之间的协作关系如下：

### 驱动层 (Driver)

负责实现芯片相关的 I2C 底层硬件操作。此层需要封装硬件细节，并向上层提供一个标准化的 `i2c_master_s` 句柄。

```C
/* 1. 定义底层操作函数集 */
static const struct i2c_ops_s bl602_i2c_ops =
{

# 开始 I2C 驱动适配

[ [English](../../../../../en/device_dev_guide/driver/bus_driver/I2C/i2c_overview.md) | 简体中文 ]

本指南是 openvela I2C 驱动开发的中心入口，旨在为驱动开发者和应用工程师提供一个清晰、全面的学习路径。无论您是需要将新的 I2C 控制器移植到 openvela 内核，还是希望在应用层与 I2C 设备通信，都能在这里找到所需的指引。

## 一、基础概念

在深入驱动适配细节之前，本章将介绍 I2C 总线的基本原理以及 openvela 系统中 I2C 驱动的通用分层模型，帮助您快速建立整体认知。

### 1、I2C 总线简介

I2C (Inter-Integrated Circuit) 是一种简单、双向、半双工的串行总线，最初由 Philips (现 NXP) 公司设计。它仅需两根信号线即可实现设备间的通信，因此在嵌入式系统中被广泛用于连接微控制器 (MCU) 与外围设备（如传感器、EEPROM、RTC 等）。

**核心特性：**

- **两线制**：

    - `SCL` (Serial Clock): 串行时钟线，由主设备产生，用于同步数据传输。
    - `SDA` (Serial Data): 串行数据线，用于传输数据。

**⚠️ DE 寄存器位域布局无法完全验证** (行 223-243)

代码将 HBP 放入 bits 31:24, HFP 放入 bits 23:12, HSYNC 放入 bits 11:0。由于 D13x DE 寄存器手册未在本项目文档中提供详细位域表 (仅在 `D13x User Manual §9.3 DE` 中)，无法确认这些偏移是否精确。建议对照 luban-lite 的 `aic_hal_de.c` 交叉验证。

**✅ DE_TIMING_SYNC_PLUSE 布局合理** (行 233-234)

`(HSYNC << 16) | VSYNC` 将水平/垂直同步脉冲宽度分开放在高/低 16 位，是常见的 DE 寄存器布局。

---

### 3. 初始化顺序

**✅ 顺序正确** (行 370-376)

```c
d13x_pll_disp_init();      // 1. PLL 锁定
d13x_de_clk_enable();      // 2. DE 时钟使能
d13x_lvds_clk_enable();    // 3. LVDS 时钟使能
d13x_de_timing_enable();   // 4. DE 时序配置
d13x_lvds_phy_enable();    // 5. LVDS PHY 使能
```

符合 Display Engine → 时钟 → 时序 → PHY 的正确硬件初始化顺序。PLL 必须先锁定，DE 时钟必须在时序配置前使能，PHY 最后开启。

**⚠️ 但第 1 步的返回值被忽略** (同上第 1 项 BUG)

**❌ LVDS_1_SWAP (0x24) — 官方文档无此寄存器** (行 68, 使用于行 249)

官方寄存器表 (register.html §10.5.3) 只定义了:
- 0x020: LVDS_SWAP (通道交换)
- 0x028: LVDS_POL_CTL (极性控制)
- 0x030: LVDS_PHY_CTL (物理层控制)

偏移 0x024 (LVDS_1_SWAP) **不存在于官方文档**。写入该地址可能修改未定义的硬件状态。

**❌ LVDS_1_POL_CTL (0x2C) — 官方文档无此寄存器** (行 70, 使用于行 251)

同理，0x02C 在官方寄存器表中无对应条目。

**❌ LVDS_1_PHY_CTL (0x34) — 官方文档无此寄存器** (行 72, 使用于行 253)

0x034 在官方寄存器表中无对应条目。官方仅描述了 "LVDS通道0物理层控制" (0x030)。

**⚠️ LVDS_CTL 未文档化位域** (行 76-82)

官方文档 (LVDS_CTL 0x000) 仅定义了:
- bits 9:8 — LVDS_MODE
- bit 1 — SYNC_MODE_EN
- bit 0 — LVDS_EN

代码中使用的 `LVDS_CTL_LINK` (bits 5:4) 和 `LVDS_CTL_SWAP_EN` (bit 2) 均为 **官方文档中的保留位** (标记为 "-")。这些可能是芯片未公开的扩展功能，但在驱动中使用未文档化位存在风险。

**✅ 已文档化的寄存器偏移正确**:
- LVDS_CTL (0x00) ✅
- LVDS_CK_CFG (0x10) ✅
- LVDS_0_SWAP (0x20) ✅
- LVDS_0_POL_CTL (0x28) ✅
- LVDS_0_PHY_CTL (0x30) ✅

- `waitforvsync` (CONFIG_FB_SYNC) — 未实现，可能导致屏幕撕裂

这些是可选功能，缺失不会导致编译错误，但会限制驱动功能。

### 6. fb_register 错误处理

**✅ up_fbinitialize 返回类型正确** (行 346)

```c
int up_fbinitialize(int display)
```

返回 `int`，失败时返回 `-ENOMEM` (行 365)，成功返回 `OK` (行 385)。`fb_register()` 会检查此返回值 (参考 Framebuffer_Driver.md 第 73-79 行)。

337:   .getvideoinfo = d13x_fb_getvideoinfo,
338:   .getplaneinfo = d13x_fb_getplaneinfo,
339:   .pandisplay  = d13x_fb_pandisplay,
340: };
341: 
342: /****************************************************************************
343:  * Public Functions - NuttX FB 平台接口
344:  ****************************************************************************/
345: 
346: int up_fbinitialize(int display)
347: {
348:   struct d13x_lvds_dev_s *dev = &g_lvds_dev;
349: 
350:   if (dev->initialized)
351:     {
352:       return OK;
353:     }
354: 
355:   dev->base   = D13X_LVDS_BASE;
356:   dev->pixclk = PANEL_PIXELCLOCK;
357:   dev->fblen  = FB_SIZE;
358: 
359:   /* 分配帧缓冲内存（PSRAM 区域，cacheable） */
360: 
361:   dev->fbmem = kumm_memalign(64, dev->fblen);
362:   if (dev->fbmem == NULL)
363:     {
364:       ierr("Failed to allocate framebuffer (%zu bytes)\n", dev->fblen);
365:       return -ENOMEM;
366:     }
367: 
368:   memset(dev->fbmem, 0, dev->fblen);
369: 
370:   /* 显示管线初始化: PLL → DE时钟 → LVDS时钟 → DE时序 → LVDS PHY */
371: 
372:   d13x_pll_disp_init();
373:   d13x_de_clk_enable();
374:   d13x_lvds_clk_enable();
375:   d13x_de_timing_enable();
376:   d13x_lvds_phy_enable();
377: 
378:   dev->initialized = true;
379: 
380:   iinfo("LVDS FB: %dx%d @ %luMHz, fbmem=%p, fblen=%zu\n",
381:         PANEL_HACTIVE, PANEL_VACTIVE,
382:         (unsigned long)(dev->pixclk / 1000000),
383:         dev->fbmem, dev->fblen);
384: 
385:   return OK;
386: }
387: 
388: FAR struct fb_vtable_s *up_fbgetvplane(int display, int vplane)
389: {
390:   if (display == 0 && vplane == 0)
391:     {
392:       return (FAR struct fb_vtable_s *)&g_fb_vtable;
393:     }
394: 
395:   return NULL;
396: }
397: 
398: void up_fbuninitialize(int display)
399: {
400:   struct d13x_lvds_dev_s *dev = &g_lvds_dev;
401: 
402:   d13x_lvds_disable();
403: 
404:   if (dev->fbmem != NULL)
405:     {
406:       kumm_free(dev->fbmem);
407:       dev->fbmem = NULL;
408:     }
409: 
410:   dev->initialized = false;
411: }
