1: # Framebuffer 驱动
2: 
3: \[ [English](../../../en/device_dev_guide/graphics/Framebuffer_Driver.md) | 简体中文 \]
4: 
5: ## 一、什么是 Framebuffer
6: 
7: Framebuffer（帧缓存/显存）是一个用于存储一帧 LCD 图像数据的内存区域。在嵌入式系统中，Framebuffer 通常通过内存模拟实现，其大小由 LCD 的分辨率和每个像素的字节大小决定。
8: 
9: ### 1、Framebuffer 的大小计算
10: 
11: 以 480x320 的屏幕为例，在不同像素模式下，Framebuffer 的大小如下：
12: 
13: 1. ARGB888 (32bpp)：
14: 
15:     - 计算公式：`480 x 320 x 4 (bytes)`
16:     - 大小：614,400 字节
17: 
18: 2. RGB565 (16bpp)：
19: 
20:     - 计算公式：`480 x 320 x 2 (bytes)`
21:     - 大小：307,200 字节
22: 
23: ## 二、Framebuffer的显示原理
24: 
25: Framebuffer 的显示原理可以概括为：LCD 控制器（LCDC）从 Framebuffer 中读取像素数据，并通过并行数据接口将数据传输到 LCD 面板进行显示。
26: 
27: ### 1、显示流程图
28: 
29: 以下是 Framebuffer 的显示流程：
30: 
31: ![img](./figures/012.svg)
32: 
33: - Framebuffer：存储像素数据。
34: - LCDC：从 Framebuffer 中读取像素数据，并将其传输到 LCD 面板。
35: - LCD Panel：接收数据并显示图像。
36: 
37: ### 2、数据传输接口
38: 
39: LCDC 通过以下信号将数据传输到 LCD 面板：
40: 
41: - Clock：时钟信号，用于同步数据传输。
42: - Data：像素数据，包括 R（红）、G（绿）、B（蓝）三种颜色通道。
43: - Control：控制信号，用于管理数据传输的时序和状态。
44: 
45: ## 三、openvela Framebuffer 接口
46: 
47: openvela 的 Framebuffer 接口分为上层用户接口和下层驱动接口，分别为用户和设备驱动程序提供了灵活的操作能力。以下是接口的详细说明。
48: 
49: ### 1、上层用户接口
50: 
51: openvela 的 Framebuffer 用户接口类似于 Linux 系统，通过 VFS（虚拟文件系统）提供标准操作接口，包括 `open`、`close`、`read`、`write` 和 `ioctl` 等。用户可以通过操作 `/dev/fbx` 设备文件，完成以下功能：
52: 
53: 1. 映射 Framebuffer 到用户态：
54: 
55:     使用 `mmap` 将 Framebuffer 映射到用户空间，便于直接对 Framebuffer 进行读写操作。
56: 
57: 2. 切换 Framebuffer：
58: 
59:     用户可以通过 `ioctl` 接口切换不同的 Framebuffer 配置或模式。
60: 
61: ### 2、下层驱动接口
62: 
63: openvela 的 Framebuffer 驱动接口用于管理 LCD 设备，设计相对简单。开发者可以参考 [video/fb.h](../../../../../../nuttx/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/include/nuttx/video/fb.h) 和 [/drivers/video/fb.c](../../../../../../nuttx/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/drivers/video/fb.c) 文件中的实现。以下是 `fb_register()` 函数的源码，展示了与 Framebuffer 设备驱动相关的重要部分：
64: 
65: ```C
66: int fb_register(int display, int plane)
67: {
68:   FAR struct fb_chardev_s *fb;
69: 
70:   ...
71: 
72:   /* Initialize the frame buffer device. */
73:   ret = up_fbinitialize(display);
74:   if (ret < 0)
75:     {
76:       gerr("ERROR: up_fbinitialize() failed for display %d: %d\n",
77:            display, ret);
78:       goto errout_with_fb;
79:     }
80:   DEBUGASSERT((unsigned)plane <= UINT8_MAX);
81:   fb->plane  = plane;
82:   fb->vtable = up_fbgetvplane(display, plane);
83:   if (fb->vtable == NULL)
84:     {
85:       gerr("ERROR: up_fbgetvplane() failed, vplane=%d\n", plane);
86:       goto errout_with_fb;
87:     }
88:   /* Initialize the frame buffer instance. */
89:   ...
90: 
91:   ret = register_driver(devname, &fb_fops, 0666, (FAR void *)fb);
92:   if (ret < 0)
93:     {
94:       gerr("ERROR: register_driver() failed: %d\n", ret);
95:       goto errout_with_fb;
96:     }
97:   return OK;
98:   
99: errout_with_fb:
100:   kmm_free(fb);
101:   return ret;
102: }
103: ```
104: 
105: 从代码中可以看出，Framebuffer 针对 LCD 设备驱动程序提供了以下 3 个接口，驱动程序需要自行实现：
106: 
107: 1. `void up_fbinitialize(int display)`
108: 
109:     - 用于初始化硬件 LCD 控制器。
110:     - 例如，在 STM32 平台上，`up_fbinitialize` 函数需要初始化 LTDC（LCD-TFT 控制器）或 MIPI 接口，并完成 DSI 外设和 LCD IC 的初始化。
111: 
112: 2. `FAR struct fb_vtable_s *up_fbgetvplane(int display, int vplane)`
113: 
114:     - 获取 LCD 的 `fb_vtable_s` 结构体信息。
115:     - `fb_vtable_s` 是 Framebuffer 的核心结构，包含了 Framebuffer 的所有接口。通过实现该函数，LCD 控制器可以将自身信息注册到 Framebuffer 框架中。
116:     - 驱动程序可以参考以下示例实现：
117: 
118:         - `drivers/video/vnc/vnc_fbdev.c`
119:         - `boards/arm/stm32f7/stm32f746g-disco/stm32_lcd.c`
120: 
121: 3. `void up_fbuninitialize(int display)`
122: 
123:     - 执行与 `up_fbinitialize` 相反的操作，用于释放资源。通常可以实现为空，不执行任何操作。
124: 
125: ### 3、`struct fb_vtable_s` 结构
126: 
127: `fb_vtable_s` 是 Framebuffer 的核心结构，定义了与视频硬件交互的接口。以下是其主要功能模块：
128: 
129: 1. 核心功能。
130: 
131:     - `getvideoinfo`：获取视频控制器配置和颜色平面信息。
132:     - `getplaneinfo`：获取指定颜色平面的信息。
133: 
134: 2. 可选功能（根据配置启用）。
135: 
136:     - 颜色映射（`CONFIG_FB_CMAP`）：
137:         - `getcmap`：获取当前颜色映射表。
138:         - `putcmap`：更新颜色映射表。
139:     - 硬件光标（`CONFIG_FB_HWCURSOR`）：
140:         - `getcursor`：获取光标属性。
141:         - `setcursor`：设置光标配置。
142:     - 显示更新（`CONFIG_FB_UPDATE`）：
143:         - `updatearea`：通知硬件更新指定显示区域。
144:     - 垂直同步（`CONFIG_FB_SYNC`）：
145:         - `waitforvsync`：等待垂直同步信号，避免屏幕撕裂。
146:     - 叠加管理（`CONFIG_FB_OVERLAY`）：
147:         - `getoverlayinfo`：获取叠加层的配置信息。
148:         - `settransp`：设置叠加层的透明度。
149:         - `setchromakey`：设置叠加层的色键。
150:         - `setcolor`：用指定颜色填充叠加层。
151:         - `setblank`：启用或禁用叠加层。
152:         - `setarea`：设置叠加操作的活动区域。
153:         - 叠加层的 Blit 和 Blend 操作（`CONFIG_FB_OVERLAY_BLIT`）：
154:             - `blit`：在叠加层之间执行 Blit 操作。
155:             - `blend`：在叠加层之间执行 Blend 操作。
156: 
157: 3. 其他控制功能。
158: 
159:     - 显示平移：
160:         - `pandisplay`：为多缓冲区显示执行平移操作。
161:     - 帧率控制：
162:         - `setframerate`：设置 Framebuffer 的刷新率。
163:         - `getframerate`：获取当前刷新率。
164:     - 电源管理：
165:         - `getpower`：获取面板的电源状态。
166:         - `setpower`：启用或禁用面板电源。
167: 
168: #### 示例代码
169: 
170: 以下是 `struct fb_vtable_s` 的部分定义示例：
171: 
172: ```C
173: struct fb_vtable_s
174: {
175:   /* Get information about the video controller configuration and the
176:    * configuration of each color plane.
177:    */
178: 
179:   int (*getvideoinfo)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
180:                       FAR struct fb_videoinfo_s *vinfo);
181:   int (*getplaneinfo)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable, int planeno,
182:                       FAR struct fb_planeinfo_s *pinfo);
183: 
184: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_CMAP
185:   /* The following are provided only if the video hardware supports RGB
186:    * color mapping
187:    */
188: 
189:   int (*getcmap)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
190:                  FAR struct fb_cmap_s *cmap);
191:   int (*putcmap)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
192:                  FAR const struct fb_cmap_s *cmap);
193: #endif
194: 
195: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_HWCURSOR
196:   /* The following are provided only if the video hardware supports a
197:    * hardware cursor.
198:    */
199: 
200:   int (*getcursor)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
201:                    FAR struct fb_cursorattrib_s *attrib);
202:   int (*setcursor)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
203:                    FAR struct fb_setcursor_s *settings);
204: #endif
205: 
206: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_UPDATE
207:   /* The following are provided only if the video hardware need extera
208:    * notification to update display content.
209:    */
210: 
211:   int (*updatearea)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
212:                     FAR const struct fb_area_s *area);
213: #endif
214: 
215: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_SYNC
216:   /* The following are provided only if the video hardware signals
217:    * vertical sync.
218:    */
219: 
220:   int (*waitforvsync)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable);
221: #endif
222: 
223: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_OVERLAY
224:   /* Get information about the video controller configuration and the
225:    * configuration of each overlay.
226:    */
227: 
228:   int (*getoverlayinfo)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable, int overlayno,
229:                         FAR struct fb_overlayinfo_s *oinfo);
230: 
231:   /* The following are provided only if the video hardware supports
232:    * transparency
233:    */
234: 
235:   int (*settransp)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
236:                    FAR const struct fb_overlayinfo_s *oinfo);
237: 
238:   /* The following are provided only if the video hardware supports
239:    * chromakey
240:    */
241: 
242:   int (*setchromakey)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
243:                       FAR const struct fb_overlayinfo_s *oinfo);
244: 
245:   /* The following are provided only if the video hardware supports
246:    * filling the overlay with a color.
247:    */
248: 
249:   int (*setcolor)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
250:                   FAR const struct fb_overlayinfo_s *oinfo);
251: 
252:   /* The following allows to switch the overlay on or off */
253: 
254:   int (*setblank)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
255:                   FAR const struct fb_overlayinfo_s *oinfo);
256: 
257:   /* The following allows to set the active area for subsequently overlay
258:    * operations.
259:    */
260: 
261:   int (*setarea)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
262:                  FAR const struct fb_overlayinfo_s *oinfo);
263: 
264: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_OVERLAY_BLIT
265:   /* The following are provided only if the video hardware supports
266:    * blit operation between overlays.
267:    */
268: 
269:   int (*blit)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
270:               FAR const struct fb_overlayblit_s *blit);
271: 
272:   /* The following are provided only if the video hardware supports
273:    * blend operation between overlays.
274:    */
275: 
276:   int (*blend)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
277:                FAR const struct fb_overlayblend_s *blend);
278: #endif
279: 
280:   /* Pan display for multiple buffers. */
281: 
282:   int (*pandisplay)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
283:                     FAR struct fb_planeinfo_s *pinfo);
284: 
285:   /* Specific Controls ******************************************************/
286: 
287:   /* Set the frequency of the Framebuffer update panel (0: disable refresh) */
288: 
289:   int (*setframerate)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable, int rate);
290: 
291:   /* Get the frequency of the Framebuffer update panel (0: disable refresh) */
292: 
293:   int (*getframerate)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable);
294: 
295:   /* Get the panel power status (0: full off). */
296: 
297:   int (*getpower)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable);
298: 
299:   /* Enable/disable panel power (0: full off). */
300: 
301:   int (*setpower)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable, int power);
302: };
303: ```
304: 
305: 开发者可以根据具体硬件需求实现这些接口，以满足 Framebuffer 的功能需求。
306: 
307: ## 四、启用 Framebuffer
308: 
309: 启用 Framebuffer 需要完成以下步骤：
310: 
311: ### 1、开启 Framebuffer 编译选项
312: 
313: 在配置文件中启用以下选项：
314: 
315: ```makefile
316: CONFIG_VIDEO_FB  
317: ```
318: 
319: ### 2、注册 Framebuffer
320: 
321: 在系统启动的初始化阶段，调用 `fb_register` 函数注册 Framebuffer。以下是示例代码：
322: 
323: ```C
324: #include <nuttx/video/fb.h>  
325: 
326: #ifdef CONFIG_VIDEO_FB  
327:     ret = fb_register(0, 0);  
328:     if (ret < 0)  
329:     {  
330:         syslog(LOG_ERR, "ERROR fb_register() failed: %d\n", ret);  
331:     }  
332: #endif
333: ```
334: 
335: ### 3、处理 VSync
336:

# Framebuffer 驱动

\[ [English](../../../en/device_dev_guide/graphics/Framebuffer_Driver.md) | 简体中文 \]

## 一、什么是 Framebuffer

Framebuffer（帧缓存/显存）是一个用于存储一帧 LCD 图像数据的内存区域。在嵌入式系统中，Framebuffer 通常通过内存模拟实现，其大小由 LCD 的分辨率和每个像素的字节大小决定。

### 1、Framebuffer 的大小计算

以 480x320 的屏幕为例，在不同像素模式下，Framebuffer 的大小如下：

1. ARGB888 (32bpp)：

    - 计算公式：`480 x 320 x 4 (bytes)`
    - 大小：614,400 字节

2. RGB565 (16bpp)：

    - 计算公式：`480 x 320 x 2 (bytes)`

10.5.2.1. 功能实现¶

366:

由DE模块输入的DI[23:0]、DE/HS/VS/CK信号（其中差分CK信号由寄存器配置，使用默认值即可）进到2C1处理输出信号选择DATA[34:0]，这里控制差分输出LVDS[4:0]，图 lvds_format。

367:

并行信号转换为差分信号格式：需要两个不同时钟控制，串行时钟SCLK的频率为并行时钟PCLK的7倍。

368:

SCLK的第一个cycle,并行信号的G0/B1/DE/CK6/NA分别给到LVDS_D0/ LVDS_D1/ LVDS_D2/ LVDS_CK/ LVDS_D3的第一位；

369:

SCLK的第二个cycle,并行信号的R5/B0/VS/CK5/NA给到LVDS_D0/ LVDS_D1/ LVDS_D2/ LVDS_CK/ LVDS_D3第二位；

370:

以此类推进行7个SCLK cycle数据转换，等到下一个PCLK cycle到达，并行信号同时更新，LVDS信号按照同样的方式转换。

I have all the information needed. Here is the complete second-round review.

---

## D13x LVDS/Framebuffer 驱动第二轮审核报告

**审核文件**: `artinchip_lvds.c` (411行)

### 1. PLL_FRA2 配置 (寄存器地址、位域、锁定等待)

**❌ BUG — PLL_FRA2_F 位域与 EN/LOCK 重叠** (行 37-42)

```
行 37: #define PLL_FRA2_EN            (1 << 16)   // bit 16
行 38: #define PLL_FRA2_LOCK          (1 << 17)   // bit 17
行 41: #define PLL_FRA2_F_SHIFT       16
行 42: #define PLL_FRA2_F_MASK        (0x3FFF << 16)  // 覆盖 bits 16-29
```

F 字段从 bit 16 开始，14 位宽 (bits 16-29)，完全覆盖了 EN (bit 16) 和 LOCK (bit 17)。行 176 的 mask `reg &= ~PLL_FRA2_F_MASK` 会同时清除 EN/LOCK，然后行 179 的 `reg |= PLL_FRA2_EN` 又将 EN 写回——对当前使用的 F=0x2000 值恰好不冲突 (0x2000 << 16 = bit 29)，但位定义本身是错误的。参考 `artinchip_start.c:41-44`，PLL_INTx 的 EN 在 bit 16，FRA2 的 F 字段不应从 bit 16 开始。正确偏移应为 bit 13 或更高位。

**⚠️ PLL 频率注释与实际不符** (行 127-131)

```
行 127: /* PLL_FRA2 频率: 24MHz × 15.25 ≈ 364MHz */
行 130: #define PLL_FRA2_N_VALUE       14
行 131: #define PLL_FRA2_F_VALUE       0x2000
```

实际: N+1=15, F/16384 = 8192/16384 = 0.5, 总倍频 = 15.5, 输出 = 24 × 15.5 = **372MHz**，注释写的是 15.25 ≈ 364MHz。注释有误。

**⚠️ PLL 锁定检查使用 INT 寄存器，但 GEN 的 LOCK 位也定义了却未使用** (行 46 vs 185)

行 46 定义了 `PLL_FRA2_LOCK (1 << 17)` 用于 GEN 寄存器 (0x0028)，但行 185 读取的是 INT 寄存器 (0x002C) 的 `PLL_FRA2_INT_LOCK`。两者都检查 bit 17，逻辑上可行，但 `PLL_FRA2_LOCK` 宏定义成了死代码。

**❌ PLL 返回值未检查** (行 372)

```c
d13x_pll_disp_init();   // 返回 -ETIMEDOUT 或 OK，被忽略
d13x_de_clk_enable();
```

如果 PLL 锁定超时，后续仍会继续配置 DE/LVDS 时钟和 PHY，使用未锁定的 PLL 输出，可能导致显示异常或硬件行为不可预测。应检查返回值并在失败时跳过后续初始化。

---

### 2. DE DPI 时序参数 (1024×600)

**✅ 时序值正确** (行 111-121)

```
PANEL_HACTIVE=1024, PANEL_VACTIVE=600
HBP=160, HFP=160, HSYNC=20, VBP=23, VFP=12, VSYNC=3
```

这些值与 luban-lite panel_simple.c 中 1024×600 面板的标准时序一致。

**⚠️ DE 寄存器位域布局无法完全验证** (行 223-243)

代码将 HBP 放入 bits 31:24, HFP 放入 bits 23:12, HSYNC 放入 bits 11:0。由于 D13x DE 寄存器手册未在本项目文档中提供详细位域表 (仅在 `D13x User Manual §9.3 DE` 中)，无法确认这些偏移是否精确。建议对照 luban-lite 的 `aic_hal_de.c` 交叉验证。

**✅ DE_TIMING_SYNC_PLUSE 布局合理** (行 233-234)

`(HSYNC << 16) | VSYNC` 将水平/垂直同步脉冲宽度分开放在高/低 16 位，是常见的 DE 寄存器布局。

---

### 3. 初始化顺序

**✅ 顺序正确** (行 370-376)

```c
d13x_pll_disp_init();      // 1. PLL 锁定
d13x_de_clk_enable();      // 2. DE 时钟使能
d13x_lvds_clk_enable();    // 3. LVDS 时钟使能
d13x_de_timing_enable();   // 4. DE 时序配置
d13x_lvds_phy_enable();    // 5. LVDS PHY 使能
```

符合 Display Engine → 时钟 → 时序 → PHY 的正确硬件初始化顺序。PLL 必须先锁定，DE 时钟必须在时序配置前使能，PHY 最后开启。

**⚠️ 但第 1 步的返回值被忽略** (同上第 1 项 BUG)

---

### 4. LVDS 寄存器偏移 vs 文档

**❌ LVDS_1_SWAP (0x24) — 官方文档无此寄存器** (行 68, 使用于行 249)

官方寄存器表 (register.html §10.5.3) 只定义了:
- 0x020: LVDS_SWAP (通道交换)
- 0x028: LVDS_POL_CTL (极性控制)
- 0x030: LVDS_PHY_CTL (物理层控制)

偏移 0x024 (LVDS_1_SWAP) **不存在于官方文档**。写入该地址可能修改未定义的硬件状态。

**❌ LVDS_1_POL_CTL (0x2C) — 官方文档无此寄存器** (行 70, 使用于行 251)

同理，0x02C 在官方寄存器表中无对应条目。

**❌ LVDS_1_PHY_CTL (0x34) — 官方文档无此寄存器** (行 72, 使用于行 253)

0x034 在官方寄存器表中无对应条目。官方仅描述了 "LVDS通道0物理层控制" (0x030)。

**⚠️ LVDS_CTL 未文档化位域** (行 76-82)

官方文档 (LVDS_CTL 0x000) 仅定义了:
- bits 9:8 — LVDS_MODE
- bit 1 — SYNC_MODE_EN
- bit 0 — LVDS_EN

代码中使用的 `LVDS_CTL_LINK` (bits 5:4) 和 `LVDS_CTL_SWAP_EN` (bit 2) 均为 **官方文档中的保留位** (标记为 "-")。这些可能是芯片未公开的扩展功能，但在驱动中使用未文档化位存在风险。

**✅ 已文档化的寄存器偏移正确**:
- LVDS_CTL (0x00) ✅
- LVDS_CK_CFG (0x10) ✅
- LVDS_0_SWAP (0x20) ✅
- LVDS_0_POL_CTL (0x28) ✅
- LVDS_0_PHY_CTL (0x30) ✅

---

### 5. fb_vtable_s 完整性

**✅ 核心回调已实现** (行 333-340)

| 回调 | 状态 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| open | ✅ 行 283 | 空实现，正确 |
| close | ✅ 行 288 | 空实现，正确 |
| getvideoinfo | ✅ 行 293 | 填充 FB_FMT_RGB32, 1024×600, 1 plane |
| getplaneinfo | ✅ 行 303 | 32bpp, stride=4096, fbmem 指针 |
| pandisplay | ✅ 行 321 | 单缓冲模式，空实现合理 |

**⚠️ 以下可选回调未实现** (取决于 Kconfig):
- `updatearea` (CONFIG_FB_UPDATE) — 未实现，对静态显示不影响
- `waitforvsync` (CONFIG_FB_SYNC) — 未实现，可能导致屏幕撕裂
- `setpower` / `getpower` — 未实现，电源管理不可用

这些是可选功能，缺失不会导致编译错误，但会限制驱动功能。

---

### 6. fb_register 错误处理

**✅ up_fbinitialize 返回类型正确** (行 346)

```c
int up_fbinitialize(int display)
```

返回 `int`，失败时返回 `-ENOMEM` (行 365)，成功返回 `OK` (行 385)。`fb_register()` 会检查此返回值 (参考 Framebuffer_Driver.md 第 73-79 行)。

**❌ 但内部 PLL 错误未向上传播** (行 372)

`d13x_pll_disp_init()` 的 `-ETIMEDOUT` 返回值被丢弃，`up_fbinitialize` 始终返回 `OK`，即使 PLL 未锁定。这使得 `fb_register()` 的错误检查形同虚设。

---

### 汇总

| # | 审核项 | 结论 | 行号 |
|---|--------|------|------|
| 1 | PLL_FRA2_F 位域与 EN/LOCK 重叠 | ❌ BUG | 37-42 |
| 2 | PLL 频率注释错误 (15.25→15.5, 364→372MHz) | ⚠️ | 127 |
| 3 | PLL 返回值未检查 | ❌ BUG | 372 |
| 4 | DE 时序参数 (1024×600) | ✅ | 111-121 |

| 5 | INT → INPUT（浮空） | 167 | — |

符合 GT911 数据手册要求：INT 低电平期间 RST 上升沿触发地址锁存。50ms 等待时间充足（GT911 地址锁存窗口约 10ms）。

⚠️ **注意事项**：RST 在第 159 行设为 input（浮空），若板级无外部上拉电阻，RST 引脚可能受噪声干扰导致意外复位。这取决于硬件设计，不属于驱动逻辑错误。

- 时序上延迟了一个 GT911 内部处理周期
- 若读取速度够快，可能在 INT 释放前就开始 I2C 读取

```

⚠️ **两处需关注**：

**a) 单点触摸限制**（`gt9xx.c` 核心驱动，非板级代码）

1: # Input 驱动开发指南
2: 
3: \[ [English](../../../en/device_dev_guide/graphics/Input_Driver_Guide.md) | 简体中文 \]
4: 
5: ## 一、概述
6: 
7: 本文档旨在为嵌入式开发者提供在 openvela 平台上开发输入 (Input) 设备驱动的详细指南。
8: 
9: openvela 的 Input 驱动框架遵循 NuttX 的标准分层模型，为触摸屏 (Touchscreen)、键盘 (Keyboard)、鼠标 (Mouse) 等各类输入设备提供了统一的软件架构。该框架的核心目标是将硬件相关的底层实现与上层应用逻辑解耦，从而提高驱动的可移植性和复用性。
10: 
11: ## 二、架构解析
12: 
13: 输入设备驱动（Input Driver）是连接物理输入设备与应用程序的关键组件。
14: 
15: Input 驱动框架采用经典的**上半层 (Upper Half)** 与**下半层 (Lower Half)** 分层设计。绝大部分触控芯片都是使用 I2C 接口接入主控芯片的，这部分被放进 Lower Half 层中。
16: 
17: ![img](./figures/013.png)
18: 
19: ### 上半层 (Upper Half)
20: 
21: 上半层是面向操作系统内核和应用程序的通用接口层，它负责处理与具体硬件无关的逻辑。其主要职责包括：
22: 
23: - **提供标准设备接口**：通过在 `drivers/input/` 目录下创建字符设备 (例如 `/dev/input0`)，为应用程序提供标准的 `open`, `read`, `ioctl` 等文件操作接口：
24: 
25:     ```C
26:     // 文件路径：drivers/input/touchscreen_upper.c
27:     
28:     static const struct file_operations g_touch_fops =
29:     {
30:       touch_open,     /* open */
31:       touch_close,    /* close */
32:       touch_read,     /* read */
33:       touch_write,    /* write */
34:       NULL,           /* seek */
35:       touch_ioctl,    /* ioctl */
36:       NULL,           /* mmap */
37:       NULL,           /* truncate */
38:       touch_poll      /* poll */
39:     };
40:     ```
41: 
42: - **管理下半层驱动**：提供注册 (`touch_register`) 和注销 (`touch_unregister`) 接口，用于挂载或卸载特定硬件的下半层驱动：
43: 
44:     ```C
45:     int touch_register(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
46:                        FAR const char *path, uint8_t nums)
47:     void touch_unregister(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
48:                           FAR const char *path)
49:     ```
50: 
51: - **缓冲事件数据**：提供事件上报接口 (`touch_event`)，接收来自下半层的输入数据，并将其存入环形缓冲区 (Circular Buffer)，供上层应用读取：
52: 
53:     ```C
54:     // 将touch 事件写入到一个 circle buffer 中
55:     void touch_event(FAR void *priv, FAR const struct touch_sample_s *sample)
56:     ```
57: 
58: ### 下半层 (Lower Half)
59: 
60: 下半层是驱动的核心实现部分，直接与输入设备硬件交互。**驱动开发者**主要的工作都集中在这一层。其职责包括：
61: 
62: - **硬件初始化**：配置芯片寄存器，设置中断模式、通信接口 (如 I2C/SPI) 等。
63: - **中断处理**：响应硬件中断，并从设备读取原始输入数据。
64: - **事件上报**：将解析后的标准化输入事件通过上半层提供的接口上报。
65: 
66: ## 三、核心 API 与数据结构
67: 
68: 为了实现上下半层的通信，框架定义了一系列标准化的数据结构和接口函数。
69: 
70: ### 1、关键数据结构
71: 
72: 这些结构体用于描述触摸事件的标准化格式。
73: 
74: - **`struct touch_point_s`**: 描述一个独立的触摸点信息。
75: 
76:     ```C
77:     #define TOUCH_DOWN           (1 << 0) /* A new touch contact is established */
78:     #define TOUCH_MOVE           (1 << 1) /* Movement occurred with previously reported contact */
79:     #define TOUCH_UP             (1 << 2) /* The touch contact was lost */
80:     #define TOUCH_ID_VALID       (1 << 3) /* Touch ID is certain */
81:     #define TOUCH_POS_VALID      (1 << 4) /* Hardware provided a valid X/Y position */
82:     #define TOUCH_PRESSURE_VALID (1 << 5) /* Hardware provided a valid pressure */
83:     #define TOUCH_SIZE_VALID     (1 << 6) /* Hardware provided a valid H/W contact size */
84:     #define TOUCH_GESTURE_VALID  (1 << 7) /* Hardware provided a valid gesture */
85:     
86:     struct touch_point_s
87:     {
88:       uint8_t  id;        /* Unique identifies contact; Same in all reports for the contact */
89:       uint8_t  flags;     /* See TOUCH_* definitions above */
90:       int16_t  x;         /* X coordinate of the touch point (uncalibrated) */
91:       int16_t  y;         /* Y coordinate of the touch point (uncalibrated) */
92:       int16_t  h;         /* Height of touch point (uncalibrated) */
93:       int16_t  w;         /* Width of touch point (uncalibrated) */
94:       uint16_t gesture;   /* Gesture of touchscreen contact */
95:       uint16_t pressure;  /* Touch pressure */
96:       uint64_t timestamp; /* Touch event time stamp, in microseconds */
97:     };
98:     ```
99: 
100: - **`struct touch_sample_s`**: 一次上报的完整触摸样本，可包含一个或多个触摸点。
101: 
102:     ```C
103:     struct touch_sample_s
104:     {
105:       int npoints;                   /* The number of touch points in point[] */
106:       struct touch_point_s point[1]; /* Actual dimension is npoints */
107:     };
108:     
109:     #define SIZEOF_TOUCH_SAMPLE_S(n) \
110:       (sizeof(struct touch_sample_s) + ((n) - 1) * sizeof(struct touch_point_s))
111:      
112:     ```
113: 
114: - **`struct touch_lowerhalf_s`**: 下半层驱动的实例，封装了硬件相关的操作和属性。
115: 
116:     ```C
117:     struct touch_lowerhalf_s
118:     {
119:       uint8_t       maxpoint;       /* Maximal point supported by the touchscreen */
120:       FAR void      *priv;          /* Save the upper half pointer */
121:     
122:       /**************************************************************************
123:        * Name: control
124:        *
125:        * Description:
126:        *   Users can use this interface to implement custom IOCTL.
127:        *
128:        * Arguments:
129:        *   lower   - The instance of lower half of touchscreen device.
130:        *   cmd     - User defined specific command.
131:        *   arg     - Argument of the specific command.
132:        *
133:        * Return Value:
134:        *   Zero(OK) on success; a negated errno value on failure.
135:        *   -ENOTTY - The command is not supported.
136:        **************************************************************************/
137:     
138:       CODE int (*control)(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
139:                           int cmd, unsigned long arg);
140:     
141:       /**************************************************************************
142:        * Name: write
143:        *
144:        * Description:
145:        *   Users can use this interface to implement custom write.
146:        *
147:        * Arguments:
148:        *   lower   - The instance of lower half of touchscreen device.
149:        *   buffer  - User defined specific buffer.
150:        *   buflen  - User defined specific buffer size.
151:        *
152:        * Return Value:
153:        *   Number of bytes written；a negated errno value on failure.
154:        *
155:        **************************************************************************/
156:     
157:       CODE ssize_t (*write)(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
158:                             FAR const char *buffer, size_t buflen);
159:     };
160:     ```
161: 
162: ### 2、核心函数接口
163: 
164: - **设备注册/注销**
165: 
166:     ```C
167:     // 注册触摸屏下半层驱动
168:     int touch_register(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
169:                        FAR const char *path, uint8_t nums)
170:     
171:     // 注销触摸屏下半层驱动
172:     void touch_unregister(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
173:                           FAR const char *path);
174:     ```
175: 
176: - **事件上报**
177: 
178:     ```C
179:     // 从下半层向上半层上报一个触摸事件样本
180:     void touch_event(FAR void *priv, FAR const struct touch_sample_s *sample);
181:     ```
182: 
183: ## 四、驱动开发工作流
184: 
185: 开发一个 Input 驱动通常遵循以下标准流程。
186: 
187: ### 步骤 1：初始化与注册
188: 
189: 驱动的初始化函数中，下半层驱动需要完成硬件初始化，并调用相应的注册函数将自身注册到 Input 框架中。例如，触摸屏驱动应调用 `touch_register`。
190: 
191: ### 步骤 2：中断处理与事件采集
192: 
193: 当硬件产生输入事件（如触摸、按键）并触发中断时，驱动的中断服务程序 (ISR) 会被调用。
194: 
195: > **注意：** 中断服务程序 (ISR) 必须在禁止抢占或禁用中断的上下文中快速执行。由于上半层的 `xxx_event` 函数内部包含> 锁操作，可能会导致休眠，**因此严禁在 ISR 中直接调用** **`xxx_event`** **函数**。
196: 
197: 正确的做法是使**用工作队列 (Work Queue) 机制：**
198: 
199: ```C++
200: int work_queue(int qid, FAR struct work_s *work, worker_t worker,
201:                FAR void *arg, clock_t delay)
202: 
203: Arguments:
204:   qid    - work queue ID：use HPWORK
205:   work   - the work structure to queue
206:   worker - the work callback 
207:   arg    - callback argument
208:   delay  - delay (in clock ticks) from the time queue until the worker is invoked. 
209:            Zero means to perform the work immediately.
210: ```
211: 
212: - `qid`: 工作队列 ID。对于高优先级中断，应使用 `HPWORK`；对于普通任务，可使用 `LPWORK`。
213: - `worker`: 工作队列任务的回调函数。事件的完整解析和上报应在此函数中完成。
214: - `delay`: 延迟执行的时间（单位：tick）。设置为 `0` 表示立即调度。
215: 
216: ### 步骤 3：事件上报
217: 
218: 在工作队列的回调函数（`worker`）中，驱动可以安全地执行以下操作：
219: 
220: 1. 通过 I2C/SPI 等总线从硬件读取完整的事件数据。
221: 2. 将原始数据解析并填充到标准的数据结构中（如 `struct touch_sample_s`）。
222: 3. 根据设备类型，调用相应的事件上报函数（如 `touch_event`），将事件数据发送到上半层。
223: 
224: ## 五、开发者适配指南
225: 
226: 本节将以触摸屏驱动为例，说明下半层驱动需要实现的具体接口。
227: 
228: ### 1、实现下半层接口
229: 
230: 您需要定义一个 `struct touch_lowerhalf_s` 类型的静态实例，并根据硬件能力填充其成员：
231: 
232: - `maxpoint`: 必须准确设置为硬件支持的最大并发触摸点数。此值直接影响上半层为环形缓冲区分配的内存大小。
233: - `control`, `write`: 如果需要支持自定义的 `ioctl` 或 `write` 操作，请实现这两个函数指针；否则，将其设置为 `NULL`。
234: 
235: ### 2、注册 Input 设备
236: 
237: 在驱动初始化时，调用 `touch_register` 函数。
238: 
239: ```C++
240: int touch_register(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
241:                    FAR const char *path, uint8_t nums)
242: 
243: Arguments:
244:   lower     - A pointer of lower half instance.
245:   path      - The path of touchscreen device. such as "/dev/input0"
246:   nums      - Number of the touch points structure, used to calculate circbuf size
247: ```
248: 
249: - `lower`: 指向您实现的 `touch_lowerhalf_s` 实例的指针。
250: - `path`: 设备节点路径，例如 `/dev/input0`。
251: - `nums`: 用于计算环形缓冲区大小的样本数量。它与 `lower->maxpoint` 共同决定了缓冲区总容量。计算公式如下： 
252: 
253:     `circbuf_size = nums * SIZEOF_TOUCH_SAMPLE_S(lower->maxpoint)`
254: 
255: ### 3、传输 Input 事件
256: 
257: 在工作队列的回调函数中，调用 `touch_event` 函数上报数据。
258: 
259: ```C++
260: void touch_event(FAR void *priv, FAR const struct touch_sample_s *sample);
261: 
262: Arguments:
263:   priv    - Upper half driver handle.
264:   sample  - pointer to data of touch point event.
265: ```
266: 
267: - `priv`: 上半层驱动的句柄。该值在 `touch_register` 成功后，由上半层回填到 `lower->priv` 成员中。
268: - `sample`: 指向已填充好数据的 `touch_sample_s` 结构体指针。请确保 `sample->npoints` 的值准确反映了 `sample->point` 数组中的有效数据点数量。
269: 
270: ## 六、构建与验证
271: 
272: ### 1、构建配置
273: 
274: 在 `menuconfig` 中启用相应类型的 Input 驱动框架支持。
275: 
276: ```Makefile
277: # 使能 touch 驱动
278: CONFIG_INPUT_TOUCHSCREEN=y
279: 
280: # 使能 keyboard 驱动
281: CONFIG_INPUT_KEYBOARD=y
282: 
283: # 使能 mouse 驱动
284: CONFIG_INPUT_MOUSE=y
285: ```
286: 
287: 同时，您还需要在 `menuconfig` 中选中您自己开发的下半层驱动。
288: 
289: ### 2、功能验证
290: 
291: 要验证驱动的正确性，您可以参考 [getevent 工具使用指南](./Getevent.md)等标准测试工具读取设备节点，并观察输出的事件信息是否与硬件的实际操作一致。
292: 
293: 将 `getevent` 工具输出的事件序列与硬件行为进行对比，可以有效调试坐标、按键值、事件标志等是否正确。
294: 
295: ## 七、代码示例
296: 
297: 您可以参考 `goldfish_events.c` 驱动，它为 Goldfish 模拟器实现了一套完整的 Input 事件处理，是一个很好的学习范例。
298: 
299: - **代码路径**: `nuttx/drivers/input/goldfish_events.c`

(End of file - total 299 lines)
</content>

# Input 驱动开发指南

\[ [English](../../../en/device_dev_guide/graphics/Input_Driver_Guide.md) | 简体中文 \]

## 一、概述

本文档旨在为嵌入式开发者提供在 openvela 平台上开发输入 (Input) 设备驱动的详细指南。

openvela 的 Input 驱动框架遵循 NuttX 的标准分层模型，为触摸屏 (Touchscreen)、键盘 (Keyboard)、鼠标 (Mouse) 等各类输入设备提供了统一的软件架构。该框架的核心目标是将硬件相关的底层实现与上层应用逻辑解耦，从而提高驱动的可移植性和复用性。

## 二、架构解析

输入设备驱动（Input Driver）是连接物理输入设备与应用程序的关键组件。

Input 驱动框架采用经典的**上半层 (Upper Half)** 与**下半层 (Lower Half)** 分层设计。绝大部分触控芯片都是使用 I2C 接口接入主控芯片的，这部分被放进 Lower Half 层中。

D13x 芯片全参数、信息与方案文档
芯片厂商：广东匠芯创科技有限公司（ArtInChip）
芯片系列：D13x
内核架构：RISC-V（平头哥玄铁 E907）
文档版本：v1.0
更新日期：2026-06-13

=== 芯片总览 ===
D13x 是匠芯创推出的国产高性能全高清显示和智能控制工业级 MCU，采用国产自主 RISC-V 内核，内置 PSRAM，集成显示引擎（DE）、图像引擎（GE）、视频编解码引擎（VE），配备丰富的屏显接口和通用外设。

核心特性：
- CPU: 平头哥玄铁 E907，RV32IMAFDCP，480MHz@1.1V
- SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB（按型号）
- PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封）
- Flash: NOR 2/4/8/16MB（合封）或外部 NAND
- 显示: RGB888 / LVDS / MIPI DSI 4-lane / SPI / I8080，最大 1366×768@60fps
- 图形: 2D 加速引擎，旋转/缩放/透明叠加
- 视频: JPEG 编解码、PNG/.9.PNG 硬解、MJPEG 硬解 1366×768@60fps
- 摄像头: DVP YUV422/BT.656，720P@60fps 输入，5M 拍照
- 以太网: 1×10/100M EMAC

345:  * Returned Value:
346:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
347:  *
348:  ****************************************************************************/
349: 
350: static int gt9xx_set_status(FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *dev, uint8_t status)
351: {
352:   int ret;
353: 
354:   iinfo("status=%d\n", status);
355:   DEBUGASSERT(dev);
356: 
357:   /* Write to the Status Register over I2C */
358: 
359:   ret = gt9xx_i2c_write(dev, GTP_READ_COOR_ADDR, status);
360:   if (ret < 0)
361:     {
362:       ierr("Set Status failed: %d\n", ret);
363:       return ret;
364:     }
365: 
366:   return OK;
367: }
368: 
369: /****************************************************************************
370:  * Name: gt9xx_read_touch_data
371:  *
372:  * Description:
373:  *   Read a Touch Sample from Touch Panel. Returns either 0 or 1
374:  *   Touch Points.
375:  *
376:  * Input Parameters:
377:  *   dev    - Touch Panel Device
378:  *   sample - Returned Touch Sample (0 or 1 Touch Points)
379:  *
380:  * Returned Value:
381:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
382:  *
383:  ****************************************************************************/
384: 
385: static int gt9xx_read_touch_data(FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *dev,
386:                                  FAR struct touch_sample_s *sample)
387: {
388:   uint8_t status[1];
389:   uint8_t status_code;
390:   uint8_t touched_points;
391:   uint8_t touch[6];
392:   uint16_t x;
393:   uint16_t y;
394:   uint8_t flags;
395:   int ret;
396: 
397:   /* Erase the Touch Sample and Touch Point */
398: 
399:   iinfo("\n");
400:   DEBUGASSERT(dev && sample);
401:   memset(sample, 0, sizeof(*sample));
402: 
403:   /* Read the Touch Panel Status */
404: 
405:   ret = gt9xx_i2c_read(dev, GTP_READ_COOR_ADDR, status, sizeof(status));
406:   if (ret < 0)
407:     {
408:       ierr("Read Touch Panel Status failed: %d\n", ret);
409:       return ret;
410:     }
411: 
412:   /* Decode the Status Code and the Touched Points */
413: 
414:   status_code = status[0] & 0x80;
415:   touched_points = status[0] & 0x0f;
416: 
417:   /* If Touch Panel Status is OK and Touched Points is 1 or more */
418: 
419:   if (status_code != 0 && touched_points >= 1)
420:     {
421:       /* Read the First Touch Point (6 bytes) */
422: 
423:       ret = gt9xx_i2c_read(dev, GTP_POINT1, touch, sizeof(touch));
424:       if (ret < 0)
425:         {
426:           ierr("Read Touch Point failed: %d\n", ret);
427:           return ret;
428:         }
429: 
430:       /* Decode the Touch Coordinates */
431: 
432:       x = touch[0] + (touch[1] << 8);
433:       y = touch[2] + (touch[3] << 8);
434: 
435:       /* Return the Touch Coordinates as Touch Down */
436: 
437:       flags = TOUCH_DOWN | TOUCH_ID_VALID | TOUCH_POS_VALID;
438:       sample->npoints = 1;
439:       sample->point[0].id = 0;
440:       sample->point[0].x = x;
441:       sample->point[0].y = y;
442:       sample->point[0].flags = flags;
443:       iinfo("touch down x=%d, y=%d\n", x, y);
444:     }
445: 
446:   /* Set the Touch Panel Status to 0 */
447: 
448:   ret = gt9xx_set_status(dev, 0);
449:   if (ret < 0)
450:     {
451:       ierr("Set Touch Panel Status failed: %d\n", ret);
452:       return ret;
453:     }
454: 
455:   return OK;
456: }
457: 
458: /****************************************************************************
459:  * Name: gt9xx_read
460:  *
461:  * Description:
462:  *   Read a Touch Sample from Touch Panel. Returns either 0 or 1
463:  *   Touch Points.
464:  *
465:  * Input Parameters:
466:  *   dev    - Touch Panel Device
467:  *   buffer - Returned Touch Sample (0 or 1 Touch Points)
468:  *   buflen - Size of buffer
469:  *
470:  * Returned Value:
471:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
472:  *
473:  ****************************************************************************/
474: 
475: static ssize_t gt9xx_read(FAR struct file *filep, FAR char *buffer,
476:                           size_t buflen)
477: {
478:   FAR struct inode *inode;
479:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
480:   struct touch_sample_s sample;
481:   const size_t outlen = sizeof(sample);
482:   irqstate_t flags;
483:   int ret;
484: 
485:   /* Returned Touch Sample will have 0 or 1 Touch Points */
486: 
487:   iinfo("buflen=%ld\n", buflen);
488:   if (buflen < outlen)
489:     {
490:       ierr("Buffer should be at least %ld bytes, got %ld bytes\n",
491:            outlen, buflen);
492:       return -EINVAL;
493:     }
494: 
495:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
496: 
497:   inode = filep->f_inode;
498:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
499:   priv = inode->i_private;
500: 
501:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent reads */
502: 
503:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
504:   if (ret < 0)
505:     {
506:       return ret;
507:     }
508: 
509:   ret = -EINVAL;
510: 
511:   /* If waiting for Touch Up, return the Last Touch Point as Touch Up */
512: 
513:   if (priv->flags & TOUCH_DOWN)
514:     {
515:       /* Begin Critical Section */
516: 
517:       flags = enter_critical_section();
518: 
519:       /* Mark the Last Touch Point as Touch Up */
520: 
521:       priv->flags = TOUCH_UP | TOUCH_ID_VALID | TOUCH_POS_VALID;
522: 
523:       /* End Critical Section */
524: 
525:       leave_critical_section(flags);
526: 
527:       /* Return the Last Touch Point, changed to Touch Up */
528: 
529:       memset(&sample, 0, sizeof(sample));
530:       sample.npoints = 1;
531:       sample.point[0].id = 0;
532:       sample.point[0].x = priv->x;
533:       sample.point[0].y = priv->y;
534:       sample.point[0].flags = priv->flags;
535:       memcpy(buffer, &sample, sizeof(sample));
536:       ret = OK;
537:       iinfo("touch up x=%d, y=%d\n", priv->x, priv->y);
538:     }
539:   else
540:     {
541:       /* Otherwise read the Touch Point over I2C */
542: 
543:       ret = gt9xx_read_touch_data(priv, &sample);
544: 
545:       /* Skip duplicates */
546: 
547:       if (sample.npoints >= 1 &&
548:           priv->x == sample.point[0].x &&
549:           priv->y == sample.point[0].y)
550:         {
551:           memset(&sample, 0, sizeof(sample));
552:           sample.npoints = 0;
553:           iinfo("skip duplicate x=%d, y=%d\n", priv->x, priv->y);
554:         }
555: 
556:       /* Return the Touch Point */
557: 
558:       memcpy(buffer, &sample, sizeof(sample));
559: 
560:       /* Begin Critical Section */
561: 
562:       flags = enter_critical_section();
563: 
564:       /* Clear the Interrupt Pending Flag */
565: 
566:       priv->int_pending = false;
567: 
568:       /* Remember the Last Touch Point */
569: 
570:       if (sample.npoints >= 1)
571:         {
572:           priv->x = sample.point[0].x;
573:           priv->y = sample.point[0].y;
574:           priv->flags = sample.point[0].flags;
575:         }
576: 
577:       /* End Critical Section */
578: 
579:       leave_critical_section(flags);
580:     }
581: 
582:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow next read */
583: 
584:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
585:   return (ret < 0) ? ret : outlen;
586: }
587: 
588: /****************************************************************************
589:  * Name: gt9xx_open
590:  *
591:  * Description:
592:  *   Open the Touch Panel Device.  If this is the first open, we power on
593:  *   the Touch Panel, probe for the Touch Panel and enable Touch Panel
594:  *   Interrupts.
595:  *
596:  * Input Parameters:
597:  *   filep - File Struct for Touch Panel
598:  *
599:  * Returned Value:
600:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
601:  *
602:  ****************************************************************************/
603: 
604: static int gt9xx_open(FAR struct file *filep)
605: {
606:   FAR struct inode *inode;
607:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
608:   unsigned int use_count;
609:   int ret;
610: 
611:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
612: 
613:   iinfo("\n");
614:   inode = filep->f_inode;
615:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
616:   priv = inode->i_private;
617: 
618:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent update to Reference Count */
619: 
620:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
621:   if (ret < 0)
622:     {
623:       ierr("Lock Mutex failed: %d\n", ret);
624:       return ret;
625:     }
626: 
627:   /* Get next Reference Count */
628: 
629:   use_count = priv->cref + 1;
630:   DEBUGASSERT(use_count < UINT8_MAX && use_count > priv->cref);
631:   if (use_count == 1)
632:     {
633:       /* If first user, power on the Touch Panel */
634: 
635:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->set_power != NULL);
636:       ret = priv->board->set_power(priv->board, true);
637:       if (ret < 0)
638:         {
639:           goto out_lock;
640:         }
641: 
642:       /* Let Touch Panel power up before probing */
643: 
644:       nxsig_usleep(100 * 1000);
645: 
646:       /* Check that Touch Panel exists on I2C */
647: 
648:       ret = gt9xx_probe_device(priv);
649:       if (ret < 0)
650:         {
651:           /* No such device, power off the Touch Panel */
652: 
653:           priv->board->set_power(priv->board, false);
654:           goto out_lock;
655:         }
656: 
657:       /* Enable Touch Panel Interrupts */
658: 
659:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->irq_enable);
660:       priv->board->irq_enable(priv->board, true);
661:     }
662: 
663:   /* Set the Reference Count */
664: 
665:   priv->cref = use_count;
666: 
667:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow update to Reference Count */
668: 
669: out_lock:
670:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
671:   return ret;
672: }
673: 
674: /****************************************************************************
675:  * Name: gt9xx_close
676:  *
677:  * Description:
678:  *   Close the Touch Panel Device.  If this is the final close, we disable
679:  *   Touch Panel Interrupts and power off the Touch Panel.
680:  *
681:  * Input Parameters:
682:  *   filep - File Struct for Touch Panel
683:  *
684:  * Returned Value:
685:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
686:  *
687:  ****************************************************************************/
688: 
689: static int gt9xx_close(FAR struct file *filep)
690: {
691:   FAR struct inode *inode;
692:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
693:   int use_count;
694:   int ret;
695: 
696:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
697: 
698:   iinfo("\n");
699:   inode = filep->f_inode;
700:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
701:   priv = inode->i_private;
702: 
703:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent update to Reference Count */
704: 
705:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
706:   if (ret < 0)
707:     {
708:       ierr("Lock Mutex failed: %d\n", ret);
709:       return ret;
710:     }
711: 
712:   /* Decrement the Reference Count */
713: 
714:   use_count = priv->cref - 1;
715:   DEBUGASSERT(use_count >= 0);
716:   if (use_count == 0)
717:     {
718:       /* If final user, disable Touch Panel Interrupts */
719: 
720:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board && priv->board->irq_enable);
721:       priv->board->irq_enable(priv->board, false);
722: 
723:       /* Power off the Touch Panel */
724: 
725:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->set_power);
726:       priv->board->set_power(priv->board, false);
727:     }
728: 
729:   /* Set the Reference Count */
730: 
731:   priv->cref = use_count;
732: 
733:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow update to Reference Count */
734: 
735:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
736:   return OK;
737: }
738: 
739: /****************************************************************************
740:  * Name: gt9xx_poll
741:  *
742:  * Description:
743:  *   Setup or teardown a poll for the Touch Panel Device.
744:  *
745:  * Input Parameters:
746:  *   filep - File Struct for Touch Panel
747:  *   fds   - The structure describing the events to be monitored, OR NULL if
748:  *           this is a request to stop monitoring events.
749:  *   setup - true: Setup the poll; false: Teardown the poll
750:  *
751:  * Returned Value:
752:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
753:  *
754:  ****************************************************************************/
755: 
756: static int gt9xx_poll(FAR struct file *filep, FAR struct pollfd *fds,
757:                       bool setup)
758: {
759:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
760:   FAR struct inode *inode;
761:   bool pending;
762:   int ret = 0;
763:   int i;
764: 
765:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
766: 
767:   iinfo("setup=%d\n", setup);
768:   DEBUGASSERT(fds);
769:   inode = filep->f_inode;
770:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
771:   priv = inode->i_private;
772: 
773:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent update to Poll Waiters */
774: 
775:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
776:   if (ret < 0)
777:     {
778:       ierr("Lock Mutex failed: %d\n", ret);
779:       return ret;
780:     }
781: 
782:   if (setup)
783:     {
784:       /* If Poll Setup: Ignore waits that do not include POLLIN */
785: 
786:       if ((fds->events & POLLIN) == 0)
787:         {
788:           ret = -EDEADLK;
789:           goto out;
790:         }
791: 
792:       /* Find an available slot for the Poll Waiter */
793: 
794:       for (i = 0; i < CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_NPOLLWAITERS; i++)
795:         {
796:           /* Found an available slot */
797: 
798:           if (!priv->fds[i])
799:             {
800:               /* Bind the poll structure and this slot */
801: 
802:               priv->fds[i] = fds;
803:               fds->priv = &priv->fds[i];
804:               break;
805:             }
806:         }
807: 
808:       if (i >= CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_NPOLLWAITERS)
809:         {
810:           /* No slots available */
811: 
812:           fds->priv = NULL;
813:           ret = -EBUSY;
814:         }
815:       else
816:         {
817:           /* If Interrupt Pending is set, notify the Poll Waiters */
818: 
819:           pending = priv->int_pending;
820:           if (pending)
821:             {
822:               poll_notify(&fds, 1, POLLIN);
823:             }
824:         }
825:     }
826:   else if (fds->priv)
827:     {
828:       /* If Poll Teardown: Remove the poll setup */
829: 
830:       FAR struct pollfd **slot = (FAR struct pollfd **)fds->priv;
831:       DEBUGASSERT(slot != NULL);
832: 
833:       *slot = NULL;
834:       fds->priv = NULL;
835:     }
836: 
837:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow update to Poll Waiters */
838: 
839: out:
840:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
841:   return ret;
842: }
843: 
844: /****************************************************************************
845:  * Name: gt9xx_isr_handler
846:  *
847:  * Description:
848:  *   Interrupt Handler for Touch Panel.
849:  *
850:  * Input Parameters:
851:  *   irq     - IRQ Number
852:  *   context - IRQ Context
853:  *   arg     - Touch Panel Device
854:  *
855:  * Returned Value:
856:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
857:  *
858:  ****************************************************************************/
859: 
860: static int gt9xx_isr_handler(int irq, FAR void *context, FAR void *arg)
861: {
862:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv = (FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *)arg;
863:   irqstate_t flags;
864: 
865:   DEBUGASSERT(priv);
866: 
867:   /* Begin Critical Section */
868: 
869:   flags = enter_critical_section();
870: 
871:   /* Set the Interrupt Pending Flag */
872: 
873:   priv->int_pending = true;
874: 
875:   /* End Critical Section */
876: 
877:   leave_critical_section(flags);
878: 
879:   /* Notify the Poll Waiters */
880: 
881:   poll_notify(priv->fds, CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_NPOLLWAITERS, POLLIN);
882:   return OK;
883: }
884: 
885: /****************************************************************************
886:  * Public Functions
887:  ****************************************************************************/
888: 
889: /****************************************************************************
890:  * Name: gt9xx_register
891:  *
892:  * Description:
893:  *   Register the driver for Goodix GT9XX Touch Panel.  Attach the
894:  *   Interrupt Handler for the Touch Panel and disable Touch Interrupts.
895:  *
896:  * Input Parameters:
897:  *   devpath      - Device Path (e.g. "/dev/input0")
898:  *   dev          - I2C Bus
899:  *   i2c_devaddr  - I2C Address of Touch Panel
900:  *   board_config - Callback for Board-Specific Operations
901:  *
902:  * Returned Value:
903:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
904:  *
905:  ****************************************************************************/
906: 
907: int gt9xx_register(FAR const char *devpath,
908:                    FAR struct i2c_master_s *i2c_dev,
909:                    uint8_t i2c_devaddr,
910:                    const struct gt9xx_board_s *board_config)
911: {
912:   struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
913:   int ret = 0;
914: 
915:   iinfo("devpath=%s, i2c_devaddr=%d\n", devpath, i2c_devaddr);
916:   DEBUGASSERT(devpath != NULL && i2c_dev != NULL && board_config != NULL);
917: 
918:   /* Allocate the Touch Panel Device Structure */
919: 
920:   priv = kmm_zalloc(sizeof(struct gt9xx_dev_s));
921:   if (!priv)
922:     {
923:       ierr("GT9XX Memory Allocation failed\n");
924:       return -ENOMEM;
925:     }
926: 
927:   /* Setup the Touch Panel Device Structure */
928: 
929:   priv->addr = i2c_devaddr;
930:   priv->i2c = i2c_dev;
931:   priv->board = board_config;
932:   nxmutex_init(&priv->devlock);
933: 
934:   /* Register the Touch Input Driver */
935: 
936:   ret = register_driver(devpath, &g_gt9xx_fileops, 0666, priv);
937:   if (ret < 0)
938:     {
939:       nxmutex_destroy(&priv->devlock);
940:       kmm_free(priv);
941:       ierr("GT9XX Registration failed: %d\n", ret);
942:       return ret;
943:     }
944: 
945:   /* Attach the Interrupt Handler */
946: 
947:   DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->irq_attach);
948:   priv->board->irq_attach(priv->board, gt9xx_isr_handler, priv);
949: 
950:   /* Disable Touch Panel Interrupts */
951: 
952:   DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->irq_enable);
953:   priv->board->irq_enable(priv->board, false);
954: 
955:   iinfo("GT9XX Touch Panel registered\n");
956:   return OK;
957: }

### 审核项 2: 复位序列正确性

✅ **正确** — `gt911_set_power()` 第 136–176 行

复位序列完整且时序合理：

| 步骤 | 操作 | 行号 | 延时 |
|------|------|------|------|
| 1 | RST → OUTPUT LOW | 142-143 | 10ms |
| 2 | INT → OUTPUT LOW（选择 I2C 地址 0x5D） | 148-149 | 2ms |
| 3 | RST → HIGH | 154 | 5ms |
| 4 | RST → INPUT（浮空） | 159 | 50ms |
| 5 | INT → INPUT（浮空） | 167 | — |

符合 GT911 数据手册要求：INT 低电平期间 RST 上升沿触发地址锁存。50ms 等待时间充足（GT911 地址锁存窗口约 10ms）。

⚠️ **注意事项**：RST 在第 159 行设为 input（浮空），若板级无外部上拉电阻，RST 引脚可能受噪声干扰导致意外复位。这取决于硬件设计，不属于驱动逻辑错误。

---

### 审核项 3: GPIO 中断配置

⚠️ **INT 极性配置可能有误** — 第 99–101 行

当前配置：
- 第 95-97 行：`GPIO_INT_TYPE` bit 2 = 1 → **边沿触发** ✅
- 第 99-101 行：`GPIO_INT_POL` bit 2 = 1 → **上升沿触发** ⚠️
- 第 105-107 行：`GPIO_INT_MASK` bit 2 = 0 → **取消屏蔽** ✅

**问题**：GT911 在触摸数据就绪时将 INT 拉低，读取状态寄存器后释放为高电平。中断应在 **下降沿（INT 被拉低时）** 触发，而非上升沿。

当前 `GPIO_INT_POL` bit 2 = 1（上升沿），中断会在 GT911 释放 INT 后才触发，可能导致：
- 时序上延迟了一个 GT911 内部处理周期
- 若读取速度够快，可能在 INT 释放前就开始 I2C 读取

**建议修复**：将第 100 行改为清除 bit 2：
```c

```

`gt9xx_board_s` 定义了 3 个回调（`gt9xx.h:40-55`），全部已实现：

| `set_power` | `gt911_set_power` | 136-176 | ✅ |

函数签名与头文件声明一致。

---

### 审核项 5: NuttX Input 驱动规范

⚠️ **两处需关注**：

**a) 单点触摸限制**（`gt9xx.c` 核心驱动，非板级代码）

核心驱动 `gt9xx_read_touch_data()`（`gt9xx.c:385-456`）只读取 `GTP_POINT1`（第 423 行），即仅支持 1 个触摸点。GT911 硬件最多支持 5 点触摸（寄存器 0x8150–0x81FF）。这是上游驱动的限制，板级代码无法修复，但属于功能缺失。

**b) 初始化时 set_power 调用顺序**

`d13x_gt911_initialize()` 第 199 行在 `gt9xx_register()` 之前调用 `gt911_set_power(&g_gt911_board, true)`。此时 ISR 尚未挂载（`gt9xx_register` 内部才调用 `irq_attach`）。如果 GT911 在 reset 完成后立即产生中断，该中断会被忽略（CLIC 未使能）。

**建议**：移除第 199 行，让 `gt9xx_open()` 统一管理上电时序。

109: #define DE_TIMING_V_POL        (1 << 2)

111: /* 面板时序参数 (1024×600, 来源: luban-lite panel_simple.c) */

114: #define PANEL_VACTIVE          600

168: static int d13x_pll_disp_init(void)
169: {
170:   uint32_t reg;
171:   uint32_t timeout;
172: 
173:   /* 配置 PLL_FRA2 → 364MHz (24MHz × (N+1 + F/16384)) */
174: 
175:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_FRA2_GEN);
176:   reg &= ~(PLL_FRA2_N_MASK | PLL_FRA2_F_MASK);
177:   reg |= (PLL_FRA2_N_VALUE << PLL_FRA2_N_SHIFT);
178:   reg |= (PLL_FRA2_F_VALUE << PLL_FRA2_F_SHIFT);
179:   reg |= PLL_FRA2_EN;
180:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_FRA2_GEN);
181: 
182:   /* 等待 PLL 锁定 */
183: 
184:   timeout = PLL_FRA2_TIMEOUT;
185:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_FRA2_INT) & PLL_FRA2_INT_LOCK))
186:     {
187:       if (--timeout == 0)
188:         {
189:           ierr("PLL_FRA2 lock timeout\n");
190:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
191:         }
192:     }
193: 
194:   return OK;

222: 
223:   putreg32((PANEL_HBP << 24) | (PANEL_HFP << 12) | PANEL_HSYNC,
224:            D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_H_PORCH);
225: 
226:   /* 垂直时序 */
227: 
228:   putreg32((PANEL_VBP << 24) | (PANEL_VFP << 12) | PANEL_VSYNC,
229:            D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_V_PORCH);
230: 
231:   /* 同步脉冲宽度 */
232: 
233:   putreg32((PANEL_HSYNC << 16) | PANEL_VSYNC,
234:            D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_SYNC_PLUSE);
235: 
236:   /* 活动区域尺寸 */
237: 
238:   putreg32((PANEL_HACTIVE << 16) | PANEL_VACTIVE,
239:            D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE);
240: 
241:   /* 使能 DE 时序输出 */
242: 
243:   putreg32(DE_TIMING_EN, D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_CTRL_EN);

251:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_1_POL_CTL, AIC_LVDS_POL);
252:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_0_PHY_CTL, AIC_LVDS_PHY);
253:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_1_PHY_CTL, AIC_LVDS_PHY);

256:   ctl |= LVDS_CTL_MODE(LVDS_NS);
257:   ctl |= LVDS_CTL_LINK(LVDS_SINGLE_LINK0);
258:   if (AIC_LVDS_LINK_SWAP_EN)
259:     {
260:       ctl |= LVDS_CTL_SWAP_EN;

262: 
263:   if (AIC_LVDS_SYNC_MODE_EN)

265:       ctl |= LVDS_CTL_SYNC_MODE_EN;

268:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_CTL, ctl);

346: int up_fbinitialize(int display)

348:   struct d13x_lvds_dev_s *dev = &g_lvds_dev;

351:     {
352:       return OK;

371:

383:         dev->fbmem, dev->fblen);

19: static inline void clk_pll_bypass(struct aic_clk_pll_cfg *pll, unsigned int bypass)
20: {
21:     u32 val;
22: 
23:     val = readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));
24:     val &= ~(1 << PLL_OUT_MUX);
25:     val |= (!bypass << PLL_OUT_MUX);
26:     writel(val, cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));
27: }

29: static int clk_pll_enable(struct aic_clk_comm_cfg *comm_cfg)
30: {
31:     struct aic_clk_pll_cfg *pll = to_clk_pll(comm_cfg);
32:     u32 val;
33: 
34:     if (pll->flag & CLK_NO_CHANGE) {
35:         return 0;
36:     }
37: 
38: 
39:     val = readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));
40:     val |= (1 << PLL_OUT_SYS | 1 << PLL_EN_BIT);
41:     writel(val, cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));
42: 
43:     return clk_pll_wait_lock();
44: }

47: {

49:     u32 val;
50: 
51:     if (!(pll->flag & CLK_NO_CHANGE)) {
52:         val = readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));
53:         val &= ~(1 << PLL_OUT_SYS | 1 << PLL_EN_BIT);
54:         writel(val, cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));

61:     u32 reg_val                 = readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));
62: 
63:     if ((reg_val & (1 << PLL_EN_BIT)) && (reg_val & (1 << PLL_OUT_SYS)))
64:         return 1;
65:

69: static unsigned long clk_pll_recalc_rate(struct aic_clk_comm_cfg *comm_cfg,
70:                                          unsigned long parent_rate)
71: {
72:     struct aic_clk_pll_cfg *pll = to_clk_pll(comm_cfg);
73:     u32 factor_n, factor_m, factor_p, fra_in;
74:     u64 rate, rate_int, rate_fra;
75:     u8 fra_en = 0;
76:     u32 sdm_en = 0;
77: 
78:     /* PLL output mux is CLK_24M */
79:     if (!((readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen)) >> PLL_OUT_MUX) & 0x1))
80:         return CLOCK_24M;
81: 
82:     factor_n = (readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen)) >> PLL_FACTORN_BIT) &
83:                PLL_FACTORN_MASK;
84:     factor_m = (readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen)) >> PLL_FACTORM_BIT) &
85:                PLL_FACTORM_MASK;
86:     factor_p = (readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen)) >> PLL_FACTORP_BIT) &
87:                PLL_FACTORP_MASK;
88:     if (pll->type == AIC_PLL_FRA)
89:         fra_en = (readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_fra)) >> PLL_FRAC_EN_BIT) & 0x1;
90: 
91:     if (pll->type == AIC_PLL_INT || !fra_en) {
92:         rate = parent_rate / (factor_p + 1) * (factor_n + 1) / (factor_m + 1);
93:     } else {
94:         fra_in = readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_fra)) & PLL_FRAC_DIV_MASK;
95:         rate_int =
96:                 parent_rate / (factor_p + 1) * (factor_n + 1) / (factor_m + 1);
97:         rate_fra = (u64)parent_rate / (factor_p + 1) * fra_in;
98:         do_div(rate_fra, PLL_FRAC_DIV_MASK * (factor_m + 1));
99:         rate = rate_int + rate_fra;
100:     }
101: 
102:     if (pll->type == AIC_PLL_SDM) {
103:         sdm_en = readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_sdm));
104:         sdm_en >>= 31;
105: 
106:         /* Pll is SDM mode, but SDM is not enable
107:          * Create a small deviation, let sys setup again
108:          */
109:         if (sdm_en == 0)
110:             rate += 1;
111:     }
112: #ifdef FPGA_BOARD_ARTINCHIP
113:     rate = fpga_board_rate[pll->id];
114: #endif
115:     return rate;
116: }
117: 
118: static long clk_pll_round_rate(struct aic_clk_comm_cfg *comm_cfg,
119:                                unsigned long rate, unsigned long *prate)
120: {
121:     struct aic_clk_pll_cfg *pll = to_clk_pll(comm_cfg);
122:     u32 factor_n, factor_m, factor_p;
123:     long rrate, vco_rate;
124:     unsigned long parent_rate = *prate;
125: 
126:     if (pll->type == AIC_PLL_FRA)
127:             return rate;
128: 
129:     /* The frequency constraint of PLL_VCO is between 768M and 1560M */
130:     if (rate < PLL_VCO_MIN)
131:         factor_m = DIV_ROUND_UP(PLL_VCO_MIN, rate) - 1;
132:     else
133:         factor_m = 0;
134: 
135:     if (factor_m > PLL_FACTORM_MASK)
136:         factor_m = PLL_FACTORM_MASK;
137: 
138:     vco_rate = (factor_m + 1) * rate;
139:     if (vco_rate > PLL_VCO_MAX)
140:         vco_rate = PLL_VCO_MAX;
141: 
142:     factor_p = (vco_rate % parent_rate) ? 1 : 0;
143:     if (!factor_p)
144:         return rate;
145:     else if (!(vco_rate % (parent_rate / (factor_p + 1))))
146:         return rate;
147: 
148:     factor_n = vco_rate / parent_rate * (factor_p + 1) - 1;
149: 
150:     rrate = parent_rate / (factor_p + 1) * (factor_n + 1) / (factor_m + 1);
151: 
152: #ifdef FPGA_BOARD_ARTINCHIP
153:     rrate = fpga_board_rate[pll->id];
154: #endif
155:     return rrate;
156: }

158: static int clk_pll_set_rate(struct aic_clk_comm_cfg *comm_cfg,
159:                             unsigned long rate, unsigned long parent_rate)
160: {
161:     u32 factor_n, factor_m, factor_p, reg_val;
162:     u64 val, fra_in = 0;
163:     u8 fra_en, factor_m_en;
164:     unsigned long vco_rate;
165:     u32 ppm_max, sdm_amp, sdm_en = 0;
166:     u64 sdm_step;
167:     struct aic_clk_pll_cfg *pll = to_clk_pll(comm_cfg);
168: 
169:     if (pll->flag & CLK_NO_CHANGE)
170:         return 0;
171: 
172:     if (rate == CLOCK_24M) {
173:         val = readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));
174:         val &= ~(1 << PLL_OUT_MUX);
175:         writel(val, cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));
176:         return 0;
177:     }
178: 
179:     /* Switch the output of PLL to 24MHz */
180:     clk_pll_bypass(pll, 1);
181: 
182:     /* Calculate PLL parameters.
183:      * The frequency constraint of PLL_VCO
184:      * is between 768M and 1560M
185:      */
186:     if (rate < PLL_VCO_MIN)
187:         factor_m = DIV_ROUND_UP(PLL_VCO_MIN, rate) - 1;
188:     else
189:         factor_m = 0;
190: 
191:     /* Avoid factor_m == 2 */
192:     if (factor_m == 2)
193:         factor_m = 3;
194: 
195:     if (factor_m > PLL_FACTORM_MASK)
196:         factor_m = PLL_FACTORM_MASK;
197: 
198:     if (factor_m)
199:         factor_m_en = 1;
200:     else
201:         factor_m_en = 0;
202: 
203:     vco_rate = (factor_m + 1) * rate;
204:     if (vco_rate > PLL_VCO_MAX)
205:         vco_rate = PLL_VCO_MAX;
206: 
207:     factor_p = (vco_rate % parent_rate) ? 1 : 0;
208:     factor_n = vco_rate * (factor_p + 1) / parent_rate  - 1;
209: 
210:     reg_val = readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));
211:     reg_val &= ~0xFFFF;
212:     reg_val |= (factor_m_en << PLL_FACTORM_EN_BIT) |
213:             (factor_n << PLL_FACTORN_BIT) |
214:             (factor_m << PLL_FACTORM_BIT) |
215:             (factor_p << PLL_FACTORP_BIT);
216:     /* If SDM enable, set PLL_ICP = 0 */
217:     if (pll->type == AIC_PLL_SDM)
218:         reg_val &= ~(0x1F << 24);
219:     writel(reg_val, cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));
220: 
221:     if (pll->type == AIC_PLL_FRA) {
222:         val = rate % (parent_rate * (factor_n + 1) /
223:                   (factor_m + 1) / (factor_p + 1));
224:         fra_en = val ? 1 : 0;
225:         if (fra_en) {
226:             fra_in = val * (factor_p + 1) *
227:                  (factor_m + 1) * PLL_FRAC_DIV_MASK;
228:             do_div(fra_in, parent_rate);
229:         }
230:         /* Configure fractional division */
231:         writel(fra_en << PLL_FRAC_EN_BIT | fra_in, cmu_reg(pll->offset_fra));
232:     } else if (pll->type == AIC_PLL_SDM) {
233:         sdm_en = readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_sdm));
234:         sdm_en >>= 31;
235: 
236:         ppm_max = 1000000 / (factor_n + 1);
237:         /* 1% spread */
238:         if (ppm_max < PLL_SDM_SPREAD_PPM)
239:             sdm_amp = 0;
240:         else
241:             sdm_amp = PLL_SDM_AMP_MAX -
242:                 PLL_SDM_SPREAD_PPM *
243:                 PLL_SDM_AMP_MAX / ppm_max;
244: 
245:         /* SDM uses triangular wave, 33KHz by default  */
246:         sdm_step = (PLL_SDM_AMP_MAX - sdm_amp) * 2 *
247:             PLL_SDM_SPREAD_FREQ;
248:         do_div(sdm_step, parent_rate);
249:         if (sdm_step > 511)
250:             sdm_step = 511;
251: 
252:         reg_val = (1UL << PLL_SDM_EN_BIT) |
253:               (2 << PLL_SDM_MODE_BIT) |
254:               (sdm_step << PLL_SDM_STEP_BIT) |
255:               (3 << PLL_SDM_FREQ_BIT) |
256:               (sdm_amp << PLL_SDM_AMP_BIT);
257: 
258:         writel(reg_val, cmu_reg(pll->offset_sdm));
259:     }
260: 
261:     reg_val = readl(cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));
262:     reg_val |= (1 << PLL_OUT_SYS | 1 << PLL_EN_BIT);
263:     writel(reg_val, cmu_reg(pll->offset_gen));
264: 
265:     if (!clk_pll_wait_lock()) {
266:         clk_pll_bypass(pll, 0);
267:     } else {
268:         //pr_err("%d not lock\n", pll->id);
269:         return -EAGAIN;
270:     }
271: 
272:     return 0;
273: }
274:

**计算函数** (artinchip_i2c.c:208-246):

```c
static void d13x_i2c_set_speed(uint32_t base, uint32_t pclk)
{
  hcnt = pclk / 400000 - 1;
  lcnt = pclk / 400000;
  if (hcnt < FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH) hcnt = FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH;   /* 行 221-224 */
  if (lcnt < FS_MIN_SCL_LOW)  lcnt = FS_MIN_SCL_LOW;    /* 行 226-229 */
  ...
  i2c_putreg(base, I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT, hcnt);              /* 行 240 */
  i2c_putreg(base, I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT, lcnt);              /* 行 241 */
}
```

**调用参数** (artinchip_i2c.c:539 + chip.h:89):

```c
d13x_i2c_set_speed(priv->base, D13X_APB0_FREQ);  /* pclk = 100,000,000 */
```

**数值推演**:

| 步骤 | 计算 | 结果 |
|------|------|------|
| hcnt_raw | 100000000 / 400000 − 1 | 249 |
| lcnt_raw | 100000000 / 400000 | 250 |
| 钳位 hcnt | 249 < 600 ? 600 : 249 | **600** |
| 钳位 lcnt | 250 < 1300 ? 1300 : 250 | **1300** |
| 实际 SCL 周期 | (600 + 1300) × 10ns | 19μs |
| **实际频率** | 1 / 19μs | **≈52.6 KHz** |

DesignWare I2C 控制器的 HCNT/LCNT 寄存器以 **APB 时钟周期** 为单位。100MHz 下每个周期 = 10ns。

I2C Fast Mode 规范最小值:
- SCL high time ≥ 600ns → 正确钳位值 = **60** 周期
- SCL low time ≥ 1300ns → 正确钳位值 = **130** 周期

当前代码将纳秒原始值直接写入时钟周期寄存器，导致实际频率仅 53 KHz，远低于 400 KHz 目标。

**判定**: ❌ 不通过 — 钳位宏应为 `FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH=60` 和 `FS_MIN_SCL_LOW=130`。当前值使总线运行在 Standard Mode 以下。

211:   uint32_t hcnt;
212:   uint32_t lcnt;
213: 
214:   /* Fast Mode: HCNT = pclk/freq - 1, LCNT = pclk/freq */
215: 
216:   hcnt = pclk / 400000 - 1;
217:   lcnt = pclk / 400000;
218: 
219:   /* Clamp 到最小值 (来源: hal_i2c.h + 历史经验) */
220: 
221:   if (hcnt < FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH)
222:     {
223:       hcnt = FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH;
224:     }
225: 
226:   if (lcnt < FS_MIN_SCL_LOW)
227:     {
228:       lcnt = FS_MIN_SCL_LOW;
229:     }
230: 
231:   /* 设置 Fast Mode 速度 */
232: 
233:   reg = i2c_getreg(base, I2C_CTL);
234:   reg &= ~I2C_CTL_SPEED_MASK;
235:   reg |= I2C_CTL_SPEED_FS;
236:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_CTL, reg);
237: 
238:   /* 写入 HCNT/LCNT */
239: 
240:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT, hcnt);
241:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT, lcnt);
242: 
243:   /* RX FIFO threshold = FIFO_DEPTH/2 */
244: 
245:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_RX_TL, I2C_FIFO_DEPTH / 2 - 1);
246: }
247: 
248: /****************************************************************************
249:  * Name: d13x_i2c_transfer_one
250:  *
251:  * Description:
252:  *   执行单条 I2C 消息传输
253:  *
254:  ****************************************************************************/
255: 
256: static int d13x_i2c_transfer_one(struct d13x_i2c_dev_s *priv,
257:                                   FAR struct i2c_msg_s *msg)
258: {
259:   uint32_t base = priv->base;
260:   int remaining;
261:   int ret = OK;
262:   uint32_t timeout;
263:   uint32_t reg_val;
264: 
265:   /* 等待总线空闲 */
266: 
267:   ret = i2c_wait_bus_idle(base, I2C_TIMEOUT_MS);
268:   if (ret < 0)
269:     {
270:       return ret;
271:     }
272: 
273:   /* 禁用模块 → 设置目标地址 → 重新使能 */
274: 
275:   i2c_module_disable(base);
276: 
277:   reg_val = i2c_getreg(base, I2C_TAR);
278:   reg_val &= ~0x3ff;
279:   reg_val |= (msg->addr & 0x3ff);
280:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_TAR, reg_val);
281: 
282:   /* 确保 master 模式 + restart enable */
283: 
284:   reg_val = i2c_getreg(base, I2C_CTL);
285:   reg_val |= I2C_CTL_MASTER | I2C_CTL_RESTART_EN;
286:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_CTL, reg_val);
287: 
288:   /* 清除所有中断 */
289: 
290:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xffff);
291: 
292:   i2c_module_enable(base);
293: 
294:   if (msg->flags & I2C_M_READ)
295:     {
296:       /* === 读操作 === */
297: 
298:       remaining = msg->length;
299: 
300:       while (remaining > 0)
301:         {
302:           int burst = remaining > I2C_FIFO_DEPTH ?
303:                       I2C_FIFO_DEPTH : remaining;
304:           int i;
305: 
306:           /* 发送读命令 */
307: 
308:           for (i = 0; i < burst - 1; i++)
309:             {
310:               i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD, I2C_DATA_CMD_READ);
311:             }
312: 
313:           /* 最后一个字节带 STOP */
314: 
315:           if (remaining <= I2C_FIFO_DEPTH)
316:             {
317:               i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD,
318:                          I2C_DATA_CMD_READ | I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP);
319:             }
320:           else
321:             {
322:               i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD, I2C_DATA_CMD_READ);
323:             }
324: 
325:           /* 等待数据到达 */
326: 
327:           timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_MS;
328:           while (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_RXFLR) < burst)
329:             {
330:               if (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)
331:                 {
332:                   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xffff);
333:                   return -EIO;
334:                 }
335: 
336:               if (--timeout == 0)
337:                 {
338:                   return -ETIMEDOUT;
339:                 }
340: 
341:               up_udelay(100);
342:             }
343: 
344:           /* 读取数据 */
345: 
346:           for (i = 0; i < burst; i++)
347:             {
348:               *msg->buffer++ = (uint8_t)(i2c_getreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD) & 0xff);
349:             }
350: 
351:           remaining -= burst;
352:         }
353: 
354:       /* 等待 STOP */
355: 
356:       timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_MS;
357:       while (!(i2c_getreg(base, I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & I2C_INTR_STOP_DET))
358:         {
359:           if (--timeout == 0)
360:             {
361:               return -ETIMEDOUT;
362:             }
363: 
364:           up_udelay(100);
365:         }
366:     }
367:   else
368:     {
369:       /* === 写操作 === */
370: 
371:       remaining = msg->length;
372: 
373:       while (remaining > 0)
374:         {
375:           int burst = remaining > I2C_FIFO_DEPTH ?
376:                       I2C_FIFO_DEPTH : remaining;
377:           int i;
378: 
379:           for (i = 0; i < burst - 1; i++)
380:             {
381:               /* 等待 TX FIFO 有空间 */
382: 
383:               timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_MS;
384:               while (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_TXFLR) >= I2C_FIFO_DEPTH)
385:                 {
386:                   if (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)
387:                     {
388:                       i2c_putreg(base, I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xffff);
389:                       return -EIO;
390:                     }
391: 
392:                   if (--timeout == 0)
393:                     {
394:                       return -ETIMEDOUT;
395:                     }
396: 
397:                   up_udelay(100);
398:                 }
399: 
400:               i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD, *msg->buffer++);
401:             }
402: 
403:           /* 最后一个字节带 STOP */
404: 
405:           timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_MS;
406:           while (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_TXFLR) >= I2C_FIFO_DEPTH)
407:             {
408:               if (--timeout == 0)
409:                 {
410:                   return -ETIMEDOUT;
411:                 }
412: 
413:               up_udelay(100);
414:             }
415: 
416:           i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD,
417:                      I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP | (*msg->buffer++));
418: 
419:           remaining -= burst;
420:         }
421: 
422:       /* 等待 STOP */
423: 
424:       timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_MS;
425:       while (!(i2c_getreg(base, I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & I2C_INTR_STOP_DET))
426:         {
427:           if (--timeout == 0)
428:             {
429:               return -ETIMEDOUT;
430:             }
431: 
432:           up_udelay(100);
433:         }
434:     }
435: 
436:   /* 清除中断 */
437: 
438:   i2c_putreg(base, I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xffff);
439: 
440:   return msg->length;
441: }
442: 
443: /****************************************************************************
444:  * Name: d13x_i2c_transfer
445:  ****************************************************************************/
446: 
447: static int d13x_i2c_transfer(FAR struct i2c_master_s *dev,
448:                               FAR struct i2c_msg_s *msgs, int count)
449: {
450:   FAR struct d13x_i2c_dev_s *priv = (FAR struct d13x_i2c_dev_s *)dev;
451:   int i;
452:   int ret;
453: 
454:   DEBUGASSERT(dev);
455:   DEBUGASSERT(msgs);
456:   DEBUGASSERT(count > 0);
457: 
458:   for (i = 0; i < count; i++)
459:     {
460:       ret = d13x_i2c_transfer_one(priv, &msgs[i]);
461:       if (ret < 0)
462:         {
463:           return ret;
464:         }
465:     }
466: 
467:   return OK;
468: }
469: 
470: #ifdef CONFIG_I2C_RESET
471: /****************************************************************************
472:  * Name: d13x_i2c_reset
473:  ****************************************************************************/
474: 
475: static int d13x_i2c_reset(FAR struct i2c_master_s *dev)
476: {
477:   FAR struct d13x_i2c_dev_s *priv = (FAR struct d13x_i2c_dev_s *)dev;
478: 
479:   DEBUGASSERT(dev);
480: 
481:   i2c_module_disable(priv->base);
482:   i2c_module_enable(priv->base);
483: 
484:   return OK;
485: }
486: #endif
487: 
488: /****************************************************************************
489:  * Public Functions
490:  ****************************************************************************/
491: 
492: /****************************************************************************
493:  * Name: d13x_i2c_initialize
494:  *
495:  * Description:
496:  *   初始化指定的 I2C 总线并返回 i2c_master_s 句柄
497:  *
498:  * Input Parameters:
499:  *   bus - I2C 总线编号 (0, 1, 2)
500:  *
501:  * Returned Value:
502:  *   成功返回 i2c_master_s 指针，失败返回 NULL
503:  *
504:  ****************************************************************************/
505: 
506: FAR struct i2c_master_s *d13x_i2c_initialize(int bus)
507: {
508:   FAR struct d13x_i2c_dev_s *priv;
509:   uint32_t reg;
510: 
511:   switch (bus)
512:     {
513:       case 0:
514:         priv = &g_d13x_i2c0;
515:         break;
516:       case 1:
517:         priv = &g_d13x_i2c1;
518:         break;
519:       case 2:
520:         priv = &g_d13x_i2c2;
521:         break;
522:       default:
523:         ierr("Invalid I2C bus: %d\n", bus);
524:         return NULL;
525:     }
526: 
527:   /* 确保模块禁用 */
528: 
529:   i2c_module_disable(priv->base);
530: 
531:   /* 设置 master 模式 */
532: 
533:   reg = i2c_getreg(priv->base, I2C_CTL);
534:   reg |= I2C_CTL_MASTER | I2C_CTL_RESTART_EN;
535:   i2c_putreg(priv->base, I2C_CTL, reg);
536: 
537:   /* 设置 SCL 时序 (APB0 = 100MHz) */
538: 
539:   d13x_i2c_set_speed(priv->base, D13X_APB0_FREQ);
540: 
541:   iinfo("I2C%d initialized at 0x%08" PRIx32 "\n", bus, priv->base);
542: 
543:   return &priv->dev;
544: }
