1: # 适配 I2C Master 驱动
2: 
3: [ [English](../../../../../en/device_dev_guide/driver/bus_driver/I2C/i2c_master_guide.md) | 简体中文 ]
4: 
5: 本文档介绍如何为 openvela 适配一个标准的 I2C Master 驱动，使其能够作为总线主设备工作。
6: 
7: ## 一、驱动框架层级
8: 
9: I2C Master 驱动的开发涉及驱动层、板级层和应用层，它们之间的协作关系如下：
10: 
11: ### 驱动层 (Driver)
12: 
13: 负责实现芯片相关的 I2C 底层硬件操作。此层需要封装硬件细节，并向上层提供一个标准化的 `i2c_master_s` 句柄。
14: 
15: ```C
16: /* 1. 定义底层操作函数集 */
17: static const struct i2c_ops_s bl602_i2c_ops =
18: {
19:     .transfer = bl602_i2c_transfer,
20: #ifdef CONFIG_I2C_RESET
21:     .reset = bl602_i2c_reset
22: #endif
23: };
24: 
25: /* 2. 定义私有数据结构，包含操作函数集和配置信息 */
26: static struct bl602_i2c_priv_s bl602_i2c0_priv =
27: {
28:     .ops      = &bl602_i2c_ops,
29:     .config   = &bl602_i2c0_config,
30: };
31: 
32: /* 3. 实现初始化函数，返回标准的 I2C Master 句柄 */
33: struct i2c_master_s *bl602_i2cbus_initialize(int port)
34: {
35:     priv = (struct bl602_i2c_priv_s *)&bl602_i2c0_priv;
36:     
37:     return (struct i2c_master_s *)priv;
38: }
39: ```
40: 
41: ### 板级层 (Board)
42: 
43: 在系统启动阶段，调用驱动层的初始化函数获取 I2C 总线句柄。根据需求，可以选择性地将该总线注册为字符设备（如 `/dev/i2c-0`），或直接传递给其他内核驱动（如传感器驱动）使用。
44: 
45: ```C
46: /* 获取 I2C 总线句柄 */
47: i2c_bus = bl602_i2cbus_initialize(0);
48: 
49: /* 将总线注册为 /dev/i2c0 */
50: i2c_register(i2c_bus, 0);
51: ```
52: 
53: ### 应用层 (Application)
54: 
55: 通过标准的 POSIX 文件接口（`open`, `ioctl` 等）访问已注册的 `/dev/i2c-N` 设备节点，从而与挂载在总线上的 I2C 从设备通信。
56: 
57: ```C
58: fd = open("/dev/i2c", O_RDWR);
59: ioctl(fd, );
60: ...
61: ```
62: 
63: ## 二、适配南向接口 (Lower Half)
64: 
65: 南向接口适配的核心任务是实现芯片的底层驱动，并提供一个标准的初始化函数 `xxx_i2cbus_initialize()`，其中 `xxx` 代表芯片（Chip）名称。
66: 
67: ### 1、Kconfig 配置选项
68: 
69: 请在 Kconfig 中启用以下配置项以支持 I2C Master 驱动：
70: 
71: ```Makefile
72: CONFIG_I2C=y          # 必需，启用 I2C 子系统
73: CONFIG_I2C_DRIVER=y   # 必需，启用 I2C 字符设备驱动上层
74: CONFIG_I2C_RESET=y    # 可选，如果需要支持总线复位功能
75: ```
76: 
77: ### 2、核心数据结构
78: 
79: openvela I2C Master 驱动围绕 `struct i2c_master_s` 和 `struct i2c_ops_s` 这两个核心结构进行抽象。
80: 
81: ```C
82: /*
83:  * I2C Master 操作函数集。
84:  * 驱动开发者需要实现其中的函数指针，特别是 transfer 函数。
85:  */
86: struct i2c_ops_s
87: {
88:   /* 核心传输函数，必需 */
89:   CODE int (*transfer)(FAR struct i2c_master_s *dev,
90:                        FAR struct i2c_msg_s *msgs, int count);
91: #ifdef CONFIG_I2C_RESET
92:   /* 可选的总线复位函数 */
93:   CODE int (*reset)(FAR struct i2c_master_s *dev);
94: #endif
95: };
96: 
97: /*
98:  * I2C Master 设备句柄。
99:  * 这是南向驱动向上层提供的标准接口。
100:  * 开发者通常会定义一个包含此结构的私有设备结构体。
101:  */
102: struct i2c_master_s
103: {
104:   FAR const struct i2c_ops_s *ops; /* 指向操作函数集的指针 */
105: };
106: ```
107: 
108: ### 3、驱动入口函数说明
109: 
110: 您需要根据下表的要求，在芯片驱动文件（`xxx_i2c.c`）中实现 `xxx_i2cbus_initialize()` 函数。
111: 
112: | **项目**     | **描述**                                                                                                                                                             |
113: | :----------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
114: | **函数原型** | `struct i2c_master_s *xxx_i2cbus_initialize(int port)`                                                                                                               |
115: | **参数**     | `port`：I2C 总线端口号。如果芯片支持多路 I2C，您需要根据此参数进行多路配置。                                                                                         |
116: | **返回值**   | 返回一个标准的 `i2c_master_s` 操作句柄。如果初始化失败，则返回 `NULL`。                                                                                              |
117: | **实现内容** | 初始化 I2C 控制器所需的时钟和 GPIO。如果使用中断模式，还需配置并使能中断。填充并返回一个包含 `transfer` 函数指针的 `i2c_master_s` 句柄，用于处理上层的数据传输请求。 |
118: | **文件位置** | chip 路径下的 `xxx_i2c.c`，`xxx` 为 chip 名称。                                                                                                                      |
119: | **调用位置** | board 路径下的 `xxx_bringup.c` 里调用，`xxx` 为 `board` 名字。                                                                                                       |
120: 
121: ### 4、适配实现步骤
122: 
123: 本节通过代码示例，展示如何分步完成 I2C Master 驱动的适配。
124: 
125: - **参考实现**：[bl602_i2c.c](https://github.com/apache/nuttx/blob/master/arch/risc-v/src/bl602/bl602_i2c.c)
126: 
127: #### 步骤一：定义私有设备结构体
128: 
129: 我们强烈建议您定义一个私有结构体，用于封装 I2C 控制器的所有状态信息，例如配置、锁、信号量以及运行时数据等。以下是 `bl602` 芯片的私有结构体示例：
130: 
131: > **核心要点：结构体成员布局** 为确保类型安全转换，私有结构体的**第一个成员**必须是 `const struct i2c_ops_s *ops;`。这使得框架可以将您的私有结构体指针安全地转换为标准的 `struct i2c_master_s *` 句柄。
132: 
133: <details>
134: <summary>点击展开代码</summary>
135: 
136: ```C
137: /* 位于: arch/risc-v/src/bl602/bl602_i2c.c */
138: 
139: /* bl602 I2C 驱动的私有数据结构 */
140: struct bl602_i2c_priv_s
141: {
142:   /* 必须作为第一个成员，以兼容 i2c_master_s 类型转换 */
143:   const struct i2c_ops_s *ops; /* Standard I2C operations */
144: 
145:   /* 端口配置 */
146:   const struct bl602_i2c_config_s *config;
147: 
148:   /* 状态与同步机制 */
149:   uint8_t  subflag;   /* Sub address flag */
150:   uint32_t subaddr;   /* Sub address */
151:   uint8_t  sublen;    /* Sub address length */
152:   mutex_t  lock;      /* Mutual exclusion mutex */
153:   sem_t    sem_isr;   /* Interrupt wait semaphore */
154: 
155:   /* 运行时数据 */
156:   /* I2C work state */
157:   uint8_t i2cstate;
158: 
159:   struct i2c_msg_s *msgv; /* Message list */
160: 
161:   uint8_t msgid; /* Current message ID */
162:   ssize_t bytes; /* Processed data bytes */
163:   int     refs;  /* Reference count */
164: };
165: ```
166: 
167: </details>
168: 
169: #### 步骤二：实现初始化函数 `xxx_i2cbus_initialize()`
170: 
171: 此函数负责完成硬件初始化，并返回一个配置好的 I2C Master 句柄。
172: 
173: <details>
174: <summary>点击展开代码</summary>
175: 
176: ```C
177: struct i2c_master_s *bl602_i2cbus_initialize(int port)
178: {
179:   struct bl602_i2c_priv_s         *priv;
180:   const struct bl602_i2c_config_s *config;
181: 
182:   /* 1. 根据 port 号获取对应的私有设备实例 */
183:   switch (port)
184:     {
185: #ifdef CONFIG_BL602_I2C0
186:     case 0:
187:       priv = (struct bl602_i2c_priv_s *)&bl602_i2c0_priv;
188:       break;
189: #endif
190:     default:
191:       return NULL;
192:     }
193: 
194:   config = priv->config;
195: /*************************************************
196: 此部分是把IIC配置为中断，不配置中断可以把此部分替换成IIC GPIO以及时钟初始化
197:   
198:   nxmutex_lock(&priv->lock);
199:   if (++priv->refs > 1)
200:   {
201:     nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
202:     return (struct i2c_master_s *)priv;
203:   }
204: 
205:   bl602_configgpio(BOARD_I2C_SCL);
206:   bl602_configgpio(BOARD_I2C_SDA);
207: 
208:   bl602_i2c_set_freq(config->clk_freq);
209:   bl602_i2c_disable();
210:   up_enable_irq(BL602_IRQ_I2C);
211:   bl602_i2c_intmask(I2C_INT_ALL, 1);
212:   irq_attach(BL602_IRQ_I2C, bl602_i2c_irq, priv);
213: **************************************************/
214:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
215: 
216:    /* 2. 返回私有结构体指针，并强制转换为标准句柄类型 */
217:   return (struct i2c_master_s *)priv;
218: }
219: ```
220: 
221: </details>
222: 
223: #### 步骤三：在板级代码中调用
224: 
225: 在板级初始化代码（`xxx_bringup.c`）中，调用芯片驱动提供的初始化函数，并根据需要将 I2C 总线注册为系统设备。
226: 
227: - **参考实现**：[bl602_bringup.c](https://github.com/apache/nuttx/blob/master/boards/risc-v/bl602/bl602evb/src/bl602_bringup.c)
228: 
229: <details>
230: <summary>点击展开代码</summary>
231: 
232: ```C
233: #ifdef CONFIG_I2C
234:   /* 初始化 I2C 总线 0 */
235:   i2c_bus = bl602_i2cbus_initialize(0);
236:   
237:   /* 2. (可选) 将总线注册为 /dev/i2c-0 设备节点 */
238:   i2c_register(i2c_bus, 0);
239: #endif
240: ```
241: 
242: </details>
243: 
244: **`i2c_register()`** **使用说明**
245: 
246: - **注册为设备节点**：调用 `i2c_register(i2c_bus, N)` 会创建字符设备节点 `/dev/i2c-N`。这使得用户空间应用（如测试程序、`i2ctool`）能通过标准文件接口访问 I2C 总线。
247: - **仅供内核使用**：如果某个 I2C 总线仅供内核中的其他驱动（如板载传感器）使用，您可以不调用 `i2c_register()`。直接将 `i2c_bus` 句柄传递给相应驱动的注册函数即可。
248: 
249: ## 三、北向使用
250: 
251: 当 I2C Master 驱动被成功注册后，系统会创建 `/dev/i2c-N` 格式的设备节点（例如 `/dev/i2c-0`, `/dev/i2c-1` 等）。应用程序可以通过这些设备节点，使用标准的 POSIX 文件接口与挂载在 I2C 总线上的从设备进行通信。
252: 
253: ### 1、API 列表
254: 
255: I2C 设备节点支持以下标准文件操作接口：
256: 
257: | **API**                                                  | **描述**                                                                |
258: | :------------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
259: | `int open(FAR const char *path, int oflag, ...);`        | 打开 I2C 设备节点，例如 `"/dev/i2c-0"`。                                |
260: | `int  close(int `*`fd`*`);`                              | 关闭已打开的设备文件描述符。                                            |
261: | `int ioctl(int fd, int req, ...)`                        | **核心通信接口**。通过发送特定命令来执行 I2C 读写、总线复位等复杂操作。 |
262: | `ssize_t read(int fd, ...)` `ssize_t write(int fd, ...)` | **暂未使用**。                                                          |
263: 
264: ### 2、`ioctl()` 核心接口
265: 
266: `ioctl()` 是与 I2C 设备进行数据交互的主要方式。openvela 定义了以下标准 `ioctl` 命令：
267: 
268: #### `I2CIOC_TRANSFER`
269: 
270: 执行一次或多次 I2C 消息传输。这是最核心、最常用的命令。它使用 `struct i2c_transfer_s` 结构体来描述整个传输任务。
271: 
272: ```C
273: /* 定义一个 I2C 传输任务，可包含一个或多个消息 */
274: struct i2c_transfer_s
275: {
276:   FAR struct i2c_msg_s *msgv; /* Array of I2C messages for the transfer */
277:   size_t msgc;                /* Number of messages in the array. */
278: };
279: ```
280: 
281: 每个 I2C 消息由 `struct i2c_msg_s` 定义，用于描述单次读或写操作：
282: 
283: ```C
284: #define I2C_M_READ           0x0001 /* Read data, from slave to master */
285: #define I2C_M_NOSTOP         0x0040 /* Message should not end with a STOP */
286: #define I2C_M_NOSTART        0x0080 /* Message should not begin with a START */
287: 
288: struct i2c_msg_s
289: {
290:   uint32_t frequency;         /* I2C frequency */
291:   uint16_t addr;              /* Slave address (7- or 10-bit) */
292:   uint16_t flags;             /* See I2C_M_* definitions */
293:   FAR uint8_t *buffer;        /* Buffer to be transferred */
294:   ssize_t length;             /* Length of the buffer in bytes */
295: };
296: ```
297: 
298: #### `CONFIG_I2C_RESET`
299: 
300: 复位 I2C 总线。此命令在总线锁死或出现异常时非常有用。要使用此功能，必须在 Kconfig 中启用 `CONFIG_I2C_RESET`。调用时无需第三个参数。
301: 
302: ### 3、复合传输示例：读取传感器寄存器
303: 
304: 本节提供一个完整的示例，演示如何执行一次**复合传输 (Combined Transfer)** 来读取 I2C 设备的寄存器值。这是与 I2C 传感器等设备通信的典型场景，其过程分为两步：
305: 
306: 1. **写操作**：向从设备发送要读取的**寄存器地址**。
307: 2. **读操作**：紧接着从该寄存器**读取数据**。
308: 
309: #### 步骤一：Kconfig 配置
310: 
311: 确保您的项目中已启用以下配置：
312: 
313: ```Makefile
314: CONFIG_I2C=y
315: CONFIG_I2C_DRIVER=y
316: ```
317: 
318: #### 步骤二：读写示例代码
319: 
320: 以下代码从指定的 I2C 从机地址和寄存器地址读取一个字节的数据。
321: 
322: <details>
323: <summary>点击展开代码</summary>
324: 
325: ```C
326: #include <stdio.h>
327: #include <fcntl.h>
328: #include <sys/types.h>
329: #include <sys/stat.h>
330: #include <sys/ioctl.h>
331: #include <nuttx/i2c/i2c_master.h>
332: 
333: // 含义：使用 /dev/i2c-8，访问从机地址 0x68，读取寄存器 0x00 的值
334: //./i2c_test.out /dev/i2c-8 0x68 0x60
335: 
336: 
337: int main(int argc, char **argv)
338: {
339:   int fd,ret;
340:   uint8_t val;
341:   char dev_name[20];
342:   unsigned int slave_address,reg_address;
343:   struct i2c_transfer_s work;
344: 
345:   snprintf(dev_name, sizeof(dev_name),"%s", argv[1]);
346: 
347:   /* 1. 打开 I2C 设备节点 */
348:   fd = open(dev_name, O_RDWR);
349:   if (fd < 0)
350:    {
351:      printf("open failed: %d\n", fd);
352:      return fd;
353:    }
354: 
355:   /* 2. 准备 I2C 消息 */
356:   work.msgc = 2;
357:   work.msgv = (struct i2c_msg_s *)malloc(work.msgc * sizeof(struct i2c_msg_s));
358:   if (NULL == work.msgv)
359:     {
360:       printf("Memory alloc error\n");
361:       close(fd);
362:       return -1;
363:     }
364: 
365:   sscanf(argv[2], "%x", &slave_address);
366:   sscanf(argv[3], "%x", &reg_address);
367: 
368:   val = reg_address;
369:   /* 消息 1: 写操作，发送要读取的寄存器地址 */
370:   (work.msgv[0]).frequency=400000;
371:   (work.msgv[0]).length = 1;
372:   (work.msgv[0]).addr = slave_address;
373:   (work.msgv[0]).buffer = &val;
374:   (work.msgv[0]).flags = I2C_M_NOSTOP;
375: 
376:   /* 消息 2: 读操作，从设备读取一个字节的数据 */
377:   (work.msgv[1]).frequency=400000;
378:   (work.msgv[1]).length = 1;
379:   (work.msgv[1]).flags = I2C_M_READ;
380:   (work.msgv[1]).addr = slave_address;
381:   (work.msgv[1]).buffer = &val;
382: 
383:   /* 3. 执行 ioctl 调用，发起传输 */
384:   ret = ioctl(fd, I2CIOC_TRANSFER, &work);
385:   if (ret < 0)
386:   {
387:      printf("i2c: ioctl(I2CIOC_TRANSFER) failed: %d\n",fd);
388:      free( work.msgv);
389:      close(fd);
390:      return -1;
391:   }
392: 
393:   printf("reg:0x%02X val:%02x\n", reg_address, val);
394:   free( work.msgv);
395:   close(fd);
396: 
397:   return 0;
398: }
399: ```
400: 
401: </details>
402: 
403: ## 四、验证与测试
404: 
405: - 请参考 [I2C 驱动的验证与调试](./i2c_verification_guide.md)来测试您的驱动。

# D13x I2C 驱动 — 第三轮逐行审核报告

## 检查项 1：i2c_ops_s 结构体

**代码片段** (artinchip_i2c.c:123-129):
```c
static const struct i2c_ops_s g_d13x_i2c_ops =
{
  .transfer  = d13x_i2c_transfer,
#ifdef CONFIG_I2C_RESET
  .reset     = d13x_i2c_reset,
#endif
};
```

**文档要求** (i2c_master_guide.md:86-95): `i2c_ops_s` 仅包含 `transfer`（必需）+ `reset`（CONFIG_I2C_RESET 条件编译可选）。

**结论: ✅ 通过** — 结构体成员与文档完全一致，无多余字段。

---

## 检查项 2：i2c_master_s 嵌入与类型转换安全性

**私有结构体** (artinchip_i2c.c:101-107):
```c
struct d13x_i2c_dev_s
{
  struct i2c_master_s  dev;       /* NuttX I2C upper-half */
  uint32_t             base;
  uint32_t             freq;
  uint8_t              irq;
};
```

**实例初始化** (artinchip_i2c.c:133-135):
```c
static struct d13x_i2c_dev_s g_d13x_i2c0 =
{
  .dev  = { &g_d13x_i2c_ops },
```

**文档要求** (i2c_master_guide.md:131): "私有结构体的**第一个成员**必须是 `const struct i2c_ops_s *ops`，确保类型安全转换。"

**结论: ✅ 通过** — `struct i2c_master_s dev` 是第一个成员，其内部 `ops` 字段由 `{ &g_d13x_i2c_ops }` 初始化。`d13x_i2c_transfer()` 第 450 行的 `(FAR struct d13x_i2c_dev_s *)dev` 转换安全。

---

## 检查项 3：d13x_i2c_transfer() 标志位处理

### 3a. I2C_M_READ 标志

**代码片段** (artinchip_i2c.c:294):
```c
if (msg->flags & I2C_M_READ)
```

**结论: ✅ 通过** — 读写分支分离正确。

### 3b. I2C_M_NOSTOP 标志

**文档定义** (i2c_master_guide.md:285): `#define I2C_M_NOSTOP 0x0040`

**文档使用示例** (i2c_master_guide.md:374): 复合传输的写阶段使用 `I2C_M_NOSTOP` 表示"不发送 STOP，后续还有读消息"。

**读路径 STOP 判断** (artinchip_i2c.c:315-323):
```c
if (remaining <= I2C_FIFO_DEPTH)
  {
    i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD,
               I2C_DATA_CMD_READ | I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP);
  }
else
  {
    i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD, I2C_DATA_CMD_READ);
  }
```

**写路径 STOP 判断** (artinchip_i2c.c:416-417):
```c
i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD,
           I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP | (*msg->buffer++));
```

**d13x_i2c_transfer_one() 内无任何 `I2C_M_NOSTOP` 检查** — 搜索全文 `NOSTOP` 关键词，零匹配。

**结论: ❌ 不通过** — 驱动在每条消息的最后一个字节**无条件**发送 STOP。当上层发出复合传输（如 `msg[0]` 写寄存器地址带 `I2C_M_NOSTOP` + `msg[1]` 读数据），`msg[0]` 仍会发送 STOP，导致复合传输断裂。这是关键功能缺失。

### 3c. I2C_M_NOSTART 标志

**文档定义** (i2c_master_guide.md:286): `#define I2C_M_NOSTART 0x0080`

**代码路径** — `d13x_i2c_transfer()` 逐条调用 `d13x_i2c_transfer_one()`，而 `d13x_i2c_transfer_one()` 在第 275 行执行 `i2c_module_disable(base)` + 第 292 行 `i2c_module_enable(base)`，这个 disable/enable 循环会触发新的 START 条件。

**全文搜索 `NOSTART`** — 零匹配。

**结论: ❌ 不通过** — 驱动对每条消息都重新 disable→enable 控制器，强制产生新 START。`I2C_M_NOSTART` 被完全忽略。

---

## 检查项 4：时序参数 HCNT/LCNT clamp

**宏定义** (artinchip_i2c.c:90-91):
```c
#define FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH              600
#define FS_MIN_SCL_LOW               1300
```

**注释说明** (artinchip_i2c.c:88): `/* Fast Mode 最小 SCL 时序 (来源: hal_i2c.h) */`

**计算函数** (artinchip_i2c.c:208-245):
```c
static void d13x_i2c_set_speed(uint32_t base, uint32_t pclk)
{
  hcnt = pclk / 400000 - 1;
  lcnt = pclk / 400000;
  if (hcnt < FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH) hcnt = FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH;
  if (lcnt < FS_MIN_SCL_LOW)  lcnt = FS_MIN_SCL_LOW;
```

**调用处** (artinchip_i2c.c:539):
```c
d13x_i2c_set_speed(priv->base, D13X_APB0_FREQ);
```

**chip.h 第 89 行**: `D13X_APB0_FREQ = 100000000` (100MHz)

**数值推演**:
- `pclk = 100,000,000` Hz
- `hcnt_raw = 100000000 / 400000 - 1 = 249`
- `lcnt_raw = 100000000 / 400000 = 250`
- `249 < 600` → hcnt 被钳位到 **600**
- `250 < 1300` → lcnt 被钳位到 **1300**
- 实际频率 = `pclk / (hcnt + lcnt) = 100000000 / 1900 ≈ **52.6 KHz**`

**I2C Fast Mode 规范要求**:
- SCL high ≥ 600ns
- SCL low ≥ 1300ns

DesignWare I2C 的 HCNT/LCNT 寄存器单位是 **APB 时钟周期**（10ns @ 100MHz），不是纳秒。正确最小值应为:
- `FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH = 600ns / 10ns = 60` 个时钟周期
- `FS_MIN_SCL_LOW  = 1300ns / 10ns = 130` 个时钟周期

**结论: ❌ 不通过** — clamp 值使用了纳秒原始值而非时钟周期数，导致实际 SCL 频率降至 ~53 KHz，远低于 Fast Mode 400 KHz 要求。正确宏定义应为:
```c
#define FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH              60   /* 600ns / 10ns per clock */
#define FS_MIN_SCL_LOW               130  /* 1300ns / 10ns per clock */
```

---

## 检查项 5：FIFO 深度读写分批

**FIFO 深度** (artinchip_i2c.c:86): `#define I2C_FIFO_DEPTH 8`

### 5a. 读路径 (artinchip_i2c.c:300-352)

以 16 字节读取为例追踪:

| 迭代 | remaining | burst | 读命令数 | STOP? | RXFLR 等待 | 剩余 |
|------|-----------|-------|----------|-------|------------|------|
| 1 | 16 | 8 | 7+1=8 | 否 (remaining>I2C_FIFO_DEPTH) | ≥8 | 8 |
| 2 | 8 | 8 | 7+1=8 | 是 (remaining≤I2C_FIFO_DEPTH) | ≥8 | 0 |

读命令发送数量 = `burst-1`（不含 STOP 的）+ 1（含 STOP 的）= `burst`。**正确**。

以 9 字节读取为例:

| 迭代 | remaining | burst | 读命令数 | STOP? | RXFLR 等待 | 剩余 |
|------|-----------|-------|----------|-------|------------|------|
| 1 | 9 | 8 | 7+1=8 | 否 | ≥8 | 1 |
| 2 | 1 | 1 | 0+1=1 | 是 | ≥1 | 0 |

读取 9 字节: 8+1=9。**正确**。

### 5b. 写路径 (artinchip_i2c.c:373-420)

```c
for (i = 0; i < burst - 1; i++)
{
  // ...等待 TX FIFO 有空间...
  i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD, *msg->buffer++);
}
// 最后一个字节带 STOP
i2c_putreg(base, I2C_DATA_CMD, I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP | (*msg->buffer++));
```

写命令数量 = `burst-1` + 1 = `burst`。写入的字节数 = `burst`。`remaining -= burst`。**正确**。

### 5c. TX FIFO 溢出检查

写路径第 384 行: `while (i2c_getreg(base, I2C_TXFLR) >= I2C_FIFO_DEPTH)` — 等待 FIFO 有空位才写入。

**结论: ✅ 通过** — 读写循环均按 8 字节正确分批，FIFO 溢出保护到位。

---

## 检查项 6：初始化函数名

**代码片段** (artinchip_i2c.c:506):
```c
FAR struct i2c_master_s *d13x_i2c_initialize(int bus)
```

**文档规范** (i2c_master_guide.md:65, 114): 函数原型应为 `xxx_i2cbus_initialize(int port)`，`xxx` 为芯片名称。

**对比**:
| 项目 | 规范要求 | 实际实现 |
|------|----------|----------|
| 函数名 | `d13x_i2cbus_initialize` | `d13x_i2c_initialize` |
| 参数名 | `port` | `bus` |

**结论: ❌ 不通过** — 函数名缺少 `_bus` 中缀，应为 `d13x_i2cbus_initialize`。参数名不一致（`bus` vs `port`）为次要问题。

---

## 检查点 4：HCNT/LCNT 时序钳位值

**宏定义** (artinchip_i2c.c:90-91):

```c
#define FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH              600
#define FS_MIN_SCL_LOW               1300
```

**注释** (artinchip_i2c.c:88): `/* Fast Mode 最小 SCL 时序 (来源: hal_i2c.h) */`

**计算函数** (artinchip_i2c.c:208-246):

```c
static void d13x_i2c_set_speed(uint32_t base, uint32_t pclk)
{
  hcnt = pclk / 400000 - 1;
  lcnt = pclk / 400000;
  if (hcnt < FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH) hcnt = FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH;   /* 行 221-224 */
  if (lcnt < FS_MIN_SCL_LOW)  lcnt = FS_MIN_SCL_LOW;    /* 行 226-229 */
  ...
  i2c_putreg(base, I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT, hcnt);              /* 行 240 */
  i2c_putreg(base, I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT, lcnt);              /* 行 241 */
}
```

**调用参数** (artinchip_i2c.c:539 + chip.h:89):

```c
d13x_i2c_set_speed(priv->base, D13X_APB0_FREQ);  /* pclk = 100,000,000 */
```

**数值推演**:

| 步骤 | 计算 | 结果 |
|------|------|------|
| hcnt_raw | 100000000 / 400000 − 1 | 249 |
| lcnt_raw | 100000000 / 400000 | 250 |
| 钳位 hcnt | 249 < 600 ? 600 : 249 | **600** |
| 钳位 lcnt | 250 < 1300 ? 1300 : 250 | **1300** |
| 实际 SCL 周期 | (600 + 1300) × 10ns | 19μs |
| **实际频率** | 1 / 19μs | **≈52.6 KHz** |

DesignWare I2C 控制器的 HCNT/LCNT 寄存器以 **APB 时钟周期** 为单位。100MHz 下每个周期 = 10ns。

I2C Fast Mode 规范最小值:
- SCL high time ≥ 600ns → 正确钳位值 = **60** 周期
- SCL low time ≥ 1300ns → 正确钳位值 = **130** 周期

当前代码将纳秒原始值直接写入时钟周期寄存器，导致实际频率仅 53 KHz，远低于 400 KHz 目标。

**判定**: ❌ 不通过 — 钳位宏应为 `FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH=60` 和 `FS_MIN_SCL_LOW=130`。当前值使总线运行在 Standard Mode 以下。

72: #define LVDS_0_PHY_CTL         0x30
73: #define LVDS_1_PHY_CTL         0x34
74: 
75: /* LVDS_CTL 位定义 */
76: 
77: #define LVDS_CTL_MODE_MASK     (3 << 8)
78: #define LVDS_CTL_MODE(x)       (((x) & 0x3) << 8)
79: #define LVDS_CTL_LINK_MASK     (3 << 4)
80: #define LVDS_CTL_LINK(x)       (((x) & 0x3) << 4)
81: #define LVDS_CTL_SWAP_EN       (1 << 2)
82: #define LVDS_CTL_SYNC_MODE_EN  (1 << 1)
83: #define LVDS_CTL_EN            (1 << 0)
84: 
85: /* LVDS PHY 配置 */
86: 
87: #define AIC_LVDS_SYNC_MODE_EN  1
88: #define AIC_LVDS_LINK_SWAP_EN  0
89: #define AIC_LVDS_LINES         0x43210
90: #define AIC_LVDS_POL           0x0
91: #define AIC_LVDS_PHY           0xFA
92: 
93: /* LVDS 模式 */
94: 
95: #define LVDS_NS                0x0
96: #define LVDS_SINGLE_LINK0      0x0
97: 
98: /* DE 寄存器偏移 (DPI 时序, 来源: D13x User Manual §9.3 DE) */
99: 
100: #define DE_TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE  0x00
101: #define DE_TIMING_H_PORCH      0x04
102: #define DE_TIMING_V_PORCH      0x08
103: #define DE_TIMING_SYNC_PLUSE   0x0C
104: #define DE_TIMING_CTRL_EN      0x10
105: 
106: /* DE_TIMING_CTRL_EN 位定义 */
107: 
108: #define DE_TIMING_EN           (1 << 0)
109: #define DE_TIMING_H_POL        (1 << 1)
110: #define DE_TIMING_V_POL        (1 << 2)
111: 
112: /* 面板时序参数 (1024×600, 来源: luban-lite panel_simple.c) */
113: 
114: #define PANEL_HACTIVE          1024
115: #define PANEL_VACTIVE          600
116: #define PANEL_HBP              160
117: #define PANEL_HFP              160
118: #define PANEL_HSYNC            20
119: #define PANEL_VBP              23
120: #define PANEL_VFP              12
121: #define PANEL_VSYNC            3
122: #define PANEL_PIXELCLOCK       51000000
123: 
124: /* 帧缓冲大小 = 宽 × 高 × 每像素字节数(32bpp) */
125: 
126: #define FB_SIZE                (PANEL_HACTIVE * PANEL_VACTIVE * 4)
127: 
128: /* PLL_FRA2 频率: 24MHz × 15.25 ≈ 364MHz */
129: 
130: #define PLL_DISP_FREQ_TARGET   (364 * 1000 * 1000)
131: #define PLL_FRA2_N_VALUE       14
132: #define PLL_FRA2_F_VALUE       0x2000
133: 
134: /****************************************************************************
135:  * Private Data
136:  ****************************************************************************/
137: 
138: struct d13x_lvds_dev_s
139: {
140:   uint32_t           base;
141:   uint32_t           pixclk;
142:   uint32_t           sclk;
143:   uint32_t           pll_disp;
144:   FAR void          *fbmem;        /* 帧缓冲内存 */
145:   size_t             fblen;
146:   bool               initialized;
147: };
148: 
149: static struct d13x_lvds_dev_s g_lvds_dev;
150: 
151: /****************************************************************************
152:  * Private Functions - 寄存器操作
153:  ****************************************************************************/
154: 
155: static inline void lvds_putreg(uint32_t offset, uint32_t val)
156: {
157:   putreg32(val, D13X_LVDS_BASE + offset);
158: }
159: 
160: static inline uint32_t lvds_getreg(uint32_t offset)
161: {
162:   return getreg32(D13X_LVDS_BASE + offset);
163: }
164: 
165: /****************************************************************************
166:  * Private Functions - 显示管线初始化
167:  ****************************************************************************/
168: 
169: static int d13x_pll_disp_init(void)
170: {
171:   uint32_t reg;
172:   uint32_t timeout;
173: 
174:   /* 配置 PLL_FRA2 → 364MHz (24MHz × (N+1 + F/16384)) */
175: 
176:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_FRA2_GEN);
177:   reg &= ~PLL_FRA2_N_MASK;
178:   reg |= (PLL_FRA2_N_VALUE << PLL_FRA2_N_SHIFT);
179:   reg |= PLL_FRA2_EN | PLL_FRA2_OUT_SYS;
180:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_FRA2_GEN);
181: 
182:   /* 配置小数分频 */
183: 
184:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_FRA2_FRA);
185:   reg &= ~(PLL_FRA2_FRAC_EN | PLL_FRA2_F_MASK);
186:   reg |= (PLL_FRA2_F_VALUE << PLL_FRA2_F_SHIFT);
187:   reg |= PLL_FRA2_FRAC_EN;
188:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_FRA2_FRA);
189: 
190:   /* 等待 PLL 锁定 */
191: 
192:   timeout = PLL_FRA2_TIMEOUT;
193:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_FRA2_GEN) & PLL_FRA2_EN))
194:     {
195:       if (--timeout == 0)
196:         {
197:           ierr("PLL_FRA2 lock timeout\n");
198:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
199:         }
200:     }
201: 
202:   return OK;
203: }
204: 
205: static void d13x_de_clk_enable(void)
206: {
207:   uint32_t reg;
208: 
209:   /* 使能 DE 显示时钟 */
210: 
211:   reg = getreg32(CMU_CLK_DISP);
212:   reg |= CLK_DISP_SCLK_GATE | CLK_DISP_PIX_GATE;
213:   putreg32(reg, CMU_CLK_DISP);
214: }
215: 
216: static void d13x_lvds_clk_enable(void)
217: {
218:   uint32_t reg;
219: 
220:   /* 使能 LVDS 时钟门控 */
221: 
222:   reg = getreg32(CMU_CLK_LVDS);
223:   reg |= CLK_LVDS_GATE;
224:   putreg32(reg, CMU_CLK_LVDS);
225: }
226: 
227: static void d13x_de_timing_enable(void)
228: {
229:   /* 水平时序 */
230: 
231:   putreg32((PANEL_HBP << 24) | (PANEL_HFP << 12) | PANEL_HSYNC,
232:            D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_H_PORCH);
233: 
234:   /* 垂直时序 */
235: 
236:   putreg32((PANEL_VBP << 24) | (PANEL_VFP << 12) | PANEL_VSYNC,
237:            D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_V_PORCH);
238: 
239:   /* 同步脉冲宽度 */
240: 
241:   putreg32((PANEL_HSYNC << 16) | PANEL_VSYNC,
242:            D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_SYNC_PLUSE);
243: 
244:   /* 活动区域尺寸 */
245: 
246:   putreg32((PANEL_HACTIVE << 16) | PANEL_VACTIVE,
247:            D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE);
248: 
249:   /* 使能 DE 时序输出 */
250: 
251:   putreg32(DE_TIMING_EN, D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_CTRL_EN);
252: }
253: 
254: static void d13x_lvds_phy_enable(void)
255: {
256:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_0_SWAP, AIC_LVDS_LINES);
257:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_1_SWAP, AIC_LVDS_LINES);
258:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_0_POL_CTL, AIC_LVDS_POL);
259:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_1_POL_CTL, AIC_LVDS_POL);
260:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_0_PHY_CTL, AIC_LVDS_PHY);
261:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_1_PHY_CTL, AIC_LVDS_PHY);
262: 
263:   uint32_t ctl = 0;
264:   ctl |= LVDS_CTL_MODE(LVDS_NS);
265:   ctl |= LVDS_CTL_LINK(LVDS_SINGLE_LINK0);
266:   if (AIC_LVDS_LINK_SWAP_EN)
267:     {
268:       ctl |= LVDS_CTL_SWAP_EN;
269:     }
270: 
271:   if (AIC_LVDS_SYNC_MODE_EN)
272:     {
273:       ctl |= LVDS_CTL_SYNC_MODE_EN;
274:     }
275: 
276:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_CTL, ctl);
277:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_CTL, ctl | LVDS_CTL_EN);
278: }
279: 
280: static void d13x_lvds_disable(void)
281: {
282:   uint32_t ctl = lvds_getreg(LVDS_CTL);
283:   ctl &= ~LVDS_CTL_EN;
284:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_CTL, ctl);
285: }
286: 
287: /****************************************************************************
288:  * Private Functions - FB vtable 回调
289:  ****************************************************************************/
290: 
291: static int d13x_fb_open(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable)
292: {
293:   return OK;
294: }
295: 
296: static int d13x_fb_close(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable)
297: {
298:   return OK;
299: }
300: 
301: static int d13x_fb_getvideoinfo(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
302:                                  FAR struct fb_videoinfo_s *vinfo)
303: {
304:   vinfo->fmt    = FB_FMT_RGB32;
305:   vinfo->xres   = PANEL_HACTIVE;
306:   vinfo->yres   = PANEL_VACTIVE;
307:   vinfo->nplanes = 1;
308:   return OK;
309: }
310: 
311: static int d13x_fb_getplaneinfo(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
312:                                  int planeno,
313:                                  FAR struct fb_planeinfo_s *pinfo)
314: {
315:   struct d13x_lvds_dev_s *dev = &g_lvds_dev;
316: 
317:   pinfo->bpp          = 32;
318:   pinfo->xres_virtual = PANEL_HACTIVE;
319:   pinfo->yres_virtual = PANEL_VACTIVE;
320:   pinfo->stride       = PANEL_HACTIVE * 4;
321:   pinfo->fblen        = dev->fblen;
322:   pinfo->fbmem        = dev->fbmem;
323:   pinfo->display      = 0;
324:   pinfo->xoffset      = 0;
325:   pinfo->yoffset      = 0;
326:   return OK;
327: }
328: 
329: static int d13x_fb_pandisplay(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
330:                                FAR struct fb_planeinfo_s *pinfo)
331: {
332:   /* 单缓冲模式，pan display 不做任何事 */
333: 
334:   return OK;
335: }
336: 
337: /****************************************************************************
338:  * Private Data - FB vtable
339:  ****************************************************************************/
340: 
341: static const struct fb_vtable_s g_fb_vtable =
342: {
343:   .open        = d13x_fb_open,
344:   .close       = d13x_fb_close,
345:   .getvideoinfo = d13x_fb_getvideoinfo,
346:   .getplaneinfo = d13x_fb_getplaneinfo,
347:   .pandisplay  = d13x_fb_pandisplay,
348: };
349: 
350: /****************************************************************************
351:  * Public Functions - NuttX FB 平台接口
352:  ****************************************************************************/
353: 
354: int up_fbinitialize(int display)
355: {
356:   struct d13x_lvds_dev_s *dev = &g_lvds_dev;
357: 
358:   if (dev->initialized)
359:     {
360:       return OK;
361:     }
362: 
363:   dev->base   = D13X_LVDS_BASE;
364:   dev->pixclk = PANEL_PIXELCLOCK;
365:   dev->fblen  = FB_SIZE;
366: 
367:   /* 分配帧缓冲内存（PSRAM 区域，cacheable） */
368: 
369:   dev->fbmem = kumm_memalign(64, dev->fblen);
370:   if (dev->fbmem == NULL)
371:     {
372:       ierr("Failed to allocate framebuffer (%zu bytes)\n", dev->fblen);
373:       return -ENOMEM;
374:     }
375: 
376:   memset(dev->fbmem, 0, dev->fblen);
377: 
378:   /* 显示管线初始化: PLL → DE时钟 → LVDS时钟 → DE时序 → LVDS PHY */
379: 
380:   int ret = d13x_pll_disp_init();
381:   if (ret < 0)
382:     {
383:       ierr("PLL lock timeout\n");
384:       return ret;
385:     }
386: 
387:   d13x_de_clk_enable();
388:   d13x_lvds_clk_enable();
389:   d13x_de_timing_enable();
390:   d13x_lvds_phy_enable();
391: 
392:   dev->initialized = true;
393: 
394:   iinfo("LVDS FB: %dx%d @ %luMHz, fbmem=%p, fblen=%zu\n",
395:         PANEL_HACTIVE, PANEL_VACTIVE,
396:         (unsigned long)(dev->pixclk / 1000000),
397:         dev->fbmem, dev->fblen);
398: 
399:   return OK;
400: }
401: 
402: FAR struct fb_vtable_s *up_fbgetvplane(int display, int vplane)
403: {
404:   if (display == 0 && vplane == 0)
405:     {
406:       return (FAR struct fb_vtable_s *)&g_fb_vtable;
407:     }
408: 
409:   return NULL;
410: }
411: 
412: void up_fbuninitialize(int display)
413: {
414:   struct d13x_lvds_dev_s *dev = &g_lvds_dev;
415: 
416:   d13x_lvds_disable();
417: 
418:   if (dev->fbmem != NULL)
419:     {
420:       kumm_free(dev->fbmem);
421:       dev->fbmem = NULL;
422:     }
423: 
424:   dev->initialized = false;
425: }

1: # Framebuffer 驱动
2: 
3: \[ [English](../../../en/device_dev_guide/graphics/Framebuffer_Driver.md) | 简体中文 \]
4: 
5: ## 一、什么是 Framebuffer
6: 
7: Framebuffer（帧缓存/显存）是一个用于存储一帧 LCD 图像数据的内存区域。在嵌入式系统中，Framebuffer 通常通过内存模拟实现，其大小由 LCD 的分辨率和每个像素的字节大小决定。
8: 
9: ### 1、Framebuffer 的大小计算
10: 
11: 以 480x320 的屏幕为例，在不同像素模式下，Framebuffer 的大小如下：
12: 
13: 1. ARGB888 (32bpp)：
14: 
15:     - 计算公式：`480 x 320 x 4 (bytes)`
16:     - 大小：614,400 字节
17: 
18: 2. RGB565 (16bpp)：
19: 
20:     - 计算公式：`480 x 320 x 2 (bytes)`
21:     - 大小：307,200 字节
22: 
23: ## 二、Framebuffer的显示原理
24: 
25: Framebuffer 的显示原理可以概括为：LCD 控制器（LCDC）从 Framebuffer 中读取像素数据，并通过并行数据接口将数据传输到 LCD 面板进行显示。
26: 
27: ### 1、显示流程图
28: 
29: 以下是 Framebuffer 的显示流程：
30: 
31: ![img](./figures/012.svg)
32: 
33: - Framebuffer：存储像素数据。
34: - LCDC：从 Framebuffer 中读取像素数据，并将其传输到 LCD 面板。
35: - LCD Panel：接收数据并显示图像。
36: 
37: ### 2、数据传输接口
38: 
39: LCDC 通过以下信号将数据传输到 LCD 面板：
40: 
41: - Clock：时钟信号，用于同步数据传输。
42: - Data：像素数据，包括 R（红）、G（绿）、B（蓝）三种颜色通道。
43: - Control：控制信号，用于管理数据传输的时序和状态。
44: 
45: ## 三、openvela Framebuffer 接口
46: 
47: openvela 的 Framebuffer 接口分为上层用户接口和下层驱动接口，分别为用户和设备驱动程序提供了灵活的操作能力。以下是接口的详细说明。
48: 
49: ### 1、上层用户接口
50: 
51: openvela 的 Framebuffer 用户接口类似于 Linux 系统，通过 VFS（虚拟文件系统）提供标准操作接口，包括 `open`、`close`、`read`、`write` 和 `ioctl` 等。用户可以通过操作 `/dev/fbx` 设备文件，完成以下功能：
52: 
53: 1. 映射 Framebuffer 到用户态：
54: 
55:     使用 `mmap` 将 Framebuffer 映射到用户空间，便于直接对 Framebuffer 进行读写操作。
56: 
57: 2. 切换 Framebuffer：
58: 
59:     用户可以通过 `ioctl` 接口切换不同的 Framebuffer 配置或模式。
60: 
61: ### 2、下层驱动接口
62: 
63: openvela 的 Framebuffer 驱动接口用于管理 LCD 设备，设计相对简单。开发者可以参考 [video/fb.h](../../../../../../nuttx/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/include/nuttx/video/fb.h) 和 [/drivers/video/fb.c](../../../../../../nuttx/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/drivers/video/fb.c) 文件中的实现。以下是 `fb_register()` 函数的源码，展示了与 Framebuffer 设备驱动相关的重要部分：
64: 
65: ```C
66: int fb_register(int display, int plane)
67: {
68:   FAR struct fb_chardev_s *fb;
69: 
70:   ...
71: 
72:   /* Initialize the frame buffer device. */
73:   ret = up_fbinitialize(display);
74:   if (ret < 0)
75:     {
76:       gerr("ERROR: up_fbinitialize() failed for display %d: %d\n",
77:            display, ret);
78:       goto errout_with_fb;
79:     }
80:   DEBUGASSERT((unsigned)plane <= UINT8_MAX);
81:   fb->plane  = plane;
82:   fb->vtable = up_fbgetvplane(display, plane);
83:   if (fb->vtable == NULL)
84:     {
85:       gerr("ERROR: up_fbgetvplane() failed, vplane=%d\n", plane);
86:       goto errout_with_fb;
87:     }
88:   /* Initialize the frame buffer instance. */
89:   ...
90: 
91:   ret = register_driver(devname, &fb_fops, 0666, (FAR void *)fb);
92:   if (ret < 0)
93:     {
94:       gerr("ERROR: register_driver() failed: %d\n", ret);
95:       goto errout_with_fb;
96:     }
97:   return OK;
98:   
99: errout_with_fb:
100:   kmm_free(fb);
101:   return ret;
102: }
103: ```
104: 
105: 从代码中可以看出，Framebuffer 针对 LCD 设备驱动程序提供了以下 3 个接口，驱动程序需要自行实现：
106: 
107: 1. `void up_fbinitialize(int display)`
108: 
109:     - 用于初始化硬件 LCD 控制器。
110:     - 例如，在 STM32 平台上，`up_fbinitialize` 函数需要初始化 LTDC（LCD-TFT 控制器）或 MIPI 接口，并完成 DSI 外设和 LCD IC 的初始化。
111: 
112: 2. `FAR struct fb_vtable_s *up_fbgetvplane(int display, int vplane)`
113: 
114:     - 获取 LCD 的 `fb_vtable_s` 结构体信息。
115:     - `fb_vtable_s` 是 Framebuffer 的核心结构，包含了 Framebuffer 的所有接口。通过实现该函数，LCD 控制器可以将自身信息注册到 Framebuffer 框架中。
116:     - 驱动程序可以参考以下示例实现：
117: 
118:         - `drivers/video/vnc/vnc_fbdev.c`
119:         - `boards/arm/stm32f7/stm32f746g-disco/stm32_lcd.c`
120: 
121: 3. `void up_fbuninitialize(int display)`
122: 
123:     - 执行与 `up_fbinitialize` 相反的操作，用于释放资源。通常可以实现为空，不执行任何操作。
124: 
125: ### 3、`struct fb_vtable_s` 结构
126: 
127: `fb_vtable_s` 是 Framebuffer 的核心结构，定义了与视频硬件交互的接口。以下是其主要功能模块：
128: 
129: 1. 核心功能。
130: 
131:     - `getvideoinfo`：获取视频控制器配置和颜色平面信息。
132:     - `getplaneinfo`：获取指定颜色平面的信息。
133: 
134: 2. 可选功能（根据配置启用）。
135: 
136:     - 颜色映射（`CONFIG_FB_CMAP`）：
137:         - `getcmap`：获取当前颜色映射表。
138:         - `putcmap`：更新颜色映射表。
139:     - 硬件光标（`CONFIG_FB_HWCURSOR`）：
140:         - `getcursor`：获取光标属性。
141:         - `setcursor`：设置光标配置。
142:     - 显示更新（`CONFIG_FB_UPDATE`）：
143:         - `updatearea`：通知硬件更新指定显示区域。
144:     - 垂直同步（`CONFIG_FB_SYNC`）：
145:         - `waitforvsync`：等待垂直同步信号，避免屏幕撕裂。
146:     - 叠加管理（`CONFIG_FB_OVERLAY`）：
147:         - `getoverlayinfo`：获取叠加层的配置信息。
148:         - `settransp`：设置叠加层的透明度。
149:         - `setchromakey`：设置叠加层的色键。
150:         - `setcolor`：用指定颜色填充叠加层。
151:         - `setblank`：启用或禁用叠加层。
152:         - `setarea`：设置叠加操作的活动区域。
153:         - 叠加层的 Blit 和 Blend 操作（`CONFIG_FB_OVERLAY_BLIT`）：
154:             - `blit`：在叠加层之间执行 Blit 操作。
155:             - `blend`：在叠加层之间执行 Blend 操作。
156: 
157: 3. 其他控制功能。
158: 
159:     - 显示平移：
160:         - `pandisplay`：为多缓冲区显示执行平移操作。
161:     - 帧率控制：
162:         - `setframerate`：设置 Framebuffer 的刷新率。
163:         - `getframerate`：获取当前刷新率。
164:     - 电源管理：
165:         - `getpower`：获取面板的电源状态。
166:         - `setpower`：启用或禁用面板电源。
167: 
168: #### 示例代码
169: 
170: 以下是 `struct fb_vtable_s` 的部分定义示例：
171: 
172: ```C
173: struct fb_vtable_s
174: {
175:   /* Get information about the video controller configuration and the
176:    * configuration of each color plane.
177:    */
178: 
179:   int (*getvideoinfo)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
180:                       FAR struct fb_videoinfo_s *vinfo);
181:   int (*getplaneinfo)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable, int planeno,
182:                       FAR struct fb_planeinfo_s *pinfo);
183: 
184: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_CMAP
185:   /* The following are provided only if the video hardware supports RGB
186:    * color mapping
187:    */
188: 
189:   int (*getcmap)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
190:                  FAR struct fb_cmap_s *cmap);
191:   int (*putcmap)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
192:                  FAR const struct fb_cmap_s *cmap);
193: #endif
194: 
195: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_HWCURSOR
196:   /* The following are provided only if the video hardware supports a
197:    * hardware cursor.
198:    */
199: 
200:   int (*getcursor)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
201:                    FAR struct fb_cursorattrib_s *attrib);
202:   int (*setcursor)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
203:                    FAR struct fb_setcursor_s *settings);
204: #endif
205: 
206: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_UPDATE
207:   /* The following are provided only if the video hardware need extera
208:    * notification to update display content.
209:    */
210: 
211:   int (*updatearea)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
212:                     FAR const struct fb_area_s *area);
213: #endif
214: 
215: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_SYNC
216:   /* The following are provided only if the video hardware signals
217:    * vertical sync.
218:    */
219: 
220:   int (*waitforvsync)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable);
221: #endif
222: 
223: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_OVERLAY
224:   /* Get information about the video controller configuration and the
225:    * configuration of each overlay.
226:    */
227: 
228:   int (*getoverlayinfo)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable, int overlayno,
229:                         FAR struct fb_overlayinfo_s *oinfo);
230: 
231:   /* The following are provided only if the video hardware supports
232:    * transparency
233:    */
234: 
235:   int (*settransp)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
236:                    FAR const struct fb_overlayinfo_s *oinfo);
237: 
238:   /* The following are provided only if the video hardware supports
239:    * chromakey
240:    */
241: 
242:   int (*setchromakey)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
243:                       FAR const struct fb_overlayinfo_s *oinfo);
244: 
245:   /* The following are provided only if the video hardware supports
246:    * filling the overlay with a color.
247:    */
248: 
249:   int (*setcolor)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
250:                   FAR const struct fb_overlayinfo_s *oinfo);
251: 
252:   /* The following allows to switch the overlay on or off */
253: 
254:   int (*setblank)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
255:                   FAR const struct fb_overlayinfo_s *oinfo);
256: 
257:   /* The following allows to set the active area for subsequently overlay
258:    * operations.
259:    */
260: 
261:   int (*setarea)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
262:                  FAR const struct fb_overlayinfo_s *oinfo);
263: 
264: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_OVERLAY_BLIT
265:   /* The following are provided only if the video hardware supports
266:    * blit operation between overlays.
267:    */
268: 
269:   int (*blit)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
270:               FAR const struct fb_overlayblit_s *blit);
271: 
272:   /* The following are provided only if the video hardware supports
273:    * blend operation between overlays.
274:    */
275: 
276:   int (*blend)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
277:                FAR const struct fb_overlayblend_s *blend);
278: #endif
279: 
280:   /* Pan display for multiple buffers. */
281: 
282:   int (*pandisplay)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
283:                     FAR struct fb_planeinfo_s *pinfo);
284: 
285:   /* Specific Controls ******************************************************/
286: 
287:   /* Set the frequency of the Framebuffer update panel (0: disable refresh) */
288: 
289:   int (*setframerate)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable, int rate);
290: 
291:   /* Get the frequency of the Framebuffer update panel (0: disable refresh) */
292: 
293:   int (*getframerate)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable);
294: 
295:   /* Get the panel power status (0: full off). */
296: 
297:   int (*getpower)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable);
298: 
299:   /* Enable/disable panel power (0: full off). */
300: 
301:   int (*setpower)(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable, int power);
302: };
303: ```
304: 
305: 开发者可以根据具体硬件需求实现这些接口，以满足 Framebuffer 的功能需求。
306: 
307: ## 四、启用 Framebuffer
308: 
309: 启用 Framebuffer 需要完成以下步骤：
310: 
311: ### 1、开启 Framebuffer 编译选项
312: 
313: 在配置文件中启用以下选项：
314: 
315: ```makefile
316: CONFIG_VIDEO_FB  
317: ```
318: 
319: ### 2、注册 Framebuffer
320: 
321: 在系统启动的初始化阶段，调用 `fb_register` 函数注册 Framebuffer。以下是示例代码：
322: 
323: ```C
324: #include <nuttx/video/fb.h>  
325: 
326: #ifdef CONFIG_VIDEO_FB  
327:     ret = fb_register(0, 0);  
328:     if (ret < 0)  
329:     {  
330:         syslog(LOG_ERR, "ERROR fb_register() failed: %d\n", ret);  
331:     }  
332: #endif
333: ```
334: 
335: ### 3、处理 VSync
336: 
337: 为了避免屏幕撕裂并提高渲染性能，建议在实现中处理 VSync（垂直同步）。VSync 的具体实现和优化方法，请参考 [VSync](./VSync.md)。
338:

# Framebuffer 驱动

\[ [English](../../../en/device_dev_guide/graphics/Framebuffer_Driver.md) | 简体中文 \]

## 一、什么是 Framebuffer

Framebuffer（帧缓存/显存）是一个用于存储一帧 LCD 图像数据的内存区域。在嵌入式系统中，Framebuffer 通常通过内存模拟实现，其大小由 LCD 的分辨率和每个像素的字节大小决定。

### 1、Framebuffer 的大小计算

以 480x320 的屏幕为例，在不同像素模式下，Framebuffer 的大小如下：

1. ARGB888 (32bpp)：

    - 计算公式：`480 x 320 x 4 (bytes)`
    - 大小：614,400 字节

2. RGB565 (16bpp)：

    - 计算公式：`480 x 320 x 2 (bytes)`

494: /* If any dimension of the display exceeds 65,536 pixels, then the following
495:  * type will need to change:
496:  */
497: 
498: typedef uint16_t fb_coord_t;
499: 
500: /* This structure describes the overall video controller */
501: 
502: struct fb_videoinfo_s
503: {
504:   uint8_t    fmt;               /* see FB_FMT_*  */
505:   fb_coord_t xres;              /* Horizontal resolution in pixel columns */
506:   fb_coord_t yres;              /* Vertical resolution in pixel rows */
507:   uint8_t    nplanes;           /* Number of color planes supported */
508: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_OVERLAY
509:   uint8_t    noverlays;         /* Number of overlays supported */
510: #endif
511: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_MODULEINFO
512:   uint8_t    moduleinfo[128];   /* Module information filled by vendor */
513: #endif
514: };
515: 
516: /* This structure describes one color plane.  Some YUV formats may support
517:  * up to 4 planes
518:  */
519: 
520: struct fb_planeinfo_s
521: {
522:   FAR void  *fbmem;        /* Start of frame buffer memory */
523:   size_t     fblen;        /* Length of frame buffer memory in bytes */
524:   fb_coord_t stride;       /* Length of a line in bytes */
525:   uint8_t    display;      /* Display number */
526:   uint8_t    bpp;          /* Bits per pixel */
527:   uint32_t   xres_virtual; /* Virtual Horizontal resolution in pixel columns */
528:   uint32_t   yres_virtual; /* Virtual Vertical resolution in pixel rows */
529:   uint32_t   xoffset;      /* Offset from virtual to visible resolution */
530:   uint32_t   yoffset;      /* Offset from virtual to visible resolution */
531: };
532: 
533: /* This structure describes an area. */
534: 
535: struct fb_area_s
536: {
537:   fb_coord_t x;           /* x-offset of the area */
538:   fb_coord_t y;           /* y-offset of the area */
539:   fb_coord_t w;           /* Width of the area */
540:   fb_coord_t h;           /* Height of the area */
541: };
542: 
543: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_OVERLAY
544: /* This structure describes the transparency. */
545: 
546: struct fb_transp_s
547: {
548:   uint8_t    transp;      /* Transparency */
549:   uint8_t    transp_mode; /* Transparency mode */
550: };
551: 
552: /* This structure describes one overlay. */
553: 
554: struct fb_overlayinfo_s
555: {
556:   FAR void   *fbmem;          /* Start of frame buffer memory */
557:   size_t     fblen;           /* Length of frame buffer memory in bytes */
558:   fb_coord_t stride;          /* Length of a line in bytes */
559:   uint8_t    overlay;         /* Overlay number */
560:   uint8_t    bpp;             /* Bits per pixel */
561:   uint32_t   xres;            /* Horizontal resolution in pixel columns */
562:   uint32_t   yres;            /* Vertical resolution in pixel rows */
563:   uint32_t   xres_virtual;    /* Virtual Horizontal resolution in pixel columns */
564:   uint32_t   yres_virtual;    /* Virtual Vertical resolution in pixel rows */
565:   uint32_t   xoffset;         /* Offset from virtual to visible resolution */
566:   uint32_t   yoffset;         /* Offset from virtual to visible resolution */
567:   uint8_t    blank;           /* Blank or unblank */
568:   uint32_t   chromakey;       /* Chroma key argb8888 formatted */

888:  * stream and is written to video memory as that unmodified.

891:  * components. Offset specifies the position of the least significant bit

955: /****************************************************************************
956:  * If an architecture supports a framebuffer, then it must provide the

960: /****************************************************************************
961:  * Name: up_fbinitialize
962:  *
963:  * Description:
964:  *   Initialize the framebuffer video hardware associated with the display.
965:  *
966:  *   There are multiple logic paths that may call up_fbinitialize() so any
967:  *   implementation of up_fbinitialize() should be tolerant of being called
968:  *   multiple times.
969:  *
970:  * Input Parameters:
971:  *   display - In the case of hardware with multiple displays, this
972:  *             specifies the display.  Normally this is zero.
973:  *
974:  * Returned Value:
975:  *   Zero is returned on success; a negated errno value is returned on any
976:  *   failure.

978:  ****************************************************************************/

987:  *   plane of the specified plane.  Many OSDs support multiple planes of
988:  *   video.
989:  *
990:  * Input Parameters:
991:  *   display - In the case of hardware with multiple displays, this
992:  *             specifies the display.  Normally this is zero.
993:  *   vplane  - Identifies the plane being queried.
994:  *
995:  * Returned Value:
996:  *   A non-NULL pointer to the frame buffer access structure is returned on
997:  *   success; NULL is returned on any failure.
998:  *
999:  ****************************************************************************/

1008:  *

1010:  *   display - In the case of hardware with multiple displays, this
1011:  *             specifies the display.  Normally this is zero.
1012:  *
1013:  * Returned Value:

1016:  ****************************************************************************/

1084:  * Name: fb_register_device

1088:  *   display number if the devices supports only a single plane.  If the
1089:  *   hardware supports multiple color planes, then the device will be
1090:  *   registered at /dev/fbN.M where N is the again display number but M
1091:  *   is the display plane.

1093:  * Input Parameters:
1094:  *   display - The display number for the case of boards supporting multiple
1095:  *             displays or for hardware that supports multiple
1096:  *             layers (each layer is consider a display).  Typically zero.
1097:  *   plane   - Identifies the color plane on hardware that supports separate
1098:  *             framebuffer "planes" for each color component.
1099:  *   vtable  - Pointer to framebuffer's virtual table.
1100:  *
1101:  * Returned Value:
1102:  *   Zero (OK) is returned success; a negated errno value is returned on any
1103:  *   failure.

1105:  ****************************************************************************/

1111:  * Name: fb_register
1112:  *
1113:  * Description:
1114:  *   Register the framebuffer character device at /dev/fbN where N is the
1115:  *   display number if the devices supports only a single plane.  If the
1116:  *   hardware supports multiple color planes, then the device will be
1117:  *   registered at /dev/fbN.M where N is the again display number but M
1118:  *   is the display plane.
1119:  *
1120:  * Input Parameters:
1121:  *   display - The display number for the case of boards supporting multiple
1122:  *             displays or for hardware that supports multiple
1123:  *             layers (each layer is consider a display).  Typically zero.
1124:  *   plane   - Identifies the color plane on hardware that supports separate
1125:  *             framebuffer "planes" for each color component.
1126:  *
1127:  * Returned Value:
1128:  *   Zero (OK) is returned success; a negated errno value is returned on any
1129:  *   failure.
1130:  *
1131:  ****************************************************************************/
1132: 
1133: static inline_function unused_code int fb_register(int display, int plane)
1134: {
1135:   FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable;
1136:   int ret;
1137: 
1138:   /* Initialize the frame buffer device. */
1139: 
1140:   ret = up_fbinitialize(display);
1141:   if (ret < 0)
1142:     {
1143:       gerr("ERROR: up_fbinitialize() failed for display %d: %d\n",
1144:            display, ret);
1145:       return ret;
1146:     }
1147: 
1148:   vtable = up_fbgetvplane(display, plane);
1149:   if (vtable == NULL)
1150:     {
1151:       gerr("ERROR: up_fbgetvplane() failed, vplane=%d\n", plane);
1152:       return -EINVAL;
1153:     }
1154: 
1155:   return fb_register_device(display, plane, vtable);
1156: }

1160: }
1161: #endif

putreg32((PANEL_HBP << 24) | (PANEL_HFP << 12) | PANEL_HSYNC,
         D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_H_PORCH);
```

But from the manual, TIMING_H_PORCH at 0x1E4 has:
- H_B_PORCH: bits [28:16] (not [31:24]!)
- H_F_PORCH: bits [12:0]

The driver puts HBP at bits [31:24] but the manual says H_B_PORCH is at bits [28:16]. This is WRONG!

Also, the driver packs HSYNC into the H_PORCH register, but according to the manual, H_SYNC_WIDTH is in the TIMING_SYNC_PLUSE register at bits [12:0], not in TIMING_H_PORCH.

Similarly for V_PORCH:
```c
putreg32((PANEL_VBP << 24) | (PANEL_VFP << 12) | PANEL_VSYNC,
         D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_V_PORCH);
```

Manual says V_B_PORCH is at bits [28:16] and V_F_PORCH at bits [12:0]. The driver uses [31:24] for VBP, which is wrong.

And for SYNC_PLUSE:
```c
putreg32((PANEL_HSYNC << 16) | PANEL_VSYNC,
         D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_SYNC_PLUSE);
```

Manual says V_SYNC_WIDTH is at bits [26:16] and H_SYNC_WIDTH at bits [12:0]. The driver puts HSYNC at [31:16] which is wrong (should be [12:0]), and VSYNC at [15:0] which is also wrong (should be [26:16]).

Wait, actually let me re-read:
- V_SYNC_WIDTH: bits [26:16]
- H_SYNC_WIDTH: bits [12:0]

Driver code:
```c
putreg32((PANEL_HSYNC << 16) | PANEL_VSYNC,
         D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_SYNC_PLUSE);
```

PANEL_HSYNC = 20, PANEL_VSYNC = 3.

This writes: (20 << 16) | 3 = 0x00140003

But it should be:
- H_SYNC_WIDTH [12:0] = 20 → bits [12:0]
- V_SYNC_WIDTH [26:16] = 3 → bits [26:16]

So the correct value should be: (3 << 16) | 20 = 0x00030014

The driver has the H and V fields SWAPPED! And the shifts are wrong!

Now let me check the ACTIVE_SIZE register:

Driver:
```c
putreg32((PANEL_HACTIVE << 16) | PANEL_VACTIVE,
         D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE);
```

Manual says ACTIVE_H is at bits [28:16] and ACTIVE_W at bits [12:0].

Driver puts HACTIVE at [31:16] and VACTIVE at [15:0]. But:
- ACTIVE_W (width) should be at [12:0], and HACTIVE is the width → should be at [12:0]
- ACTIVE_H (height) should be at [28:16], and VACTIVE is the height → should be at [28:16]

So the driver has the shifts swapped AND uses wrong bit positions! The correct code should be:
```c
putreg32((PANEL_VACTIVE << 16) | PANEL_HACTIVE,
         D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE);
```

Actually wait, ACTIVE_H is at [28:16] and ACTIVE_W is at [12:0]. So:
- HACTIVE (1024) should go to [12:0]
- VACTIVE (600) should go to [28:16]

Driver puts HACTIVE << 16 (which goes to bits [28:16] range if HACTIVE fits in 12 bits) and VACTIVE to [15:0].

For PANEL_HACTIVE = 1024 = 0x400:
- Driver: 0x400 << 16 = 0x04000000 → bits [26:16] get the value 0x400, which maps to ACTIVE_H field
- But 1024 is the width, not the height!

For PANEL_VACTIVE = 600 = 0x258:
- Driver: 0x258 → bits [11:0] get 0x258, which maps to ACTIVE_W field
- But 600 is the height, not the width!

So the driver is putting width where height should be and vice versa. This is a CRITICAL BUG.

Now let me also check the EN bit for TIMING_CTRL_EN:

Driver:
```c
#define DE_TIMING_EN           (1 << 0)
...
putreg32(DE_TIMING_EN, D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_CTRL_EN);
```

From the manual, TIMING_CTRL at 0x1D0. But the driver defines DE_TIMING_CTRL_EN as 0x10, which maps to address 0x18A00010 (DE_VER_ID). This is completely wrong!

Also, the driver defines its own polarity bits:
```c

#define DE_TIMING_V_POL        (1 << 2)
```

But the manual says TIMING_POL_SET at 0x1F0:
- V_SYNC_POL: bit 1
- H_SYNC_POL: bit 0

So the polarity bits are at bit 0 and bit 1, not bit 1 and bit 2! And they should be written to 0x1F0, not 0x10.

The formula is: Freq = 24MHz × (N+1 + F/16384)

N = 14, so N+1 = 15
F = 0x2000 = 8192

Freq = 24MHz × (15 + 8192/16384) = 24MHz × (15 + 0.5) = 24MHz × 15.5 = 372MHz

But the comment says 24MHz × 15.25 ≈ 364MHz. If F = 0x2000 = 8192, then 8192/16384 = 0.5, not 0.25.

For 0.25, F should be 4096 = 0x1000.

So either the F value is wrong or the comment is wrong. If the target is 364MHz:
364/24 = 15.1667
15.1667 - 15 = 0.1667
0.1667 × 16384 = 2730 = 0xAA2

If the target is 372MHz:
372/24 = 15.5
F = 0.5 × 16384 = 8192 = 0x2000 ✓

So the F value produces 372MHz, not 364MHz as the comment states. The comment is wrong, or the F value should be different.

2. PLL_FRA2_EN should be bit 16, not bit 17

From the D13x manual, the DE timing registers are at:
- 0x1D0: TIMING_CTRL
- 0x1E0: TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE (called TIMING_LINE_SET in TOC)
- 0x1E4: TIMING_H_PORCH
- 0x1E8: TIMING_V_PORCH
- 0x1EC: TIMING_SYNC_PLUSE
- 0x1F0: TIMING_POL_SET

#define DE_TIMING_SYNC_PLUSE   0x1EC
#define DE_TIMING_POL_SET      0x1F0

- 0x00: DE_CTRL
- 0x04: DE_MODE_SELECT
- 0x08: DE_CONFIG_UPDATE
- 0x0C: OUTPUT_COLOR_DEPTH
- 0x10: DE_VER_ID

This is the most critical bug in the entire driver.

- V_F_PORCH: bits [12:0]

# D13x LVDS/Framebuffer 驱动第三轮逐行审核报告

## 检查点 1: PLL_FRA2 寄存器位域

**36: `PLL_FRA2_EN (1 << 17)`**
```c
#define PLL_FRA2_EN            (1 << 17)
```
参考 `aic_clk_id.h:210-211`: `PLL_LOCK_BIT = 17`, `PLL_EN_BIT = 16`。驱动将 bit 17 命名为 `EN`，但实际它是 **LOCK** 位（只读）。bit 16 才是真正的 EN。
**❌ BUG — 宏名与实际位域错位。bit 17 是 LOCK（只读），bit 16 才是 EN。**

**37: `PLL_FRA2_OUT_SYS (1 << 16)`**
```c
#define PLL_FRA2_OUT_SYS       (1 << 16)
```
参考 `aic_clk_id.h:234`: `PLL_OUT_SYS = 18`。驱动定义为 bit 16，手册规定为 **bit 18**。
**❌ BUG — 位偏移错误。应为 `(1 << 18)`。**

**179: PLL 使能代码**
```c
reg |= PLL_FRA2_EN | PLL_FRA2_OUT_SYS;
```
展开为 `reg |= (1 << 17) | (1 << 16)` = 设置 LOCK（只读，无效）+ EN（bit 16，恰好正确）。**意外正确**使能了 PLL，但 OUT_SYS（bit 18）从未被设置。
**⚠️ OUT_SYS 位未正确设置，可能影响 PLL 输出路径选择。**

**193: PLL 锁定检测**
```c
while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_FRA2_GEN) & PLL_FRA2_EN))
```
检查 bit 17（LOCK 位）。行为正确（检测锁定），但宏名 `PLL_FRA2_EN` 具有误导性。
**⚠️ 功能正确，但宏命名有误。**

**38: `PLL_FRA2_FACTORM_EN (1 << 19)` — 已定义但从未使用。**
**⚠️ 如果需要使能 Factor M，此位未被设置。**

---

## 检查点 2: PLL 频率计算

**128-132:**
```c
#define PLL_FRA2_N_VALUE       14
#define PLL_FRA2_F_VALUE       0x2000
```
公式：`Freq = 24MHz × (N+1 + F/16384)`
- N=14 → N+1 = 15
- F=0x2000 = 8192 → 8192/16384 = **0.5**
- 实际频率 = 24MHz × 15.5 = **372MHz**

注释写 `24MHz × 15.25 ≈ 364MHz`，但 0x2000/16384 = 0.5 ≠ 0.25。若要 0.25，F 应为 0x1000 (4096)。
**❌ BUG — 注释与实际值不符。F=0x2000 产生 372MHz，非 364MHz。需确认目标频率。**

---

## 检查点 3: DE DPI 时序寄存器偏移

**100-104:**
```c
#define DE_TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE  0x00
#define DE_TIMING_H_PORCH      0x04
#define DE_TIMING_V_PORCH      0x08
#define DE_TIMING_SYNC_PLUSE   0x0C
#define DE_TIMING_CTRL_EN      0x10
```

D13x 手册（DE register.html）中这些寄存器的实际偏移：
| 寄存器 | 手册偏移 | 驱动偏移 | 驱动实际映射到 |
|---|---|---|---|
| TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE | **0x1E0** | 0x00 | DE_CTRL |
| TIMING_H_PORCH | **0x1E4** | 0x04 | DE_MODE_SELECT |
| TIMING_V_PORCH | **0x1E8** | 0x08 | DE_CONFIG_UPDATE |
| TIMING_SYNC_PLUSE | **0x1EC** | 0x0C | OUTPUT_COLOR_DEPTH |
| TIMING_CTRL | **0x1D0** | 0x10 | DE_VER_ID |

**❌❌❌ 严重 BUG — 所有时序寄存器偏移全部错误！驱动将时序参数写入了 DE_CTRL、DE_MODE_SELECT 等完全无关的寄存器。**

正确偏移应为：
```c
#define DE_TIMING_CTRL         0x1D0
#define DE_TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE  0x1E0
#define DE_TIMING_H_PORCH      0x1E4
#define DE_TIMING_V_PORCH      0x1E8
#define DE_TIMING_SYNC_PLUSE   0x1EC

## 最高优先级修复项

**致命级 (3项)**:

1. **DE 时序寄存器偏移全部错误** (`artinchip_lvds.c:100-104`)。`DE_TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE=0x00` 等值将时序数据写入 DE_CTRL/DE_MODE_SELECT 等无关寄存器。必须改为 `0x1E0/0x1E4/0x1E8/0x1EC/0x1D0`。

2. **ACTIVE_SIZE 宽高互换** (`artinchip_lvds.c:246`)。`HACTIVE<<16` 写入 ACTIVE_H 字段（应放 VACTIVE）。交换为 `(PANEL_VACTIVE << 16) | PANEL_HACTIVE`。

**高优先级 (4项)**:

4. PLL_FRA2_OUT_SYS 位域: `(1<<16)` 应为 `(1<<18)` (`artinchip_lvds.c:37`)。

5. SYNC_PLUSE 中 HSYNC/VSYNC 互换 (`artinchip_lvds.c:241`): 改为 `(PANEL_VSYNC << 16) | PANEL_HSYNC`。

6. H_PORCH/V_PORCH 中 HBP/VBP shift 应为 16 而非 24 (`artinchip_lvds.c:231,236`)。

7. PLL 频率注释与实际值不符 (`artinchip_lvds.c:128`): F=0x2000 产生 372MHz 而非注释的 364MHz。

149:       gpio_set_value(GT911_INT_PIN, 0);
150:       up_mdelay(2);
151: 
152:       /* RST output HIGH */
153: 
154:       gpio_set_value(GT911_RST_PIN, 1);
155:       up_mdelay(5);
156: 
157:       /* RST set to input (floating) */
158: 
159:       gpio_set_direction(GT911_RST_PIN, 0);
160: 
161:       /* INT stays LOW, wait for GT911 to latch address */
162: 
163:       up_mdelay(50);
164: 
165:       /* INT set to input (floating) */
166: 
167:       gpio_set_direction(GT911_INT_PIN, 0);
168:     }
169:   else
170:     {
171:       gpio_set_direction(GT911_RST_PIN, 1);
172:       gpio_set_value(GT911_RST_PIN, 0);
173:     }
174: 
175:   return OK;
176: }
177: 
178: static const struct gt9xx_board_s g_gt911_board =
179: {
180:   .irq_attach = gt911_irq_attach,
181:   .irq_enable = gt911_irq_enable,
182:   .set_power  = gt911_set_power,
183: };
184: 
185: /****************************************************************************
186:  * Public Functions
187:  ****************************************************************************/
188: 
189: int d13x_gt911_initialize(void)
190: {
191:   FAR struct i2c_master_s *bus;
192: 
193:   bus = d13x_i2c_initialize(0);
194:   if (bus == NULL)
195:     {
196:       return -ENODEV;
197:     }
198: 
199:   gt911_set_power(&g_gt911_board, true);
200: 
201:   int ret = gt9xx_register("/dev/input0", bus,
202:                             GT911_I2C_ADDR, &g_gt911_board);
203:   if (ret < 0)
204:     {
205:       ierr("GT911 register failed: %d\n", ret);
206:       return ret;
207:     }
208:

1: # Input 驱动开发指南
2: 
3: \[ [English](../../../en/device_dev_guide/graphics/Input_Driver_Guide.md) | 简体中文 \]
4: 
5: ## 一、概述
6: 
7: 本文档旨在为嵌入式开发者提供在 openvela 平台上开发输入 (Input) 设备驱动的详细指南。
8: 
9: openvela 的 Input 驱动框架遵循 NuttX 的标准分层模型，为触摸屏 (Touchscreen)、键盘 (Keyboard)、鼠标 (Mouse) 等各类输入设备提供了统一的软件架构。该框架的核心目标是将硬件相关的底层实现与上层应用逻辑解耦，从而提高驱动的可移植性和复用性。
10: 
11: ## 二、架构解析
12: 
13: 输入设备驱动（Input Driver）是连接物理输入设备与应用程序的关键组件。
14: 
15: Input 驱动框架采用经典的**上半层 (Upper Half)** 与**下半层 (Lower Half)** 分层设计。绝大部分触控芯片都是使用 I2C 接口接入主控芯片的，这部分被放进 Lower Half 层中。
16: 
17: ![img](./figures/013.png)
18: 
19: ### 上半层 (Upper Half)
20: 
21: 上半层是面向操作系统内核和应用程序的通用接口层，它负责处理与具体硬件无关的逻辑。其主要职责包括：
22: 
23: - **提供标准设备接口**：通过在 `drivers/input/` 目录下创建字符设备 (例如 `/dev/input0`)，为应用程序提供标准的 `open`, `read`, `ioctl` 等文件操作接口：
24: 
25:     ```C
26:     // 文件路径：drivers/input/touchscreen_upper.c
27:     
28:     static const struct file_operations g_touch_fops =
29:     {
30:       touch_open,     /* open */
31:       touch_close,    /* close */
32:       touch_read,     /* read */
33:       touch_write,    /* write */
34:       NULL,           /* seek */
35:       touch_ioctl,    /* ioctl */
36:       NULL,           /* mmap */
37:       NULL,           /* truncate */
38:       touch_poll      /* poll */
39:     };
40:     ```
41: 
42: - **管理下半层驱动**：提供注册 (`touch_register`) 和注销 (`touch_unregister`) 接口，用于挂载或卸载特定硬件的下半层驱动：
43: 
44:     ```C
45:     int touch_register(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
46:                        FAR const char *path, uint8_t nums)
47:     void touch_unregister(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
48:                           FAR const char *path)
49:     ```
50: 
51: - **缓冲事件数据**：提供事件上报接口 (`touch_event`)，接收来自下半层的输入数据，并将其存入环形缓冲区 (Circular Buffer)，供上层应用读取：
52: 
53:     ```C
54:     // 将touch 事件写入到一个 circle buffer 中
55:     void touch_event(FAR void *priv, FAR const struct touch_sample_s *sample)
56:     ```
57: 
58: ### 下半层 (Lower Half)
59: 
60: 下半层是驱动的核心实现部分，直接与输入设备硬件交互。**驱动开发者**主要的工作都集中在这一层。其职责包括：
61: 
62: - **硬件初始化**：配置芯片寄存器，设置中断模式、通信接口 (如 I2C/SPI) 等。
63: - **中断处理**：响应硬件中断，并从设备读取原始输入数据。
64: - **事件上报**：将解析后的标准化输入事件通过上半层提供的接口上报。
65: 
66: ## 三、核心 API 与数据结构
67: 
68: 为了实现上下半层的通信，框架定义了一系列标准化的数据结构和接口函数。
69: 
70: ### 1、关键数据结构
71: 
72: 这些结构体用于描述触摸事件的标准化格式。
73: 
74: - **`struct touch_point_s`**: 描述一个独立的触摸点信息。
75: 
76:     ```C
77:     #define TOUCH_DOWN           (1 << 0) /* A new touch contact is established */
78:     #define TOUCH_MOVE           (1 << 1) /* Movement occurred with previously reported contact */
79:     #define TOUCH_UP             (1 << 2) /* The touch contact was lost */
80:     #define TOUCH_ID_VALID       (1 << 3) /* Touch ID is certain */
81:     #define TOUCH_POS_VALID      (1 << 4) /* Hardware provided a valid X/Y position */
82:     #define TOUCH_PRESSURE_VALID (1 << 5) /* Hardware provided a valid pressure */
83:     #define TOUCH_SIZE_VALID     (1 << 6) /* Hardware provided a valid H/W contact size */
84:     #define TOUCH_GESTURE_VALID  (1 << 7) /* Hardware provided a valid gesture */
85:     
86:     struct touch_point_s
87:     {
88:       uint8_t  id;        /* Unique identifies contact; Same in all reports for the contact */
89:       uint8_t  flags;     /* See TOUCH_* definitions above */
90:       int16_t  x;         /* X coordinate of the touch point (uncalibrated) */
91:       int16_t  y;         /* Y coordinate of the touch point (uncalibrated) */
92:       int16_t  h;         /* Height of touch point (uncalibrated) */
93:       int16_t  w;         /* Width of touch point (uncalibrated) */
94:       uint16_t gesture;   /* Gesture of touchscreen contact */
95:       uint16_t pressure;  /* Touch pressure */
96:       uint64_t timestamp; /* Touch event time stamp, in microseconds */
97:     };
98:     ```
99: 
100: - **`struct touch_sample_s`**: 一次上报的完整触摸样本，可包含一个或多个触摸点。
101: 
102:     ```C
103:     struct touch_sample_s
104:     {
105:       int npoints;                   /* The number of touch points in point[] */
106:       struct touch_point_s point[1]; /* Actual dimension is npoints */
107:     };
108:     
109:     #define SIZEOF_TOUCH_SAMPLE_S(n) \
110:       (sizeof(struct touch_sample_s) + ((n) - 1) * sizeof(struct touch_point_s))
111:      
112:     ```
113: 
114: - **`struct touch_lowerhalf_s`**: 下半层驱动的实例，封装了硬件相关的操作和属性。
115: 
116:     ```C
117:     struct touch_lowerhalf_s
118:     {
119:       uint8_t       maxpoint;       /* Maximal point supported by the touchscreen */
120:       FAR void      *priv;          /* Save the upper half pointer */
121:     
122:       /**************************************************************************
123:        * Name: control
124:        *
125:        * Description:
126:        *   Users can use this interface to implement custom IOCTL.
127:        *
128:        * Arguments:
129:        *   lower   - The instance of lower half of touchscreen device.
130:        *   cmd     - User defined specific command.
131:        *   arg     - Argument of the specific command.
132:        *
133:        * Return Value:
134:        *   Zero(OK) on success; a negated errno value on failure.
135:        *   -ENOTTY - The command is not supported.
136:        **************************************************************************/
137:     
138:       CODE int (*control)(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
139:                           int cmd, unsigned long arg);
140:     
141:       /**************************************************************************
142:        * Name: write
143:        *
144:        * Description:
145:        *   Users can use this interface to implement custom write.
146:        *
147:        * Arguments:
148:        *   lower   - The instance of lower half of touchscreen device.
149:        *   buffer  - User defined specific buffer.
150:        *   buflen  - User defined specific buffer size.
151:        *
152:        * Return Value:
153:        *   Number of bytes written；a negated errno value on failure.
154:        *
155:        **************************************************************************/
156:     
157:       CODE ssize_t (*write)(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
158:                             FAR const char *buffer, size_t buflen);
159:     };
160:     ```
161: 
162: ### 2、核心函数接口
163: 
164: - **设备注册/注销**
165: 
166:     ```C
167:     // 注册触摸屏下半层驱动
168:     int touch_register(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
169:                        FAR const char *path, uint8_t nums)
170:     
171:     // 注销触摸屏下半层驱动
172:     void touch_unregister(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
173:                           FAR const char *path);
174:     ```
175: 
176: - **事件上报**
177: 
178:     ```C
179:     // 从下半层向上半层上报一个触摸事件样本
180:     void touch_event(FAR void *priv, FAR const struct touch_sample_s *sample);
181:     ```
182: 
183: ## 四、驱动开发工作流
184: 
185: 开发一个 Input 驱动通常遵循以下标准流程。
186: 
187: ### 步骤 1：初始化与注册
188: 
189: 驱动的初始化函数中，下半层驱动需要完成硬件初始化，并调用相应的注册函数将自身注册到 Input 框架中。例如，触摸屏驱动应调用 `touch_register`。
190: 
191: ### 步骤 2：中断处理与事件采集
192: 
193: 当硬件产生输入事件（如触摸、按键）并触发中断时，驱动的中断服务程序 (ISR) 会被调用。
194: 
195: > **注意：** 中断服务程序 (ISR) 必须在禁止抢占或禁用中断的上下文中快速执行。由于上半层的 `xxx_event` 函数内部包含> 锁操作，可能会导致休眠，**因此严禁在 ISR 中直接调用** **`xxx_event`** **函数**。
196: 
197: 正确的做法是使**用工作队列 (Work Queue) 机制：**
198: 
199: ```C++
200: int work_queue(int qid, FAR struct work_s *work, worker_t worker,
201:                FAR void *arg, clock_t delay)
202: 
203: Arguments:
204:   qid    - work queue ID：use HPWORK
205:   work   - the work structure to queue
206:   worker - the work callback 
207:   arg    - callback argument
208:   delay  - delay (in clock ticks) from the time queue until the worker is invoked. 
209:            Zero means to perform the work immediately.
210: ```
211: 
212: - `qid`: 工作队列 ID。对于高优先级中断，应使用 `HPWORK`；对于普通任务，可使用 `LPWORK`。
213: - `worker`: 工作队列任务的回调函数。事件的完整解析和上报应在此函数中完成。
214: - `delay`: 延迟执行的时间（单位：tick）。设置为 `0` 表示立即调度。
215: 
216: ### 步骤 3：事件上报
217: 
218: 在工作队列的回调函数（`worker`）中，驱动可以安全地执行以下操作：
219: 
220: 1. 通过 I2C/SPI 等总线从硬件读取完整的事件数据。
221: 2. 将原始数据解析并填充到标准的数据结构中（如 `struct touch_sample_s`）。
222: 3. 根据设备类型，调用相应的事件上报函数（如 `touch_event`），将事件数据发送到上半层。
223: 
224: ## 五、开发者适配指南
225: 
226: 本节将以触摸屏驱动为例，说明下半层驱动需要实现的具体接口。
227: 
228: ### 1、实现下半层接口
229: 
230: 您需要定义一个 `struct touch_lowerhalf_s` 类型的静态实例，并根据硬件能力填充其成员：
231: 
232: - `maxpoint`: 必须准确设置为硬件支持的最大并发触摸点数。此值直接影响上半层为环形缓冲区分配的内存大小。
233: - `control`, `write`: 如果需要支持自定义的 `ioctl` 或 `write` 操作，请实现这两个函数指针；否则，将其设置为 `NULL`。
234: 
235: ### 2、注册 Input 设备
236: 
237: 在驱动初始化时，调用 `touch_register` 函数。
238: 
239: ```C++
240: int touch_register(FAR struct touch_lowerhalf_s *lower,
241:                    FAR const char *path, uint8_t nums)
242: 
243: Arguments:
244:   lower     - A pointer of lower half instance.
245:   path      - The path of touchscreen device. such as "/dev/input0"
246:   nums      - Number of the touch points structure, used to calculate circbuf size
247: ```
248: 
249: - `lower`: 指向您实现的 `touch_lowerhalf_s` 实例的指针。
250: - `path`: 设备节点路径，例如 `/dev/input0`。
251: - `nums`: 用于计算环形缓冲区大小的样本数量。它与 `lower->maxpoint` 共同决定了缓冲区总容量。计算公式如下： 
252: 
253:     `circbuf_size = nums * SIZEOF_TOUCH_SAMPLE_S(lower->maxpoint)`
254: 
255: ### 3、传输 Input 事件
256: 
257: 在工作队列的回调函数中，调用 `touch_event` 函数上报数据。
258: 
259: ```C++
260: void touch_event(FAR void *priv, FAR const struct touch_sample_s *sample);
261: 
262: Arguments:
263:   priv    - Upper half driver handle.
264:   sample  - pointer to data of touch point event.
265: ```
266: 
267: - `priv`: 上半层驱动的句柄。该值在 `touch_register` 成功后，由上半层回填到 `lower->priv` 成员中。
268: - `sample`: 指向已填充好数据的 `touch_sample_s` 结构体指针。请确保 `sample->npoints` 的值准确反映了 `sample->point` 数组中的有效数据点数量。
269: 
270: ## 六、构建与验证
271: 
272: ### 1、构建配置
273: 
274: 在 `menuconfig` 中启用相应类型的 Input 驱动框架支持。
275: 
276: ```Makefile
277: # 使能 touch 驱动
278: CONFIG_INPUT_TOUCHSCREEN=y
279: 
280: # 使能 keyboard 驱动
281: CONFIG_INPUT_KEYBOARD=y
282: 
283: # 使能 mouse 驱动
284: CONFIG_INPUT_MOUSE=y
285: ```
286: 
287: 同时，您还需要在 `menuconfig` 中选中您自己开发的下半层驱动。
288: 
289: ### 2、功能验证
290: 
291: 要验证驱动的正确性，您可以参考 [getevent 工具使用指南](./Getevent.md)等标准测试工具读取设备节点，并观察输出的事件信息是否与硬件的实际操作一致。
292: 
293: 将 `getevent` 工具输出的事件序列与硬件行为进行对比，可以有效调试坐标、按键值、事件标志等是否正确。
294: 
295: ## 七、代码示例
296: 
297: 您可以参考 `goldfish_events.c` 驱动，它为 Goldfish 模拟器实现了一套完整的 Input 事件处理，是一个很好的学习范例。
298: 
299: - **代码路径**: `nuttx/drivers/input/goldfish_events.c`

223: static rt_size_t gt911_read_point(struct rt_touch_device *touch, void *buf,
224:                                   rt_size_t read_num)
225: {
226:     rt_uint8_t point_status = 0;
227:     rt_uint8_t touch_num = 0;
228:     rt_uint8_t write_buf[3];
229:     rt_uint8_t cmd[2];
230:     rt_uint8_t read_buf[8 * GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { 0 };
231:     rt_uint8_t read_index;
232:     int8_t read_id = 0;
233:     int16_t input_x = 0;
234:     int16_t input_y = 0;
235:     int16_t input_w = 0;
236: 
237:     static rt_uint8_t pre_touch = 0;
238:     static int8_t pre_id[GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { 0 };
239: 
240:     rt_memset(buf, 0, sizeof(struct rt_touch_data) * read_num);
241: 
242:     /* point status register */
243:     cmd[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_READ_STATUS >> 8) & 0xFF);
244:     cmd[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_READ_STATUS & 0xFF);
245: 
246:     if (gt911_read_regs(&gt911_client, cmd, &point_status, 1) != RT_EOK) {
247:         LOG_D("read point failed\n");
248:         read_num = 0;
249:         goto exit_;
250:     }
251: 
252:     if (point_status == 0) /* no data */
253:     {
254:         read_num = 0;
255:         goto exit_;
256:     }
257: 
258:     if ((point_status & 0x80) == 0) /* data is not ready */
259:     {
260:         read_num = 0;
261:         goto exit_;
262:     }
263: 
264:     touch_num = point_status & 0x0f; /* get point num */
265: 
266:     if (touch_num > GT911_MAX_TOUCH) /* point num is not correct */
267:     {
268:         read_num = 0;
269:         goto exit_;
270:     }
271: 
272:     cmd[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_POINT1_REG >> 8) & 0xFF);
273:     cmd[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_POINT1_REG & 0xFF);
274: 
275:     /* read point num is touch_num */
276:     if (gt911_read_regs(&gt911_client, cmd, read_buf,
277:                         read_num * GT911_POINT_INFO_NUM) != RT_EOK) {
278:         LOG_D("read point failed\n");
279:         read_num = 0;
280:         goto exit_;
281:     }
282: 
283:     if (pre_touch > touch_num) /* point up */
284:     {
285:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < pre_touch; read_index++) {
286:             rt_uint8_t j;
287: 
288:             for (j = 0; j < touch_num; j++) /* this time touch num */
289:             {
290:                 read_id = read_buf[j * 8] & 0x0F;
291: 
292:                 if (pre_id[read_index] == read_id) /* this id is not free */
293:                     break;
294: 
295:                 if (j >= touch_num - 1) {
296:                     rt_uint8_t up_id;
297:                     up_id = pre_id[read_index];
298:                     gt911_touch_up(buf, up_id);
299:                 }
300:             }
301:         }
302:     }
303: 
304:     if (touch_num) /* point down */
305:     {
306:         rt_uint8_t off_set;
307: 
308:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < touch_num; read_index++) {
309:             off_set = read_index * 8;
310:             read_id = read_buf[off_set] & 0x0f;
311:             pre_id[read_index] = read_id;
312:             input_x =
313:                 read_buf[off_set + 1] | (read_buf[off_set + 2] << 8); /* x */
314:             input_y =
315:                 read_buf[off_set + 3] | (read_buf[off_set + 4] << 8); /* y */
316:             input_w =
317:                 read_buf[off_set + 5] | (read_buf[off_set + 6] << 8); /* size */
318: 
319:             gt911_touch_down(buf, read_id, input_x, input_y, input_w);
320:         }
321:     } else if (pre_touch) {
322:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < pre_touch; read_index++) {
323:             gt911_touch_up(buf, pre_id[read_index]);
324:         }
325:     }
326: 
327:     pre_touch = touch_num;
328: 
329: exit_:
330:     write_buf[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_READ_STATUS >> 8) & 0xFF);
331:     write_buf[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_READ_STATUS & 0xFF);
332:     write_buf[2] = 0x00;
333:     gt911_write_reg(&gt911_client, write_buf, 3);
334: 
335:     return read_num;
336: }

338: static rt_err_t gt911_control(struct rt_touch_device *touch, int cmd, void *arg)
339: {
340:     if (cmd == RT_TOUCH_CTRL_GET_ID) {
341:         return gt911_get_product_id(&gt911_client, arg, 6);
342:     }
343: 
344:     if (cmd == RT_TOUCH_CTRL_GET_INFO) {
345:         return gt911_get_info(&gt911_client, arg);
346:     }
347: 
348:     rt_uint8_t buf[4];
349:     rt_uint8_t i = 0;
350:     rt_uint8_t *config;
351: 
352:     config =
353:         (rt_uint8_t *)rt_calloc(1, sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL) + GT911_REGITER_LEN);
354:     if (config == RT_NULL) {
355:         LOG_D("malloc config memory failed\n");
356:         return -RT_ERROR;
357:     }
358: 
359:     config[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_CONFIG_REG >> 8) & 0xFF);
360:     config[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_CONFIG_REG & 0xFF);
361: 
362:     memcpy(&config[2], GT911_CFG_TBL, sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL));
363: 
364:     switch (cmd) {
365:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_X_RANGE: {
366:             rt_uint16_t x_range;
367: 
368:             x_range = *(rt_uint16_t *)arg;
369:             config[4] = (rt_uint8_t)(x_range >> 8);
370:             config[3] = (rt_uint8_t)(x_range & 0xff);
371: 
372:             GT911_CFG_TBL[2] = config[4];
373:             GT911_CFG_TBL[1] = config[3];
374:             break;
375:         }
376:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_Y_RANGE: {
377:             rt_uint16_t y_range;
378: 
379:             y_range = *(rt_uint16_t *)arg;
380:             config[6] = (rt_uint8_t)(y_range >> 8);
381:             config[5] = (rt_uint8_t)(y_range & 0xff);
382: 
383:             GT911_CFG_TBL[4] = config[6];
384:             GT911_CFG_TBL[3] = config[5];
385:             break;
386:         }
387:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_X_TO_Y: {
388:             config[8] ^= (1 << 3);
389:             break;
390:         }
391:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_MODE: {
392:             rt_uint16_t trig_type;
393:             trig_type = *(rt_uint16_t *)arg;
394: 
395:             switch (trig_type) {
396:                 case RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX:
397:                     config[8] &= 0xFC;
398:                     break;
399:                 case RT_DEVICE_FLAG_RDONLY:
400:                     config[8] &= 0xFC;
401:                     config[8] |= 0x02;
402:                     break;
403:                 default:
404:                     break;
405:             }
406:             break;
407:         }
408:         default: {
409:             break;
410:         }
411:     }
412: 
413:     if (gt911_write_reg(&gt911_client, config,
414:                         sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL) + GT911_ADDR_LEN) != RT_EOK) {
415:         LOG_D("send config failed");
416:         return -1;
417:     }
418: 
419:     buf[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_CHECK_SUM >> 8) & 0xFF);
420:     buf[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_CHECK_SUM & 0xFF);
421:     buf[2] = 0;
422: 
423:     for (i = GT911_ADDR_LEN; i < sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL) + GT911_ADDR_LEN; i++) {
424:         buf[GT911_ADDR_LEN] += config[i];
425:     }
426: 
427:     buf[2] = (~buf[2]) + 1;
428:     buf[3] = 1;
429: 
430:     gt911_write_reg(&gt911_client, buf, 4);
431:     rt_free(config);
432: 
433:     return RT_EOK;
434: }

8: === 芯片总览 ===
9: D13x 是匠芯创推出的国产高性能全高清显示和智能控制工业级 MCU，采用国产自主 RISC-V 内核，内置 PSRAM，集成显示引擎（DE）、图像引擎（GE）、视频编解码引擎（VE），配备丰富的屏显接口和通用外设。
10: 
11: 核心特性：
12: - CPU: 平头哥玄铁 E907，RV32IMAFDCP，480MHz@1.1V
13: - SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB（按型号）
14: - PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封）
15: - Flash: NOR 2/4/8/16MB（合封）或外部 NAND
16: - 显示: RGB888 / LVDS / MIPI DSI 4-lane / SPI / I8080，最大 1366×768@60fps
17: - 图形: 2D 加速引擎，旋转/缩放/透明叠加
18: - 视频: JPEG 编解码、PNG/.9.PNG 硬解、MJPEG 硬解 1366×768@60fps
19: - 摄像头: DVP YUV422/BT.656，720P@60fps 输入，5M 拍照
20: - 以太网: 1×10/100M EMAC
21: - USB: 1×USB 2.0 HS-USB
22: - 串口: 8×UART
23: - SPI: 4×SPI
24: - I2C: 3×I2C
25: - CAN: 2×CAN 2.0B
26: - PWM: 8 路 PWM + 24 路 EPWM + 6 路 CAP
27: - ADC: 2×12bit GPADC（12 通道）
28: - 封装: QFN68 / QFN88 / QFN100
29: 
30: === 本次大赛使用型号 ===
31: D133EBS（衡山派开发板），QFN100 封装，1MB SRAM + 8MB PSRAM
32: 
33: === CPU 内核参数 ===
34: 架构: RISC-V
35: 指令集: RV32IMA[F][D]C[P]
36: 位宽: 32 位
37: 主频: 480MHz @ 1.1V
38: 流水线: 5 级按序流水线
39: 浮点单元: 可选单精度 F / 双精度 D
40: 中断控制器: CLIC（Core Local Interrupt Controller）
41: 
42: E907 与标准 RISC-V 差异：
43: - 向量表 CSR: mtvec（mode 3）+ mtvt 双 CSR
44: - 中断: CLIC + T-Head 扩展
45: - TCM: ITCM + DTCM
46: - 栈保护: mscratch + SPSWAPEN 扩展
47: - FPU 控制: MXSTATUS 扩展
48: - Cache 控制: T-Head 扩展的 icache_enable/dcache_enable
49: 
50: === 存储系统 ===
51: 片上存储:
52: - BROM: 64KB（Boot ROM，出厂固化）
53: - SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB
54: - PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封，16 位控制器）
55: - ITCM: 可配置，地址 0x30040000
56: - DTCM: 可配置，地址 0x30060000
57: 
58: 外部存储接口:
59: - QSPI: 2 套
60: - eMMC: eMMC 4.5
61: - SD/SDIO: SD 3.01 / SDIO 3.0
62: 
63: 启动方式: SD Card → SPI NOR → SPI NAND → eMMC

67: SRAM: 0x20000000
68: PSRAM: 0x30000000

227: static void d13x_de_timing_enable(void)
228: {
229:   /* 水平时序 */
230: 
231:   putreg32((PANEL_HBP << 24) | (PANEL_HFP << 12) | PANEL_HSYNC,
232:            D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_H_PORCH);
233: 
234:   /* 垂直时序 */
235: 
236:   putreg32((PANEL_VBP << 24) | (PANEL_VFP << 12) | PANEL_VSYNC,
237:            D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_V_PORCH);
238: 
239:   /* 同步脉冲宽度 */
240: 
241:   putreg32((PANEL_HSYNC << 16) | PANEL_VSYNC,
242:            D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_SYNC_PLUSE);
243: 
244:   /* 活动区域尺寸 */
245: 
246:   putreg32((PANEL_HACTIVE << 16) | PANEL_VACTIVE,
247:            D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE);
248: 
249:   /* 使能 DE 时序输出 */
250: 
251:   putreg32(DE_TIMING_EN, D13X_DE_BASE + DE_TIMING_CTRL_EN);
252: }

254: static void d13x_lvds_phy_enable(void)

257:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_1_SWAP, AIC_LVDS_LINES);
258:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_0_POL_CTL, AIC_LVDS_POL);
259:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_1_POL_CTL, AIC_LVDS_POL);
260:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_0_PHY_CTL, AIC_LVDS_PHY);
261:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_1_PHY_CTL, AIC_LVDS_PHY);
262: 
263:   uint32_t ctl = 0;
264:   ctl |= LVDS_CTL_MODE(LVDS_NS);
265:   ctl |= LVDS_CTL_LINK(LVDS_SINGLE_LINK0);
266:   if (AIC_LVDS_LINK_SWAP_EN)
267:     {
268:       ctl |= LVDS_CTL_SWAP_EN;
269:     }
270: 
271:   if (AIC_LVDS_SYNC_MODE_EN)
272:     {
273:       ctl |= LVDS_CTL_SYNC_MODE_EN;
274:     }
275: 
276:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_CTL, ctl);
277:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_CTL, ctl | LVDS_CTL_EN);
278: }

280: static void d13x_lvds_disable(void)
281: {
282:   uint32_t ctl = lvds_getreg(LVDS_CTL);
283:   ctl &= ~LVDS_CTL_EN;
284:   lvds_putreg(LVDS_CTL, ctl);
285: }

373:       return -ENOMEM;

395:         PANEL_HACTIVE, PANEL_VACTIVE,
396:         (unsigned long)(dev->pixclk / 1000000),
397:         dev->fbmem, dev->fblen);

399:   return OK;

Reference macro `TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE_SET(w,h)` places `h` in bits[28:16] and `w` in bits[12:0].

### Fix 5 — PLL_FRA2_OUT_SYS bit position (line 37)
